--[[
	ColorGradientEditor BuildUI
	Classic's body of the colour over life editor: builds the panel and wires its events.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Corners and strokes go through Widgets, so a theme switch recolours the stroke.
local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.Widgets)
local function addCorner(p, r) return Widgets.addCorner(p, r) end
local function addStroke(p, T) return Widgets.addStroke(p) end

-- Builds the editor's UI and wires its events; sets its parts on self.
return function(self, PANEL_W, PANEL_H, BAR_H, BAR_SLICES, STOP_W, STOP_H)
	local T = self._T

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "ColorGradientEditor"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_W/2, 0.3, 0)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, PANEL_H)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Visible = false; panel.ZIndex = 8
	panel.Parent = self._screenGui
	addCorner(panel, "Big"); addStroke(panel, T)
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,8); pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,8)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,6); pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,6); pad.Parent = panel
	self._panel = panel

	local header = Instance.new("Frame"); header.Name = "Header"; header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); header.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); header.Parent = panel

	self._title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); self._title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self._title.Text = "Color Editor"; self._title.TextColor3 = T.Gold; self._title.Font = T.Font
	self._title.TextSize = 11; self._title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	-- A decal layer's title carries the layer's name, of any length: cut short of the buttons.
	self._title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	self._title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-126,1,0); self._title.Parent = header

	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); closeBtn.Name = "Close"; closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "X"; closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; closeBtn.Font = T.Font; closeBtn.TextSize = 11
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,1,0); closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,0); closeBtn.ZIndex = 3
	closeBtn.Parent = header
	self._closeBtn = closeBtn

	-- Code / Copy / Paste sit in the header left of the close button (graph editor layout).
	local HEADER_BTN_W, HEADER_BTN_GAP = 32, 3
	local function makeHeaderBtn(name, text, slot)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 9; b.Size = UDim2.new(0, HEADER_BTN_W, 0, 16); b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(16 + slot * (HEADER_BTN_W + HEADER_BTN_GAP)), 0, 2); b.ZIndex = 3
		b.Parent = header; addCorner(b, UDim.new(0,3)); addStroke(b, T)
		return b
	end
	self._pasteBtn = makeHeaderBtn("Paste", "Paste", 1)
	self._copyBtn = makeHeaderBtn("Copy", "Copy", 2)
	self._codeBtn = makeHeaderBtn("Code", "Code", 3)

	local dragHandle = Instance.new("TextButton"); dragHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dragHandle.Text = ""
	dragHandle.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0); dragHandle.ZIndex = 2; dragHandle.Parent = header
	self._dragHandle = dragHandle

	local barFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); barFrame.Name = "GradientBar"
	barFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0); barFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	barFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,BAR_H); barFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,24)
	barFrame.ClipsDescendants = true; barFrame.Parent = panel
	addCorner(barFrame, UDim.new(0,3)); addStroke(barFrame, T)
	self._barFrame = barFrame

	self._barSlices = {}
	for i = 1, BAR_SLICES do
		local slice = Instance.new("Frame"); slice.Name = "S"..i; slice.BorderSizePixel = 0
		slice.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
		-- A slice of the user's gradient: the theme's recolouring pass leaves it alone.
		slice:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
		slice.Size = UDim2.new(1/BAR_SLICES, 0, 1, 0)
		slice.Position = UDim2.new((i-1)/BAR_SLICES, 0, 0, 0)
		slice.Parent = barFrame
		self._barSlices[i] = slice
	end

	-- The stop triangles sit below the bar.
	local stopArea = Instance.new("Frame"); stopArea.Name = "StopArea"
	stopArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1; stopArea.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,STOP_H+4)
	stopArea.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,24+BAR_H); stopArea.Parent = panel
	self._stopArea = stopArea

	-- The ghost: a half-transparent triangle that follows the cursor.
	local ghost = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ghost.Name = "Ghost"; ghost.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ghost.Text = "\u{25B2}"; ghost.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; ghost.TextTransparency = 0.6
	ghost.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; ghost.TextSize = 14
	ghost.Size = UDim2.new(0, STOP_W, 0, STOP_H); ghost.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	ghost.Visible = false; ghost.ZIndex = 5; ghost.Parent = stopArea
	self._ghost = ghost

	self._stopFrames = {}

	local infoRow = Instance.new("Frame"); infoRow.Name = "InfoRow"; infoRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	infoRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); infoRow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,24+BAR_H+STOP_H+6)
	infoRow.Parent = panel

	local timeLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); timeLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; timeLbl.Text = "Time:"
	timeLbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; timeLbl.Font = T.Font; timeLbl.TextSize = 9
	timeLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,30,1,0); timeLbl.Parent = infoRow

	self._timeInput = Instance.new("TextBox"); self._timeInput.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	self._timeInput.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; self._timeInput.Text = "0.00"
	self._timeInput.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; self._timeInput.Font = T.Font; self._timeInput.TextSize = 9
	self._timeInput.Size = UDim2.new(0,40,1,0); self._timeInput.Position = UDim2.new(0,32,0,0)
	self._timeInput.ClearTextOnFocus = false; self._timeInput.BorderSizePixel = 0
	self._timeInput.Parent = infoRow; addCorner(self._timeInput, UDim.new(0,3))

	self._deleteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); self._deleteBtn.Name = "Delete"
	self._deleteBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; self._deleteBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	self._deleteBtn.Text = "Delete"; self._deleteBtn.TextColor3 = T.Red; self._deleteBtn.Font = T.Font
	self._deleteBtn.TextSize = 9; self._deleteBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,44,1,0)
	self._deleteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-44,0,0); self._deleteBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	self._deleteBtn.Parent = infoRow; addCorner(self._deleteBtn, UDim.new(0,3)); addStroke(self._deleteBtn, T)

	local footer = Instance.new("Frame"); footer.Name = "Footer"; footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	footer.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,22); footer.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,1,-26); footer.Parent = panel
	local fl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); fl.Padding = UDim.new(0,4); fl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	fl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; fl.Parent = footer

	local function makeFooterBtn(name, text, color, lo)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = color
		b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 10; b.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,-2,1,0); b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.LayoutOrder = lo; b.Parent = footer; addCorner(b, UDim.new(0,4)); addStroke(b, T)
		return b
	end
	self._invertBtn = makeFooterBtn("Invert", "Invert", T.Gold, 0)
	self._huesBtn = makeFooterBtn("Hues", "Hues", T.Gold, 1)
	self._reloadBtn = makeFooterBtn("Reload", "Reload", T.MutedGold, 2)
	self._cancelBtn = makeFooterBtn("Cancel", "Cancel", T.DarkGold, 3)
	self._applyBtn = makeFooterBtn("Apply", "Apply", T.Green, 4)

	table.insert(self._conns, self._closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:Close() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:Close() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._applyBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_apply() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._invertBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_reverse() end))

	-- Copy and Paste use the shared sequence clipboard.
	table.insert(self._conns, self._copyBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_copy() end))
	table.insert(self._conns, self._pasteBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_paste() end))
	table.insert(self._conns, self._codeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_openCodePopup() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._reloadBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_reload() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._deleteBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_deleteSelected() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._huesBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_smoothHues() end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._timeInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		self:_setStopTime(self._selectedIndex, tonumber(self._timeInput.Text))
	end))

	local dragging = false
	local dragIdx = nil
	local dragMoved = false -- true once the mouse moved: a drag, not a click

	table.insert(self._conns, self._stopArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		local barWidth = self._barFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
		local barLeft = self._barFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
		local t = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barLeft) / barWidth, 0, 1)
		-- Deferred so a press on a stop starts its drag first.
		task.defer(function()
			if not dragging then
				self:_addStopAt(t)
			end
		end)
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, self._barFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		local barWidth = self._barFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
		local barLeft = self._barFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
		local t = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barLeft) / barWidth, 0, 1)
		task.defer(function()
			if not dragging then self:_addStopAt(t) end
		end)
	end))

	-- Hidden while dragging and near a stop: 0.03 is about a triangle's width over the bar (10 / 280 px).
	local GHOST_SNAP = 0.03
	local function isNearStop(t)
		for _, s in ipairs(self._stops) do
			if math.abs(s.time - t) < GHOST_SNAP then return true end
		end
		return false
	end
	local function updateGhost(input)
		if dragging then self._ghost.Visible = false; return end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		local barWidth = self._barFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
		local barLeft = self._barFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
		local t = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barLeft) / barWidth, 0, 1)
		if isNearStop(t) then self._ghost.Visible = false
		else self._ghost.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0, 0); self._ghost.Visible = true end
	end
	table.insert(self._conns, self._barFrame.InputChanged:Connect(updateGhost))
	table.insert(self._conns, self._barFrame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if not dragging then self._ghost.Visible = false end
	end))
	table.insert(self._conns, self._stopArea.InputChanged:Connect(updateGhost))
	table.insert(self._conns, self._stopArea.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if not dragging then self._ghost.Visible = false end
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or not dragIdx or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		local stop = self._stops[dragIdx]
		if not stop then dragging = false; return end
		-- The first and last stops stay put.
		if dragIdx == 1 or dragIdx == #self._stops then return end
		local barWidth = self._barFrame.AbsoluteSize.X
		local barLeft = self._barFrame.AbsolutePosition.X
		local newT = math.clamp((input.Position.X - barLeft) / barWidth, 0, 1)
		dragMoved = true
		-- Re-sorted as it passes a neighbour, or the bar would draw it in its old slot.
		dragIdx = self:_moveStop(dragIdx, newT)
		self:_render()
		self:_firePreview()
	end))

	table.insert(self._conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and dragging then
			self._wasDrag = dragMoved -- _onStopClick skips a press that moved
			dragging = false; dragIdx = nil
			self:_render()
		end
	end))

	-- Wires a stop's press to start a drag, replacing any earlier connection. Open and _addStopAt call it.
	self._stopDragWirer = function(index)
		if index > #self._stopFrames then return end
		local sf = self._stopFrames[index]
		if sf.dragConn then sf.dragConn:Disconnect() end
		sf.dragConn = sf.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				dragging = true; dragMoved = false
				dragIdx = index
				self._selectedIndex = index
				self._ghost.Visible = false
				self:_renderStops()
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Panel drag: the cursor's delta is divided by UIScale.Scale (offsets are unscaled pixels).
	local panelDragging = false
	local dragStart, startPos, dragScale
	table.insert(self._conns, self._dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			panelDragging = true; dragStart = i.Position; startPos = self._panel.Position
			local sg = self._panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
			local us = sg and sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			dragScale = (us and us.Scale) or 1
		end
	end))
	table.insert(self._conns, self._dragHandle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then panelDragging = false end
	end))
	table.insert(self._conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if panelDragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			local d = i.Position - dragStart
			-- From now on Open leaves the panel where it is (ColorGradientEditor:Open).
			self._placedByHand = true
			self._panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X / dragScale, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y / dragScale)
		end
	end))
end

--[[
	ColorGradientEditor CodeIO Mixin  -  gradient <-> Luau code string bridge.
	_openCodePopup() shows the current gradient as a `ColorSequence.new({...})` constructor (select-all
	focused for Ctrl+C) with an Import button that parses the same form back into stops.
]]

local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.Widgets)

return function(ColorGradientEditor)

local function rgb(c)
	return math.round(c.R * 255), math.round(c.G * 255), math.round(c.B * 255)
end

-- Serialize what Apply would write (sorted, clamped) so exported code matches applied output.
function ColorGradientEditor:_csToCodeString()
	local cs = self._stopsToCS(self._stops)
	local lines = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(cs.Keypoints) do
		local r, g, b = rgb(kp.Value)
		table.insert(lines, string.format("\tColorSequenceKeypoint.new(%.4g, Color3.fromRGB(%d, %d, %d)),", kp.Time, r, g, b))
	end
	return "ColorSequence.new({\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n})"
end

-- Parse `ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b))` (or Color3.new / fromHSV) entries out of pasted code.
function ColorGradientEditor:_parseCodeString(text)
	local stops = {}
	for t, ctor, args in text:gmatch("ColorSequenceKeypoint%.new%s*%(%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*Color3%.(%w+)%s*%(([^%)]*)%)") do
		local nums = {}
		for token in args:gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(nums, tonumber((token:gsub("%s", "")))) end
		local time = tonumber(t)
		if not time or not nums[1] or not nums[2] or not nums[3] then return nil, "Unreadable keypoint" end
		local color
		if ctor == "fromRGB" then
			color = Color3.fromRGB(nums[1], nums[2], nums[3])
		elseif ctor == "new" then
			color = Color3.new(nums[1], nums[2], nums[3])
		elseif ctor == "fromHSV" then
			color = Color3.fromHSV(nums[1], nums[2], nums[3])
		else
			return nil, "Unsupported Color3 constructor: " .. ctor
		end
		table.insert(stops, { time = math.clamp(time, 0, 1), color = color })
	end
	if #stops < 2 then return nil, "Need at least 2 keypoints" end
	if #stops > ColorGradientEditor.MOST_STOPS then
		return nil, "A ColorSequence holds at most " .. ColorGradientEditor.MOST_STOPS .. " keypoints"
	end
	table.sort(stops, function(a, b) return a.time < b.time end)
	stops[1].time = 0
	stops[#stops].time = 1
	return stops
end

-- Code read into the stops, drawn and previewed: true, or false and why not.
function ColorGradientEditor:_loadCodeString(text)
	local stops, why = self:_parseCodeString(text)
	if not stops then
		return false, why or "Couldn't parse code"
	end
	self._stops = stops
	self._selectedIndex = nil
	self:_showLoaded()
	self:_firePreview()
	return true
end

-- Classic's popup Import.
function ColorGradientEditor:_importCodeString(text)
	local loaded, why = self:_loadCodeString(text)
	if not loaded then
		self._codeHint.Text = why
		return
	end
	self._codePopup.Visible = false
end

function ColorGradientEditor:_buildCodePopup()
	local T = self._T
	local popup = Instance.new("Frame"); popup.Name = "CodePopup"; popup.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	popup.BackgroundTransparency = 0; popup.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -24); popup.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
	popup.ZIndex = 18; popup.Visible = false; popup.Parent = self._panel
	Widgets.addCorner(popup); Widgets.addStroke(popup)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox"); box.Name = "CodeBox"
	box.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; box.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	box.Font = Enum.Font.Code; box.TextSize = 9
	box.MultiLine = true; box.TextWrapped = true; box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; box.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -30); box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
	box.Text = ""; box.ZIndex = 19; box.Parent = popup
	local function footBtn(name, text, color, xOff)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = color; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 9; b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
		b.Position = UDim2.new(1, xOff, 1, -22); b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.ZIndex = 19; b.Parent = popup
		Widgets.addCorner(b, UDim.new(0,3)); Widgets.addStroke(b)
		return b
	end
	local importBtn = footBtn("Import", "Import", T.Green, -54)
	local closeBtn = footBtn("CloseCode", "Close", T.DarkGold, -108)
	local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); hint.Name = "Hint"; hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hint.Text = "Ctrl+C to copy  -  paste code, then Import"; hint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; hint.Font = T.Font; hint.TextSize = 8
	hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 18); hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -22)
	hint.ZIndex = 19; hint.Parent = popup
	table.insert(self._conns, importBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_importCodeString(box.Text) end))
	table.insert(self._conns, closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() popup.Visible = false end))
	self._codePopup = popup
	self._codeBox = box
	self._codeHint = hint
end

function ColorGradientEditor:_openCodePopup()
	if not self._codePopup then self:_buildCodePopup() end
	if self._codePopup.Visible then
		self._codePopup.Visible = false
		return
	end
	self._codeHint.Text = "Ctrl+C to copy  -  paste code, then Import"
	self._codeBox.Text = self:_csToCodeString()
	self._codePopup.Visible = true
	self._codeBox:CaptureFocus()
	self._codeBox.SelectionStart = 1
	self._codeBox.CursorPosition = #self._codeBox.Text + 1
end

end

--[[
	ColorGradientEditor/Presets  -  the colour over life editor's Presets page: built-in sequences
	that are hard to build by hand and the user's own, each a tile (strip, name, stop count), two
	to a row, scrolling.
	  Presets.BUILT_IN -> { { name, sequence } }   each runs bright to dark, the way an effect cools
	  Presets.stored(settings) -> store            the user's own, in the plugin setting SAVED_SETTING
	                                                (in memory where there is none)
	    store.get() -> { { name, sequence } }
	    store.add(sequence)                        named "Saved N", the first N free
	    store.remove(index)
	  Presets.build(parent, order, handlers) -> page
	    handlers.onPick(sequence)   a tile pressed
	    handlers.onSave()           "+ Save this one" pressed
	    handlers.onRemove(index)    a saved tile pressed with the right button
	    page.frame
	    page:set(saved, current)    the saved tiles, and the ring on the tile that holds `current`
	    page:pick(kind, index), page:save(), page:remove(index)
	                                what a tile ("built" or "saved"), "+" or a right press does (for checks)
]]

local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local C = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)
local ColorMath = require(UIBuilder.ThemeModes.ColorMath)
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local Presets = {}

local SAVED_SETTING = "ColorSequencePresets"
local MOST_SAVED = 24
local TILE_GAP = 8
local STRIP_HEIGHT = 22
local TILE_PAD = 6
-- How many rows of tiles the page shows before it scrolls.
local ROWS_SHOWN = 5

-- { name, { { percent, "#hex" } } }: written as a colour stop list reads.
local BUILT_IN = {
	{ "Rainbow", { { 0, "ff2a2a" }, { 17, "ff9a1f" }, { 33, "ffe83a" }, { 50, "3ddc5a" }, { 67, "2fb8ff" }, { 83, "5a5cff" }, { 100, "c13dff" } } },
	{ "Fire", { { 0, "fff7d6" }, { 12, "ffe27a" }, { 30, "ffae3d" }, { 50, "ff6a1f" }, { 70, "c8321a" }, { 88, "4a1c14" }, { 100, "1c1614" } } },

-- A sequence as the setting keeps it: { { time, "#hex" } }, and back (nil when unreadable).
local function toStored(sequence)
	local stops = {}
	for _, keypoint in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints) do
		table.insert(stops, { keypoint.Time, ColorMath.toHex(keypoint.Value) })
	end
	return stops
end

local function fromStored(stops)
	if type(stops) ~= "table" or #stops < 2 then
		return nil
	end
	local keypoints = {}
	for _, stop in ipairs(stops) do
		local color = type(stop) == "table" and type(stop[1]) == "number" and type(stop[2]) == "string" and ColorMath.fromHex(stop[2])
		if not color then
			return nil
		end
		table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(math.clamp(stop[1], 0, 1), color))
	end
	local made, sequence = pcall(ColorSequence.new, keypoints)
	return made and sequence or nil
end

function Presets.stored(settings)
	local held = nil
	local store = {}
	local function write()
		if not settings then
			return
		end
		local entries = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(held) do
			table.insert(entries, { name = entry.name, stops = toStored(entry.sequence) })
		end
		pcall(function()
			settings:SetSetting(SAVED_SETTING, entries)
		end)
	end
	function store.get()
		if held then
			return held
		end
		held = {}
		local ok, entries = false, nil
		if settings then
			ok, entries = pcall(function()
				return settings:GetSetting(SAVED_SETTING)
			end)
		end
		if ok and type(entries) == "table" then
			for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
				local sequence = type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.name) == "string" and fromStored(entry.stops)
				if sequence then
					table.insert(held, { name = entry.name, sequence = sequence })
				end
			end
		end
		return held
	end
	function store.add(sequence)
		local list = store.get()
		local taken = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
			taken[entry.name] = true
		end
		local number = 1
		while taken["Saved " .. number] do
			number += 1
		end
		table.insert(list, { name = "Saved " .. number, sequence = sequence })
		while #list > MOST_SAVED do
			table.remove(list, 1)
		end
		write()
	end
	function store.remove(index)
		table.remove(store.get(), index)
		write()
	end
	return store
end

function Presets.build(parent, order, handlers)
	local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	page.Name = "Presets"
	page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	page.BorderSizePixel = 0
	page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	page.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	page.LayoutOrder = order
	W.lay(page, "Size", function()
		local tile = TILE_PAD * 2 + STRIP_HEIGHT + LAYOUT.Text + 6
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROWS_SHOWN * (tile + TILE_GAP) + LAYOUT.Text + 6)
	end)
	W.paint(page, "ScrollBarImageColor3", "TextSecondary")
	page.Parent = parent
	W.addListLayout(page, "RowGap")
	W.addPadding(page, 0, 8, 0, 4)

	local built = makeSection(page, "BuiltIn", "Built in", 1)
	local tiles = {}
	for index, preset in ipairs(Presets.BUILT_IN) do
		local tile = makeTile(built, preset.name, preset.sequence, index)
		tile.Activated:Connect(function()
			handlers.onPick(preset.sequence)
		end)
		table.insert(tiles, { tile = tile, sequence = preset.sequence })
	end
	local saved = makeSection(page, "Saved", "Saved", 3)
	local add = Instance.new("TextButton")
	add.Name = "Add"
	add.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	add.Text = "+ Save this one"
	add.LayoutOrder = 10000
	TypeScale.style(add, "Label")
	W.paint(add, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	add.Parent = saved
	W.addCorner(add)
	W.addStroke(add)
	add.Activated:Connect(handlers.onSave)

	local savedTiles = {}
	local savedList = {}
	local shown = nil
	local view = { frame = page }
	function view:set(list, current)
		local names = {}
		for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
			names[index] = entry.name
		end
		local key = table.concat(names, "\n")
		if key ~= shown or #list ~= #savedTiles then
			shown = key
			for _, entry in ipairs(savedTiles) do
				entry.tile:Destroy()
			end
			savedTiles = {}
			for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
				local tile = makeTile(saved, entry.name, entry.sequence, index)
				tile.Activated:Connect(function()
					handlers.onPick(entry.sequence)
				end)
				tile.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
					handlers.onRemove(index)
				end)
				table.insert(savedTiles, { tile = tile, sequence = entry.sequence })
			end
		end
		savedList = list
		for _, group in ipairs({ tiles, savedTiles }) do
			for _, entry in ipairs(group) do
				entry.tile.Picked.Visible = current ~= nil and entry.sequence == current
			end
		end
	end
	function view:pick(kind, index)
		local entry = kind == "saved" and savedList[index] or Presets.BUILT_IN[index]
		if entry then
			handlers.onPick(entry.sequence)
		end
	end
	function view:save()
		handlers.onSave()
	end
	function view:remove(index)
		handlers.onRemove(index)
	end
	return view
end

--[[
	ColorGradientEditor/ViewStops  -  the colour over life editor outside Classic: the sequence as a
	strip with a pin under it per stop, the selected stop's place, the colour wheel and the numbers
	for its colour, the effect's colours, the tools (Reverse, Even spacing, Smooth hues) and a footer
	(count, Cancel, Apply). A Stops | Presets switch shows the Presets page (Presets.luau) instead;
	the menu holds Copy, Paste, Code and Reset to the start, and Code shows the sequence as code.
	  ViewStops.build(editor) -> view, or nil where the wheel cannot be drawn (the editor then builds
	  its Classic body). The editor holds the stops (_stops, sorted by time, first at 0, last at 1)
	  and the selection (_selectedIndex); the view draws them and calls the editor's methods.
	    view.panel
	    view.open(title, options, position)  options as ColorGradientEditor:Open takes them
	    view.render(from)    every piece for the stops; `from` ("wheel") is not set again
	    view.showPage(name)  "stops", "presets" or "code"
	    view.close()         shuts the menu
	    view.destroy()
	    view.presets         the Presets page (its pick(kind, index) is what a tile press does)
	Pins: a press selects and drags one (the end stops stay put); let go below the rail, it is
	removed. A press on the rail away from the pins adds a stop there, on the strip selects the
	nearest. Crowded pins drop to a second tier. Delete or Backspace over the panel removes the
	selected stop.
]]

	grip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	grip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -3)
	grip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 5)
	grip.ZIndex = 5
	grip.Parent = pin

	return pin

-- The selected stop's colour: the wheel, and beside it the colour it had, the hex and Copy; then

		return math.clamp(room * WHEEL_SHARE, 80, 280)

	W.addListLayout(side, "RowGap")

	parts.wheel = wheel
	parts.wasNow = Controls.wasNow(side, 1, function()
		if parts.wasColor then

	parts.channels = Controls.channels(parts.panel, 7, setColor)
	parts.effectRow = Controls.swatches(parts.panel, 8, "In this effect", setColor)

-- Each stop's tier: the first, or the second where the first is crowded and the second is not.
local function tiersOf(stops, width)
	local lastX = { -math.huge, -math.huge }
	local tiers = {}
	local twoTiers = false
	for index, stop in ipairs(stops) do
		local x = stop.time * width
		local tier = 1
		if x - lastX[1] < CROWDED and x - lastX[2] >= CROWDED then
			tier = 2
		end
		lastX[tier] = x
		tiers[index] = tier
		twoTiers = twoTiers or tier == 2
	end
	return tiers, twoTiers
end

-- The pins where their stops stand, the selected one ringed and raised, a pin dragged off the
-- rail faded below it.
local function drawPins(parts, editor, drag)
	local stops = editor._stops
	local tiers, twoTiers = tiersOf(stops, parts.area.AbsoluteSize.X)
	parts.rail.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, RAIL_HEIGHT + (twoTiers and TIER_DROP or 0))
	for index, stop in ipairs(stops) do
		local pin = parts.pins[index]
		if not pin then
			pin = makePin(parts.area)
			parts.pins[index] = pin
		end
		local picked = index == editor._selectedIndex
		local gone = drag ~= nil and drag.index == index and drag.gone
		local top = STEM + (tiers[index] - 1) * TIER_DROP + (gone and TIER_DROP or 0)
		pin.Visible = true
		pin.BackgroundColor3 = stop.color
		pin.BackgroundTransparency = gone and 0.55 or 0
		local size = picked and UDim2.fromOffset(PICKED_WIDTH, PICKED_HEIGHT) or UDim2.fromOffset(PIN_WIDTH, PIN_HEIGHT)
		if pin:GetAttribute("Picked") ~= picked then
			pin:SetAttribute("Picked", picked)
			TweenService:Create(pin, GROW, { Size = size }):Play()
		end
		pin.Position = UDim2.new(stop.time, 0, 0, picked and top - 2 or top)
		pin.ZIndex = picked and 5 or 4
		pin.Stem.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, top)
		pin.Grip.Visible = index == 1 or index == #stops
		if picked then
			parts.ring.Visible = not gone
			parts.ring.Position = UDim2.new(stop.time, 0, 0, top - 5)
		end
	end
	for index = #stops + 1, #parts.pins do
		parts.pins[index].Visible = false
	end
end

-- The pin under a point on screen (the nearest where two overlap), or nil.
local function pinAt(parts, count, point)
	local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
	for index = 1, count do
		local pin = parts.pins[index]
		if pin and pin.Visible then
			local centre = pin.AbsolutePosition + pin.AbsoluteSize / 2
			local dx = math.abs(point.X - centre.X)
			local dy = math.abs(point.Y - centre.Y)
			local distance = dx * dx + dy * dy
			if dx <= pin.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 + 3 and dy <= pin.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 + 6 and distance < bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = index, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function isOver(frame, point)
	local corner = frame.AbsolutePosition
	local size = frame.AbsoluteSize
	return point.X >= corner.X and point.Y >= corner.Y and point.X <= corner.X + size.X and point.Y <= corner.Y + size.Y
end

-- The strip and the rail: select, add, drag, drag off to remove, the "+" under the pointer.
local function wireRail(parts, editor, view, connect)
	local function timeAt(x)
		return math.clamp((x - parts.area.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(parts.area.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
	end
	local function full()
		return #editor._stops >= editor.MOST_STOPS
	end
	connect(parts.stripCatcher.InputBegan, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		local time = timeAt(input.Position.X)
		local nearest, nearestDistance = 1, math.huge
		for index, stop in ipairs(editor._stops) do
			if math.abs(stop.time - time) < nearestDistance then
				nearest, nearestDistance = index, math.abs(stop.time - time)
			end
		end
		view.select(nearest)
	end)
	connect(parts.railCatcher.InputBegan, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local index = pinAt(parts, #editor._stops, point)
		if index then
			parts.drag = { index = index, gone = false }
			parts.ghost.Visible = false
			view.select(index)
		elseif not full() then
			editor:_addStopAt(math.clamp(timeAt(point.X), 0.001, 0.999))
		end
	end)
	connect(parts.railCatcher.InputChanged, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or parts.drag then
			return
		end
		local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		parts.ghost.Visible = pinAt(parts, #editor._stops, point) == nil
		parts.ghost.Position = UDim2.new(timeAt(point.X), 0, 0, STEM)
		parts.ghost.TextTransparency = full() and 0.75 or 0.2
		parts.ghostEdge.Transparency = full() and 0.75 or 0.35
	end)
	connect(parts.railCatcher.MouseLeave, function()
		parts.ghost.Visible = false
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		local drag = parts.drag
		if not drag or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			return
		end
		local stops = editor._stops
		if not stops[drag.index] then
			parts.drag = nil
			return
		end
		-- An end stop stays put: pressing it changes nothing, so nothing is previewed.
		local inside = drag.index > 1 and drag.index < #stops
		if not inside then
			return
		end
		local wasGone = drag.gone
		drag.gone = #stops > 2 and input.Position.Y > parts.rail.AbsolutePosition.Y + parts.rail.AbsoluteSize.Y + OFF_RAIL
		if drag.gone then
			if not wasGone then
				view.render()
			end
			return
		end
		drag.index = editor:_moveStop(drag.index, math.clamp(timeAt(input.Position.X), 0.001, 0.999))
		view.edited()
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if not parts.drag or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			return
		end
		local gone = parts.drag.gone
		parts.drag = nil
		if gone then
			editor:_deleteSelected()
		else
			view.render()
		end
	end)
	connect(parts.area:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
		if parts.panel.Visible then
			drawPins(parts, editor, parts.drag)
		end
	end)
end

-- The page switch, the stop bar, the tools, close, and the Delete key over the panel.
local function wireStopControls(parts, editor, view, connect)
	connect(parts.previous.Activated, function()
		view.select(math.max((editor._selectedIndex or 1) - 1, 1))
	end)
	connect(parts.nextButton.Activated, function()
		view.select(math.min((editor._selectedIndex or 1) + 1, #editor._stops))
	end)
	connect(parts.remove.Activated, function()
		editor:_deleteSelected()
	end)
	-- A typed time moves an inner stop between its neighbours; anything else shows the time back.
	connect(parts.timeBox.FocusLost, function()
		if not editor:_setStopTime(editor._selectedIndex, tonumber(parts.timeBox.Text)) then
			view.render()
		end
	end)
	connect(parts.tools[1].Activated, function()
		editor:_reverse()
	end)
	connect(parts.tools[2].Activated, function()
		editor:_evenSpacing()
	end)
	connect(parts.tools[3].Activated, function()
		editor:_smoothHues()
	end)
	connect(parts.stopsTab.Activated, function()
		view.showPage("stops")
	end)
	connect(parts.presetsTab.Activated, function()
		view.showPage("presets")
	end)
	connect(parts.bar.close.Activated, function()
		editor:Close()
	end)
	Controls.watchPlaced(parts.panel, parts.bar.dragHandle, function()
		editor._placedByHand = true
	end)
	local hovering = false
	connect(parts.panel.MouseEnter, function()
		hovering = true
	end)
	connect(parts.panel.MouseLeave, function()
		hovering = false
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input)
		local key = input.KeyCode
		if (key == Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace) and hovering and parts.panel.Visible
			and parts.page == "stops" and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			editor:_deleteSelected()
		end
	end)
end

-- The menu's items, its button, a press elsewhere closing it; the code's Back and Import.
local function wireMenu(parts, editor, view, connect)
	local menu = parts.menu
	local function closeMenu()
		menu.Visible = false
	end
	parts.closeMenu = closeMenu
	connect(parts.more.Activated, function()
		if menu.Visible then
			closeMenu()
			return
		end
		parts.pasteItem.TextTransparency = SequenceClipboard.get("ColorSequence") and 0 or 0.5
		local scale = W._getScale(parts.panel)
		local corner = (parts.more.AbsolutePosition + parts.more.AbsoluteSize) / scale
		menu.Visible = true
		menu.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(corner.X - menu.AbsoluteSize.X / scale, corner.Y)
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and menu.Visible then
			local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			if not isOver(menu, point) and not isOver(parts.more, point) then
				closeMenu()
			end
		end
	end)
	connect(parts.copyItem.Activated, function()
		closeMenu()
		editor:_copy()
	end)
	connect(parts.pasteItem.Activated, function()
		closeMenu()
		if editor:_paste() and parts.page == "code" then
			view.showPage("stops")
		end
	end)
	connect(parts.codeItem.Activated, function()
		closeMenu()
		view.showPage(parts.page == "code" and "stops" or "code")
	end)
	connect(parts.resetItem.Activated, function()
		closeMenu()
		editor:_reload()
	end)
	connect(parts.codeBack.Activated, function()
		view.showPage("stops")
	end)
	connect(parts.codeImport.Activated, function()
		local loaded, why = editor:_loadCodeString(parts.codeBox.Text)
		if not loaded then
			parts.codeNote.Text = why
			return
		end
		view.showPage("stops")
	end)
end

-- The stop bar and the colour pieces for the selected stop.
local function showStop(parts, editor, from)
	local stops = editor._stops
	local index = editor._selectedIndex
	local stop = stops[index]
	parts.stepText.Text = string.format("%d of %d", index, #stops)
	parts.previous.TextTransparency = index > 1 and 0 or 0.6
	parts.nextButton.TextTransparency = index < #stops and 0 or 0.6
	local inside = index > 1 and index < #stops
	if not parts.timeBox:IsFocused() then
		parts.timeBox.Text = string.format("%.3f", stop.time)
	end
	parts.timeBox.TextEditable = inside
	parts.timeBox.TextTransparency = inside and 0 or 0.4
	parts.remove.TextTransparency = (inside and #stops > 2) and 0 or 0.6

	if from ~= "wheel" then
		local h, s, v = stop.color:ToHSV()
		if s == 0 then
			h = parts.wheel:get()
		end
		parts.wheel:set(h, s, v)
	end
	parts.wasNow:set(parts.wasColor, stop.color)
	parts.hex:set(stop.color)
	parts.channels:set(stop.color)
	parts.effectRow:set(parts.effectColors, stop.color)
end

function ViewStops.build(editor)
	local panel = W.makePanel(editor._screenGui, "ColorGradientEditor", PanelSizes.of("ColorStops"))
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.ZIndex = 8
	-- Its home for PanelPersistence's Reset Layout; every Open places it again until it is dragged.
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.25)
	local parts = { panel = panel, effectColors = {}, page = "stops" }
	local view = { panel = panel }
	local connections = {}
	local function connect(signal, handler)
		table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(handler))
	end
	local function setColor(color, from)
		local stop = editor._stops[editor._selectedIndex or 0]
		if stop then
			stop.color = color
			view.edited(from)
		end
	end

	buildTitleBar(parts)
	parts.live = Controls.liveLine(panel, 1)
	buildStrip(parts)
	buildRail(parts)
	buildStopBar(parts)
	local stopsBreak = W.makeGroupBreak(panel, 5)
	if not buildPick(parts, setColor) then
		panel:Destroy()
		return nil
	end
	local colourBreak = W.makeGroupBreak(panel, 9)
	local toolsRow
	parts.tools, toolsRow = W.makeButtonRow(panel, "Tools", {
		{ name = "Reverse", text = "Reverse" },
		{ name = "Even", text = "Even spacing" },
		{ name = "Hues", text = "Smooth hues" },
	}, 10)
	local footerBreak = W.makeGroupBreak(panel, 12)
	parts.footer = Controls.footer(panel, 13, function()
		editor:Close()
	end, function()
		editor:_apply()
	end)
	parts.store = Presets.stored(editor._settings)
	parts.presets = Presets.build(panel, 11, {
		onPick = function(sequence)
			editor:_load(sequence)
		end,
		onSave = function()
			parts.store.add(editor._stopsToCS(editor._stops))
			view.render()
		end,
		onRemove = function(index)
			parts.store.remove(index)
			view.render()
		end,
	})
	view.presets = parts.presets
	buildCode(parts)
	buildMenu(parts, editor._screenGui)
	parts.pages = {
		stops = { parts.stripRow, parts.rail, parts.stopBar, stopsBreak, parts.pickRow, parts.channels.frame,
			parts.effectRow.frame, colourBreak, toolsRow, footerBreak, parts.footer.frame },
		presets = { parts.stripRow, parts.presets.frame, footerBreak, parts.footer.frame },
		code = parts.coding,
	}

	function view.render(from)
		local stops = editor._stops
		if #stops == 0 then
			return
		end
		editor._selectedIndex = math.clamp(editor._selectedIndex or 1, 1, #stops)
		local stop = stops[editor._selectedIndex]
		-- Was: the colour the stop had when it was selected.
		if stop ~= parts.wasFor then
			parts.wasFor = stop
			parts.wasColor = stop.color
		end
		local sequence = editor._stopsToCS(stops)
		parts.ramp.Color = sequence
		parts.timeLine.Position = UDim2.new(stop.time, 0, 0, -3)
		parts.timeLine.Visible = parts.page ~= "presets"
		local most = editor.MOST_STOPS
		local count = string.format("%d of %d stops", #stops, most)
		parts.footer.status.Text = #stops >= most and count .. ", the most a color sequence holds" or count
		-- Each page draws only its own pieces: a colour row shows itself when it has colours.
		if parts.page == "presets" then
			parts.presets:set(parts.store.get(), sequence)
		elseif parts.page == "stops" then
			drawPins(parts, editor, parts.drag)
			showStop(parts, editor, from)
		end
	end

	-- A change to the stops: drawn, and sent to what the editor was opened for.
	function view.edited(from)
		view.render(from)
		editor:_firePreview()
	end

	function view.select(index)
		editor._selectedIndex = index
		view.render()
	end

	function view.showPage(name)
		parts.page = name
		local shown = {}
		for _, row in ipairs(parts.pages[name]) do
			shown[row] = true
		end
		for _, rows in pairs(parts.pages) do
			for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
				row.Visible = shown[row] == true
			end
		end
		W.paintSegment(parts.stopsTab, name ~= "presets")
		W.paintSegment(parts.presetsTab, name == "presets")
		if name ~= "code" then
			view.render()
			return
		end
		parts.codeNote.Text = "Ctrl+C copies it. Paste a ColorSequence.new over it, then Import."
		parts.codeBox.Text = editor:_csToCodeString()
		parts.codeBox:CaptureFocus()
		parts.codeBox.SelectionStart = 1
		parts.codeBox.CursorPosition = #parts.codeBox.Text + 1
	end

	-- Beside the row that opened it, else at `position`, unless the user has put it somewhere.
	function view.open(title, options, position)
		options = options or {}
		local name = options.title or title
		if name == nil or name == "" then
			name = "Color"
		end
		parts.live:set(name, options)
		parts.bar.title.Text = parts.live.frame.Visible and "Color over life" or name
		parts.effectColors = options.items and EffectColors.of(options.items, EffectColors.MOST) or {}
		parts.wasFor = nil
		view.showPage("stops")
		if editor._placedByHand then
			return
		end
		if position and not options.anchor then
			panel.Position = position
		else
			Controls.place(panel, editor._screenGui, options.anchor)
		end
	end

	function view.close()
		parts.closeMenu()
		parts.drag = nil
		parts.ghost.Visible = false
	end

	function view.destroy()
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		connections = {}
		parts.wheel:destroy()
		parts.menu:Destroy()
		panel:Destroy()
	end

	wireRail(parts, editor, view, connect)
	wireStopControls(parts, editor, view, connect)
	wireMenu(parts, editor, view, connect)
	return view
end

return ViewStops

--[[
	ColorPicker Module
	The colour picker. Outside Classic it is ViewWheel (a colour wheel with a darkness slider, hex,
	R G B, the effect's colours, recent and saved). Classic keeps a Studio-like body: a Hue by
	Saturation square, a Value strip, HSV / RGB / hex inputs, OK and Cancel.
	  ColorPicker.new(screenGui, theme, settings): settings (the plugin) keeps recent and saved colours.
	  Open / Close / IsOpen / IsBoundToSelection / GetPanel / GetColor / SetOnColorChanged / SetOnOK /
	  SetOnCancel / RefreshTheme / Destroy / IsPlacedByHand / SetPlacedByHand
	ColorPicker.Wheel / .Controls / .EffectColors: the pieces the colour over life editor shares. A
	release ships this folder as one module (BUNDLE_GROUPS), so code outside reaches them here.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local buildUI = require(script.BuildUI)
local ViewWheel = require(script.ViewWheel)
local Wheel = require(script.Wheel)
local Controls = require(script.Controls)
local EffectColors = require(script.EffectColors)
local UIConstants = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.TypeScale)
local ColorMath = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.ThemeModes.ColorMath)

local ColorPicker = {}
ColorPicker.__index = ColorPicker
ColorPicker.Wheel = Wheel
ColorPicker.Controls = Controls
ColorPicker.EffectColors = EffectColors

local color3ToHex, hexToColor3 = ColorMath.toHex, ColorMath.fromHex


function ColorPicker.new(screenGui, theme, settings)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ColorPicker)
	self._T = theme
	self._screenGui = screenGui
	self._settings = settings
	self._conns = {}

	-- _h stays in [0, 0.999]: fromHSV(1) wraps to red, so the canvas's right edge stops just short.
	self._h = 0
	self._s = 1
	self._v = 1
	self._originalColor = Color3.new(1,1,1)

	-- Set with SetOn*() before Open(); Close() clears them.
	self._onChanged = nil
	self._onOK = nil
	self._onCancel = nil
	-- Set by every Open: whether the pick edits something of the selection.
	self._boundToSelection = false

	-- Outside Classic the wheel, where it can be drawn; else Classic's body.
	if not UIConstants.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		self._view = ViewWheel.build(self)
	end
	if self._view then
		self._panel = self._view.panel
	else
		buildUI(self)
		self:_wire()
	end
	return self
end


function ColorPicker:_getColor()
	return Color3.fromHSV(self._h, self._s, self._v)
end

-- The colour held, from the wheel or a control (`from`: the one not to set again).
function ColorPicker:_setHSV(h, s, v, from)
	self._h, self._s, self._v = math.clamp(h, 0, 0.999), math.clamp(s, 0, 1), math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
	self:_updateUI(from)
end

-- A grey keeps the hue it had, so the wheel's ring does not jump to red.
function ColorPicker:_setColor(color, from)
	local h, s, v = color:ToHSV()
	if s == 0 then
		h = self._h
	end
	self:_setHSV(h, s, v, from)
end

-- Apply: the colour stays, the panel closes.
function ColorPicker:_apply()
	self._panel.Visible = false
	if self._onOK then self._onOK() end
end

function ColorPicker:_updateUI(from)
	local c = self:_getColor()
	if self._view then
		self._view.show(self._h, self._s, self._v, from)
		if self._onChanged then self._onChanged(c) end
		return
	end
	self._preview.BackgroundColor3 = c

	self._crosshair.Position = UDim2.new(self._h, 0, 1 - self._s, 0)

	-- The strip's white-to-black gradient (BuildUI) multiplies over this full-Value colour.
	self._valStrip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(self._h, self._s, 1)
	self._valIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, -2, 1 - self._v, 0)

	self._hexIn.Text = color3ToHex(c)
	self._hueIn.Text = tostring(math.floor(self._h * 360 + 0.5))
	self._satIn.Text = tostring(math.floor(self._s * 255 + 0.5))
	self._valIn.Text = tostring(math.floor(self._v * 255 + 0.5))
	self._redIn.Text = tostring(math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5))
	self._greenIn.Text = tostring(math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5))
	self._blueIn.Text = tostring(math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))

	if self._onChanged then self._onChanged(c) end
end


function ColorPicker:_wire()
	local canvasDragging = false
	local stripDragging = false

	self._canvasBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			canvasDragging = true
			self:_updateFromCanvas(i)
		end
	end)
	self._canvasBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then canvasDragging = false end
	end)

	self._valBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			stripDragging = true
			self:_updateFromStrip(i)
		end
	end)
	self._valBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then stripDragging = false end
	end)

	table.insert(self._conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		if canvasDragging then self:_updateFromCanvas(i)
		elseif stripDragging then self:_updateFromStrip(i) end
	end))
	table.insert(self._conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			canvasDragging = false; stripDragging = false
		end
	end))

	local function wireHSV(tb, setter)
		tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local n = tonumber(tb.Text); if not n then return end
			setter(n); self:_updateUI()
		end)
	end
	wireHSV(self._hueIn, function(n) self._h = math.clamp(n / 360, 0, 0.999) end)
	wireHSV(self._satIn, function(n) self._s = math.clamp(n / 255, 0, 1) end)
	wireHSV(self._valIn, function(n) self._v = math.clamp(n / 255, 0, 1) end)

	local function applyRGB()
		local r = tonumber(self._redIn.Text) or 0
		local g = tonumber(self._greenIn.Text) or 0
		local b = tonumber(self._blueIn.Text) or 0
		local c = Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(r,0,255), math.clamp(g,0,255), math.clamp(b,0,255))
		self._h, self._s, self._v = Color3.toHSV(c)
		self:_updateUI()
	end
	self._redIn.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)
	self._greenIn.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)
	self._blueIn.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)

	self._hexIn.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local c = hexToColor3(self._hexIn.Text)
		if c then self._h, self._s, self._v = Color3.toHSV(c); self:_updateUI() end
	end)

	self._okBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:_apply()
	end)

	self._cancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:Close() end)
	self._closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:Close() end)

	-- UIScale is taken at drag start so mouse pixels map 1:1 to Offset, as in Widgets.makeDraggable.
	local panelDragging = false; local dragStart, startPos, dragScale
	self._dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			panelDragging = true; dragStart = i.Position; startPos = self._panel.Position
			local sg = self._panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
			local us = sg and sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			dragScale = (us and us.Scale) or 1
		end
	end)
	self._dragHandle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then panelDragging = false end
	end)
	table.insert(self._conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if panelDragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			local d = i.Position - dragStart
			self._panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X / dragScale, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y / dragScale)
		end
	end))
end

function ColorPicker:_updateFromCanvas(input)
	local pos = input.Position
	local canvas = self._canvasBtn.Parent
	local cx = math.clamp((pos.X - canvas.AbsolutePosition.X) / canvas.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 0.999)
	local cy = math.clamp((pos.Y - canvas.AbsolutePosition.Y) / canvas.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
	self._h = cx
	self._s = 1 - cy -- top is 1
	self:_updateUI()
end

function ColorPicker:_updateFromStrip(input)
	local pos = input.Position
	local strip = self._valBtn.Parent
	local sy = math.clamp((pos.Y - strip.AbsolutePosition.Y) / strip.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
	self._v = 1 - sy -- top is 1
	self:_updateUI()
end

-- Public API

-- Callbacks are set BEFORE Open; Close clears them, so a forgotten setter is a no-op.
-- outlivesSelection: the pick edits nothing of the selection (the theme editor). Any other pick
-- is closed by SelectionEditors when the selection changes.
-- options: { items (their colours fill "In this effect"), live (how many items show it live),
-- anchor (the row that opened it; the picker opens beside it), classicTitle }. Classic reads
-- only classicTitle.
function ColorPicker:Open(color, title, outlivesSelection, options)
	self._boundToSelection = not outlivesSelection
	self._originalColor = color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
	self._h, self._s, self._v = Color3.toHSV(self._originalColor)
	if self._view then
		self._view.open(title, options)
	else
		self._title.Text = options and options.classicTitle or title or "Select Color"
	end
	self._panel.Visible = true
	self:_updateUI()
end

-- Always fires onCancel: ColorGradientEditor reverts through it, so a close after Apply clears
-- that revert state first (ColorGradientEditor's _rawClose).
function ColorPicker:Close()
	self._panel.Visible = false
	if self._onCancel then self._onCancel() end
	self._onChanged, self._onOK, self._onCancel = nil, nil, nil
end

function ColorPicker:IsOpen() return self._panel.Visible end
-- PanelPersistence: a moved wheel picker keeps its place, else it opens beside its row.
-- Classic's body never places itself, so its place is always kept.
function ColorPicker:IsPlacedByHand() return self._view == nil or self._view.isPlacedByHand() end
function ColorPicker:SetPlacedByHand(placed) if self._view then self._view.setPlacedByHand(placed) end end
-- PanelPersistence: the wheel picker is resized by hand and keeps its width; Classic's is fixed.
function ColorPicker:ResizesByHand() return self._view ~= nil end
-- True while open for something of the selection (see Open).
function ColorPicker:IsBoundToSelection() return self._panel.Visible and self._boundToSelection end
function ColorPicker:GetPanel() return self._panel end
function ColorPicker:GetColor() return self:_getColor() end

function ColorPicker:SetOnColorChanged(fn) self._onChanged = fn end
function ColorPicker:SetOnOK(fn) self._onOK = fn end
function ColorPicker:SetOnCancel(fn) self._onCancel = fn end

function ColorPicker:RefreshTheme()
	-- The wheel picker is built from the plugin's panel pieces: the theme's walk repaints it.
	if self._view then return end
	local T = self._T

	self._panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	self._panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	local panelStroke = self._panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if panelStroke then panelStroke.Color = T.Border; panelStroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha end
	local panelCorner = self._panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if panelCorner then panelCorner.CornerRadius = T.BigCorner end

	self._title.TextColor3 = T.Gold; self._title.Font = T.Font
	self._closeBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; self._closeBtn.Font = T.Font

	local prevStroke = self._preview:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if prevStroke then prevStroke.Color = T.Border; prevStroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha end

	self._okBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; self._okBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	self._okBtn.TextColor3 = T.Green; self._okBtn.Font = T.Font
	local okStroke = self._okBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if okStroke then okStroke.Color = T.Border; okStroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha end
	self._cancelBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; self._cancelBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	self._cancelBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; self._cancelBtn.Font = T.Font
	local cancelStroke = self._cancelBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if cancelStroke then cancelStroke.Color = T.Border; cancelStroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha end

	self._hexIn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; self._hexIn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	self._hexIn.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; self._hexIn.Font = T.Font

	for _, desc in ipairs(self._panel:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("TextBox") and desc ~= self._hexIn then
			desc.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; desc.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			desc.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; desc.Font = T.Font
		elseif desc:IsA("TextLabel") and desc ~= self._title and desc ~= self._crosshair then
			desc.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; desc.Font = T.Font
		end
	end
	-- The lines above write the theme font; the mode's own text fonts and sizes go back on.
	TypeScale.reapply(self._panel)
end

function ColorPicker:Destroy()
	for _, c in ipairs(self._conns) do c:Disconnect() end
	self._conns = {}
	if self._view then
		self._view.destroy()
	elseif self._panel then
		self._panel:Destroy()
	end
end

return ColorPicker

	self._hexIn = Instance.new("TextBox"); self._hexIn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg

	self._hexIn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; self._hexIn.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	self._hexIn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); self._hexIn.Position = UDim2.new(0,30,0,0)

	local btnRow = Instance.new("Frame"); btnRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	btnRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,22); btnRow.LayoutOrder = 5; btnRow.Parent = panel
	local bl = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); bl.Padding = UDim.new(0,4); bl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	bl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; bl.Parent = btnRow

	local function makeBtn(name, text, color, lo)
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha; b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = color
		b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 10; b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-2,1,0); b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.LayoutOrder = lo; b.Parent = btnRow; addCorner(b, UDim.new(0,4)); addStroke(b, T)
		return b
	end
	self._okBtn = makeBtn("OK", "OK", T.Green, 0)
	self._cancelBtn = makeBtn("Cancel", "Cancel", T.DarkGold, 1)
end

--[[
	ColorPicker/Controls  -  the pieces under a colour wheel that the colour picker (ViewWheel) and the
	colour over life editor (ViewStops) share. Built from the plugin's panel pieces, so a theme dresses
	them and the layout (Relayout) moves them.
	  Controls.wasNow(parent, order, onRevert) -> piece: the colour opened with (a press reverts)
	    beside the colour now; piece:set(was, now)
	  Controls.hex(parent, order, onCommit, stacked) -> piece: the hex and Copy (a plugin cannot write
	    the clipboard, so Copy selects it); onCommit(color) on Enter or leaving; piece:set(color)
	  Controls.channels(parent, order, onCommit) -> piece: R G B fields that are sliders (a drag moves
	    the value, Shift a quarter as fast; a click types); piece:set(color), piece.slideTo(index, share)
	  Controls.swatches(parent, order, label, onPick, options) -> piece: a row of colour chips;
	    options.onAdd() adds a "+" chip, options.onRemove(color) on a right press; piece:set(colors, current)
	  Controls.liveLine(parent, order) -> piece: "Meshes › Color, live on 3 selected"; piece:set(title, options)
	  Controls.footer(parent, order, onCancel, onApply) -> { frame, status, cancel, apply }
	  Controls.note(parent, order, text) -> label: small wrapped secondary text
	  Controls.place(panel, screenGui, anchor): beside the opening row (left, else right), else centred
	    near the top; always inside the screen
	  Controls.watchPlaced(panel, handle, onPlaced): onPlaced() once a drag of `handle` moves the panel
	User colours carry `_noColorRemap`: the theme's recolouring never touches them.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local C = require(UIBuilder.Constants)
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(UIBuilder.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(UIBuilder.PanelSizes)
local ColorMath = require(UIBuilder.ThemeModes.ColorMath)
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local Controls = {}

-- How tall the was / now pair stands beyond a row.
local PAIR_EXTRA = 4
-- How much smaller than a row a colour chip is.
local CHIP_INSET = 11
local LETTER = 14
local BAR = 3
local SCRUB_FINE = 0.25
-- How far a press moves before it slides instead of typing, in screen pixels.
local DRAG_START = 3

local function userColor(frame)
	frame:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	return frame
end

-- Black or white, whichever reads on `color`.
local function inkFor(color)
	local light = color.R * 0.299 + color.G * 0.587 + color.B * 0.114
	return light > 0.55 and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

local function byteOf(value)
	return math.floor(value * 255 + 0.5)
end

function Controls.wasNow(parent, order, onRevert)
	local pair = Instance.new("Frame")
	pair.Name = "WasNow"
	pair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pair.ClipsDescendants = true
	pair.LayoutOrder = order
	W.lay(pair, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row + PAIR_EXTRA)
	end)
	pair.Parent = parent
	W.addCorner(pair)

	local was = userColor(Instance.new("TextButton"))
	was.Name = "Was"
	was.AutoButtonColor = false
	was.BorderSizePixel = 0
	was.Text = "Was"
	was.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	was.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	was.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 1)
	TypeScale.style(was, "Caption")
	was.Parent = pair
	W.addPadding(was, 7, 4, 4, 4)
	was.Activated:Connect(onRevert)

	local now = userColor(Instance.new("Frame"))
	now.Name = "Now"
	now.BorderSizePixel = 0
	now.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0)
	now.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.66, 1)
	now.Parent = pair

	local piece = { frame = pair }
	function piece:set(wasColor, nowColor)
		was.BackgroundColor3 = wasColor
		was.TextColor3 = inkFor(wasColor)
		now.BackgroundColor3 = nowColor
	end
	return piece
end

function Controls.hex(parent, order, onCommit, stacked)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, "HexRow", order)
	local copy
	if stacked then
		W.lay(row, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row * 2 + LAYOUT.RowGap)
		end)
		W.addListLayout(row, "RowGap")
		W.makeTextField(row, "Hex", "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		copy = W.makeActionButton(row, "Copy", "Copy", 2, "TextSecondary")
	else
		local list = W.addListLayout(row, "RowGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
		list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
		local _, field = W.makeTextField(row, "Hex", "", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		field.LayoutOrder = 1
		local fill = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
		fill.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
		fill.Parent = field
		copy = W.makeTextButton(row, "Copy", "Copy", 2, "TextSecondary")
	end
	local box = row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox", true)
	copy.Activated:Connect(function()
		box:CaptureFocus()
		box.SelectionStart = 1
		box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
	end)
	local shown = ""
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local color = ColorMath.fromHex((string.gsub(box.Text, "%s", "")))
		if color then
			onCommit(color)
		else
			box.Text = shown
		end
	end)

	local piece = { box = box }
	function piece:set(color)
		shown = ColorMath.toHex(color)
		if not box:IsFocused() then
			box.Text = shown
		end
	end
	return piece
end

function Controls.channels(parent, order, onCommit)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, "Channels", order)
	W.addListLayout(row, "RowGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	local current = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local cells = {}

	local function withChannel(color, index, value)
		local channels = { color.R, color.G, color.B }
		channels[index] = math.clamp(value, 0, 255) / 255
		return Color3.new(channels[1], channels[2], channels[3])
	end

	for index, letterText in ipairs({ "R", "G", "B" }) do
		local box, field = W.makeTextField(row, letterText, "0", Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
		field.LayoutOrder = index
		W.lay(field, "Size", function()
			return UDim2.new(1 / 3, -LAYOUT.RowGap * 2 / 3, 1, 0)
		end)
		W.layProps(box, function()
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad + LETTER, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2 + LETTER), 1, -BAR) }
		end)

		local letter = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		letter.Name = "Letter"
		letter.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		letter.Text = letterText
		W.layProps(letter, function()
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.FieldPad - 4, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, LETTER + 4, 1, -BAR) }
		end)
		TypeScale.style(letter, "Caption")
		W.paint(letter, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		letter.Parent = field

		local bar = userColor(Instance.new("Frame"))
		bar.Name = "Range"
		bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
		bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		W.layProps(bar, function()
			return { Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.Corner, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.Corner * 2, 0, BAR) }
		end)
		bar.Parent = field
		local ramp = Instance.new("UIGradient")
		ramp.Parent = bar
		local tick = userColor(Instance.new("Frame"))
		tick.Name = "Tick"
		tick.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		tick.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tick.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
		tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, BAR + 4)
		tick.Parent = bar
		local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		edge.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		edge.Transparency = 0.4
		edge.Parent = tick

		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local value = tonumber(box.Text)
			if value then
				onCommit(withChannel(current, index, value))
			else
				box.Text = tostring(byteOf(({ current.R, current.G, current.B })[index]))
			end
		end)

		-- A catcher over the field takes the press: a drag slides the value (Shift: a quarter of the
		-- travel); a release without a drag types into the box, and the catcher steps aside meanwhile.
		local catcher = Instance.new("TextButton")
		catcher.Name = "Slide"
		catcher.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		catcher.Text = ""
		catcher.AutoButtonColor = false
		catcher.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		catcher.ZIndex = box.ZIndex + 2
		catcher.Parent = field
		box.Focused:Connect(function()
			catcher.Visible = false
		end)
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			catcher.Visible = true
		end)

		local pressedAt = nil
		local sliding = false
		local last = nil
		catcher.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				pressedAt = input.Position.X
				last = input.Position.X
				sliding = false
			end
		end)
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not pressedAt or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				return
			end
			if not sliding and math.abs(input.Position.X - pressedAt) < DRAG_START then
				return
			end
			sliding = true
			local fine = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
			local width = math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
			local share
			if fine then
				share = ({ current.R, current.G, current.B })[index] + (input.Position.X - last) * SCRUB_FINE / width
			else
				share = (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width
			end
			last = input.Position.X
			onCommit(withChannel(current, index, math.clamp(share, 0, 1) * 255))
		end))
		table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or not pressedAt then
				return
			end
			local typed = not sliding
			pressedAt = nil
			sliding = false
			if typed then
				box:CaptureFocus()
				box.SelectionStart = 1
				box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
			end
		end))
		cells[index] = { box = box, ramp = ramp, tick = tick }
	end

	local piece = { frame = row }
	function piece.slideTo(index, share)
		onCommit(withChannel(current, index, math.clamp(share, 0, 1) * 255))
	end
	function piece:set(color)
		current = color
		local channels = { color.R, color.G, color.B }
		for index, cell in ipairs(cells) do
			if not cell.box:IsFocused() then
				cell.box.Text = tostring(byteOf(channels[index]))
			end
			cell.ramp.Color = ColorSequence.new(withChannel(color, index, 0), withChannel(color, index, 255))
			cell.tick.Position = UDim2.fromScale(channels[index], 1)
		end
	end
	return piece
end

function Controls.swatches(parent, order, labelText, onPick, options)
	options = options or {}
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, labelText:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Colors", order)
	-- Caption-sized, as the colour rows are a compact list beside their chips.
	TypeScale.style(W.makeRowLabel(row, labelText, PanelSizes.of("ColorLabel")), "Caption")
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Chips"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	W.layProps(holder, function()
		local left = PanelSizes.get().ColorLabel + LAYOUT.LabelGap
		return { Position = UDim2.new(0, left, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -left, 1, 0) }
	end)
	holder.ClipsDescendants = true
	holder.Parent = row
	local list = W.addListLayout(holder, 5, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

	local function chipSize()
		return UDim2.fromOffset(LAYOUT.Row - CHIP_INSET, LAYOUT.Row - CHIP_INSET)
	end
	local add = nil
	if options.onAdd then
		add = Instance.new("TextButton")
		add.Name = "Add"
		add.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		add.Text = "+"
		add.LayoutOrder = 1000
		W.lay(add, "Size", chipSize)
		TypeScale.style(add, "Glyph")
		W.paint(add, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		add.Parent = holder
		W.addCorner(add)
		W.addStroke(add)
		add.Activated:Connect(options.onAdd)
	end

	local chips = {}
	local shown = nil
	local function makeChip(color, index)
		local chip = userColor(Instance.new("TextButton"))
		chip.Name = "Chip"
		chip.Text = ""
		chip.AutoButtonColor = false
		chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
		chip.BackgroundColor3 = color
		chip.LayoutOrder = index
		W.lay(chip, "Size", chipSize)
		chip.Parent = holder
		W.addCorner(chip)
		Instance.new("UIStroke").Parent = chip
		chip.Activated:Connect(function()
			onPick(color)
		end)
		if options.onRemove then
			chip.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
				options.onRemove(color)
			end)
		end
		return chip
	end
	local piece = { frame = row }
	-- The chips are made again only when the colours change; a drag moves only the ring.
	function piece:set(colors, current)
		local hexes = {}
		for index, color in ipairs(colors) do
			hexes[index] = ColorMath.toHex(color)
		end
		local key = table.concat(hexes, " ")
		if key ~= shown then
			shown = key
			for _, chip in ipairs(chips) do
				chip:Destroy()
			end
			chips = {}
			for index, color in ipairs(colors) do
				chips[index] = makeChip(color, index)
			end
		end
		local currentHex = current and ColorMath.toHex(current)
		for index, chip in ipairs(chips) do
			local ring = chip:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			local isCurrent = hexes[index] == currentHex
			ring.Thickness = isCurrent and 2 or 1
			ring.Color = isCurrent and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			ring.Transparency = isCurrent and 0 or 0.6
		end
		row.Visible = #colors > 0 or add ~= nil
	end
	return piece
end

-- The type section a row sits in ("Meshes"): the outermost section frame around it (WidgetSections
-- names each "<name>Section", its header Header.Title). A panel's own title bar is not one.
local function sectionTitleOf(row)
	local title = nil
	local node = row
	while node do
		local header = string.sub(node.Name, -7) == "Section" and node:FindFirstChild("Header")
		local label = header and header:FindFirstChild("Title")
		if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title = label.Text
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return title
end

function Controls.liveLine(parent, order)
	local live = W.makeRowFrame(parent, "Live", order)
	W.lay(live, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Text + 6)
	end)
	local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
	dot.Name = "Dot"
	dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
	dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7)
	W.paint(dot, "BackgroundColor3", "Success")
	dot.Parent = live
	W.addCorner(dot, UDim.new(0.5, 0))
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "Text"
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	text.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	text.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
	text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(text, "Caption")
	W.paint(text, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	text.Parent = live

	local piece = { frame = live }
	function piece:set(title, options)
		local section = options.anchor and sectionTitleOf(options.anchor)
		local where = section and (section .. " › " .. title) or title
		live.Visible = options.live ~= nil and options.live > 0
		if live.Visible then
			text.Text = string.format("%s, live on %d selected", where, options.live)
		end
	end
	return piece
end

function Controls.footer(parent, order, onCancel, onApply)
	local row = W.makeRowFrame(parent, "Footer", order)
	W.addListLayout(row, "RowGap", Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal).VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
	local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	status.LayoutOrder = 1
	TypeScale.style(status, "Caption")

	status.Parent = row
	local fill = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")

function Controls.note(parent, order, text)
	local note = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	note.Name = "Note"
	note.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	note.Text = text
	note.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	note.TextWrapped = true
	note.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	note.LayoutOrder = order
	W.lay(note, "Size", function()
		return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Text + 4)
	end)
	TypeScale.style(note, "Caption")
	W.paint(note, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	note.Parent = parent
	return note
end

-- Between a panel and the row that opened it.
local BESIDE = 8

function Controls.place(panel, screenGui, anchor)
	local scale = W._getScale(panel)
	local screen = screenGui.AbsoluteSize / scale
	local size = panel.AbsoluteSize / scale
	local x, y
	if anchor and anchor.Parent then
		local at = anchor.AbsolutePosition / scale
		x = at.X - size.X - BESIDE
		if x < 4 then
			x = at.X + anchor.AbsoluteSize.X / scale + BESIDE
		end
		y = at.Y
	else
		x = (screen.X - size.X) / 2
		y = screen.Y * 0.25
	end
	x = math.clamp(x, 4, math.max(screen.X - size.X - 4, 4))
	y = math.clamp(y, 4, math.max(screen.Y - size.Y - 4, 4))
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
end

function Controls.watchPlaced(panel, handle, onPlaced)
	local pressed = false
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			pressed = true
		end
	end)
	table.insert(W.getUISConnections(), UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			pressed = false
		end
	end))
	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
		if pressed then
			onPlaced()
		end
	end)
end

return Controls

--[[
	ColorPicker/EffectColors  -  the colours already used around what a pick is for (the picker's
	"In this effect" row), so a colour is matched across emitters with one press.
	  EffectColors.of(items, limit) -> { Color3 }: every Color3 and ColorSequence setting of each item
	    and the part-icles beside it (its parent's configs), and a directly edited Trail's or Beam's
	    Color; unique by hex, in order found, at most `limit` (EffectColors.MOST). A parent that is the
	    Workspace or a service gives only the item's own colours.
	QueryDescendants finds the configs, so a big model costs one query, not a walk.
]]

local ColorMath = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.ThemeModes.ColorMath)

local EffectColors = {}
EffectColors.MOST = 10

local CONFIG = "PartIcleProperties"

local function collect(found, seen, value, limit)
	local function add(color)
		if #found >= limit then
			return
		end
		local hex = ColorMath.toHex(color)
		if not seen[hex] then
			seen[hex] = true
			table.insert(found, color)
		end
	end
	if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
		add(value)
	elseif typeof(value) == "ColorSequence" then
		for _, keypoint in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do
			add(keypoint.Value)
		end
	end
end

-- An item's own colours: its config's settings, or a Trail's / Beam's Color edited directly.
local function colorsOf(item, found, seen, limit)
	local config = item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG)
	if config then
		for _, value in pairs(config:GetAttributes()) do
			collect(found, seen, value, limit)
		end
	elseif item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
		collect(found, seen, item.Color, limit)
	end
end

-- The instance whose part-icles make an item's effect: its parent, unless that is the Workspace
-- or another service (its parent is the place).
local function effectOf(item)
	local parent = item.Parent
	if not parent or (parent.Parent and parent.Parent:IsA("DataModel")) then
		return nil
	end
	return parent
end

function EffectColors.of(items, limit)
	local found, seen = {}, {}
	local visited = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		if not visited[item] then
			visited[item] = true
			colorsOf(item, found, seen, limit)
		end
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local effect = effectOf(item)
		if effect and not visited[effect] then
			visited[effect] = true
			for _, config in ipairs(effect:QueryDescendants("Configuration")) do
				if #found >= limit then
					break
				end
				local owner = config.Parent
				if config.Name == CONFIG and owner and not visited[owner] then
					visited[owner] = true
					colorsOf(owner, found, seen, limit)
				end
			end
		end
		if #found >= limit then
			break
		end
	end
	return found
end

return EffectColors
