--[[
	ColorPicker/ViewWheel  -  the colour picker outside Classic: a title, a colour wheel with its
	darkness slider, was / now, hex, R G B, the effect's colours, recent and saved, Cancel and Apply.
	Built from the plugin's panel pieces, so a theme dresses it.
	  ViewWheel.build(picker) -> view, or nil where the wheel cannot be drawn (the picker then builds
	    Classic's body). The controls call the picker's _setColor / _setHSV / _apply / Close.
	  view.panel, view.channels (the R G B fields)
	  view.show(h, s, v, from)     every control for the colour; `from` ("wheel") is not set again
	  view.open(title, options)    options as ColorPicker:Open takes them
	  view.destroy()
	Recent and saved colours are hex strings in plugin settings, so they follow the user into every place.
]]

local Wheel = require(script.Parent.Wheel)
local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)
local ColorMath = require(UIBuilder.ThemeModes.ColorMath)
local PanelSizes = require(UIBuilder.PanelSizes)
local Controls = require(script.Parent.Controls)
local EffectColors = require(script.Parent.EffectColors)

local ViewWheel = {}

local RECENT_SETTING = "ColorPickerRecent"
local SAVED_SETTING = "ColorPickerSaved"
local MOST_RECENT = 10
local WHEEL_SHARE = 0.62
local MIN_WIDTH = 180
local MOST_SAVED = 12

-- A list of colours kept as hex strings in a plugin setting (in memory where there is none). The
-- setting is read once; this list writes it, so the copy held stays true.
local function storedList(settings, name)
	local held = nil
	local list = {}
	function list.get()
		if held then
			return held
		end
		local saved = {}
		if settings then
			local ok, value = pcall(function()
				return settings:GetSetting(name)
			end)
			if ok and type(value) == "table" then
				saved = value
			end
		end
		held = {}
		for _, hex in ipairs(saved) do
			local color = type(hex) == "string" and ColorMath.fromHex(hex)
			if color then
				table.insert(held, color)
			end
		end
		return held
	end
	function list.put(colors)
		local hexes = {}
		for _, color in ipairs(colors) do
			table.insert(hexes, ColorMath.toHex(color))
		end
		held = colors
		if settings then
			pcall(function()
				settings:SetSetting(name, hexes)
			end)
		end
	end
	-- `color` first, once, the list cut to `most`.
	function list.push(color, most)
		local hex = ColorMath.toHex(color)
		local colors = { color }
		for _, other in ipairs(list.get()) do
			if ColorMath.toHex(other) ~= hex and #colors < most then
				table.insert(colors, other)
			end
		end
		list.put(colors)
	end
	function list.remove(color)
		local hex = ColorMath.toHex(color)
		local colors = {}
		for _, other in ipairs(list.get()) do
			if ColorMath.toHex(other) ~= hex then
				table.insert(colors, other)
			end
		end
		list.put(colors)
	end
	return list
end

function ViewWheel.build(picker)
	local panel = W.makePanel(picker._screenGui, "ColorPicker", PanelSizes.of("ColorPicker"))
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.ZIndex = 12
	-- Its home for PanelPersistence's Reset Layout; every Open places it again until it is dragged.
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.25)
	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(panel, "Color", 0)
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
	-- Resized by its sides, as other panels are; the wheel scales with it (PanelPersistence keeps it).
	W.makeResizable(panel, MIN_WIDTH, 0, { widthOnly = true })
	bar.close.Activated:Connect(function()
		picker:Close()
	end)

	local live = Controls.liveLine(panel, 1)

	local wheel = Wheel.new(panel, function(room)
		return math.clamp(room * WHEEL_SHARE, 90, 400)
	end, function(h, s, v)
		picker:_setHSV(h, s, v, "wheel")
	end, true)
	if not wheel then
		panel:Destroy()
		return nil
	end
	wheel.frame.LayoutOrder = 2

	-- Three groups under the wheel: the numbers, the colour rows, the footer.
	W.makeGroupBreak(panel, 3)
	local wasNow = Controls.wasNow(panel, 4, function()
		picker:_setColor(picker._originalColor)
	end)
	local hex = Controls.hex(panel, 5, function(color)
		picker:_setColor(color)
	end)
	local channels = Controls.channels(panel, 6, function(color)
		picker:_setColor(color)
	end)
	W.makeGroupBreak(panel, 7)

	local recent = storedList(picker._settings, RECENT_SETTING)
	local saved = storedList(picker._settings, SAVED_SETTING)
	local effectColors = {}
	local function pick(color)
		picker:_setColor(color)
	end
	local effectRow = Controls.swatches(panel, 8, "In this effect", pick)
	local recentRow = Controls.swatches(panel, 9, "Recent", pick)
	local savedRow
	local function showLists(current)
		effectRow:set(effectColors, current)
		recentRow:set(recent.get(), current)
		savedRow:set(saved.get(), current)
	end
	savedRow = Controls.swatches(panel, 10, "Saved", pick, {
		onAdd = function()
			saved.push(picker:_getColor(), MOST_SAVED)
			showLists(picker:_getColor())
		end,
		onRemove = function(color)
			saved.remove(color)
			showLists(picker:_getColor())
		end,
	})

	W.makeGroupBreak(panel, 11)
	local footer = Controls.footer(panel, 12, function()
		picker:Close()
	end, function()
		recent.push(picker:_getColor(), MOST_RECENT)
		picker:_apply()
	end)
	-- No hint in the footer: at the compact width Cancel and Apply leave it no room.
	footer.status.Text = ""

	local view = { panel = panel, channels = channels }
	function view.destroy()
		wheel:destroy()
		panel:Destroy()
	end
	local placedByHand = false
	function view.setPlacedByHand(placed)
		placedByHand = placed
	end
	function view.isPlacedByHand()
		return placedByHand
	end
	Controls.watchPlaced(panel, bar.dragHandle, function()
		placedByHand = true
	end)

	function view.show(h, s, v, from)
		local color = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		if from ~= "wheel" then
			wheel:set(h, s, v)
		end
		wasNow:set(picker._originalColor, color)
		hex:set(color)
		channels:set(color)
		showLists(color)
	end

	-- Beside the row that opened it, unless the user has put it somewhere.
	function view.open(title, options)
		options = options or {}
		bar.title.Text = title or "Color"
		live:set(title or "Color", options)
		effectColors = options.items and EffectColors.of(options.items, EffectColors.MOST) or {}
		if not placedByHand then
			Controls.place(panel, picker._screenGui, options.anchor)
		end
	end
	return view
end

return ViewWheel

--[[
	ColorPicker/Wheel  -  a colour wheel and the darkness slider beside it, for the picker and the
	colour over life editor outside Classic (ViewWheel, ViewStops).
	  Wheel.new(parent, diameterOf, onChange, centred) -> wheel, or nil where it cannot be drawn
	    diameterOf(room): the diameter for the row's width, asked again whenever the row resizes
	    centred: wheel and slider sit in the middle of a row as wide as the parent
	    wheel.frame; wheel:set(h, s, v) without onChange; wheel:get() -> h, s, v; wheel:destroy()
	  Wheel.makeMarker(parent, width, height, round) -> frame: a marker that reads on any colour;
	    its BackgroundColor3 is the colour shown, its "Outline" the dark ring
	  onChange(h, s, v) runs at every drag step. Hue goes clockwise from red at the right, saturation
	  from white at the centre to full at the rim; the slider sets value and darkens the wheel with it.
	  Shift while dragging moves a quarter as far.
	The picture is drawn once into an EditableImage (Roblox gradients are linear only) and shared by
	every wheel; when one cannot be made, Wheel.new returns nil and the caller keeps its other picker.
]]

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local UIBuilder = script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder
local W = require(UIBuilder.Widgets)

local Wheel = {}
Wheel.__index = Wheel

-- The picture's side in pixels: sharp at the largest wheel the modes draw.
local RESOLUTION = 256
local SLIDER_WIDTH = 22
local GAP = 12
-- How far a Shift-drag moves for the pointer's travel.
local FINE = 0.25
local RING = 16
local THUMB_HEIGHT = 12

local picture = nil

-- Hue around, saturation outward, at full value; the rim anti-aliased over one pixel.
local function drawPicture()
	local made, image = pcall(function()
		return AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(RESOLUTION, RESOLUTION) })
	end)
	if not made or not image then
		return nil
	end
	local pixels = buffer.create(RESOLUTION * RESOLUTION * 4)
	local half = RESOLUTION / 2
	for y = 0, RESOLUTION - 1 do
		for x = 0, RESOLUTION - 1 do
			local dx = (x + 0.5 - half) / half
			local dy = (y + 0.5 - half) / half
			local radius = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
			local alpha = math.clamp((1 - radius) * half + 0.5, 0, 1)
			if alpha > 0 then
				local color = Color3.fromHSV((math.atan2(dy, dx) / (2 * math.pi)) % 1, math.min(radius, 1), 1)
				local index = (y * RESOLUTION + x) * 4
				buffer.writeu8(pixels, index, math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5))
				buffer.writeu8(pixels, index + 1, math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5))
				buffer.writeu8(pixels, index + 2, math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5))
				buffer.writeu8(pixels, index + 3, math.floor(alpha * 255 + 0.5))
			end
		end
	end
	local wrote = pcall(function()
		image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(RESOLUTION, RESOLUTION), pixels)
	end)
	if not wrote then
		image:Destroy()
		return nil
	end
	return image
end

local function circle(frame)
	W.addCorner(frame, UDim.new(0.5, 0))
	return frame
end

local makeMarker = W.makeMarker

Wheel.makeMarker = makeMarker

function Wheel.new(parent, diameterOf, onChange, centred)
	picture = picture or drawPicture()
	if not picture then
		return nil
	end
	local self = setmetatable({ _h = 0, _s = 0, _v = 1, _connections = {} }, Wheel)

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Wheel"
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	local holder = nil
	if centred then
		holder = Instance.new("Frame")
		holder.Name = "Wheel"
		holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		holder.Parent = parent
		frame.Name = "Body"
		frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0)
		frame.Parent = holder
	else
		frame.Parent = parent
	end
	self.frame = holder or frame

	local disc = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	disc.Name = "Disc"
	disc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	disc.ImageContent = Content.fromObject(picture)
	disc:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	disc.Parent = frame
	-- Darker as the value falls: black over the picture, as clear as the value is high.
	local shade = circle(Instance.new("Frame"))
	shade.Name = "Shade"
	shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	shade.BorderSizePixel = 0
	shade.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	shade.ZIndex = 2
	shade:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	shade.Parent = disc
	self._shade = shade
	self._ring = makeMarker(disc, RING, RING, true)

	local slider = Instance.new("Frame")
	slider.Name = "Darkness"
	slider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	slider.BorderSizePixel = 0
	slider:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	slider.Size = UDim2.new(0, SLIDER_WIDTH, 1, 0)
	slider.Parent = frame

	-- The diameter comes from the room the panel has, not from the layout's numbers, so it is
	-- written here whenever that room changes.
	local diameter = nil
	local row = holder or parent
	local function fit()
		local wanted = math.floor(diameterOf(row.AbsoluteSize.X / W._getScale(row)))
		if wanted == diameter then
			return
		end
		diameter = wanted
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wanted + GAP + SLIDER_WIDTH, wanted)
		if holder then
			holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, wanted)
		end
		disc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wanted, wanted)
		slider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(wanted + GAP, 0)
	end
	fit()
	table.insert(self._connections, row:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit))
	W.addCorner(slider)
	local ramp = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	ramp.Rotation = 90
	ramp.Parent = slider
	self._ramp = ramp
	self._thumb = makeMarker(slider, SLIDER_WIDTH + 8, THUMB_HEIGHT, false)

	-- Drags: absolute where the press lands, a quarter of the pointer's travel with Shift held.
	local dragging = nil
	local last = nil
	local function fine()
		return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
	end
	local function dragTo(position)
		if dragging == "disc" then
			local centre = disc.AbsolutePosition + disc.AbsoluteSize / 2
			local radius = disc.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
			local offset
			if fine() and last then
				local at = Vector2.new(math.cos(self._h * 2 * math.pi), math.sin(self._h * 2 * math.pi)) * self._s * radius
				offset = at + (position - last) * FINE
			else
				offset = position - centre
			end
			self._h = (math.atan2(offset.Y, offset.X) / (2 * math.pi)) % 1
			self._s = math.min(offset.Magnitude / math.max(radius, 1), 1)
		elseif dragging == "slider" then
			-- The thumb's centre travels the slider less half a thumb at each end.
			local half = THUMB_HEIGHT / 2 * W._getScale(slider)
			local travel = math.max(slider.AbsoluteSize.Y - half * 2, 1)
			if fine() and last then
				self._v = math.clamp(self._v - (position.Y - last.Y) * FINE / travel, 0, 1)
			else
				self._v = math.clamp(1 - (position.Y - slider.AbsolutePosition.Y - half) / travel, 0, 1)
			end
		end
		last = position
		self:_show()
		onChange(self._h, self._s, self._v)
	end
	local function begin(kind)
		return function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				dragging = kind
				last = nil
				dragTo(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
			end
		end
	end
	local discButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	discButton.Name = "DiscInput"
	discButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	discButton.Text = ""
	discButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	discButton.ZIndex = 5
	discButton.Parent = disc
	local sliderButton = discButton:Clone()
	sliderButton.Name = "DarknessInput"
	sliderButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 0)
	sliderButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-4, 0)
	sliderButton.Parent = slider
	table.insert(self._connections, discButton.InputBegan:Connect(begin("disc")))
	table.insert(self._connections, sliderButton.InputBegan:Connect(begin("slider")))
	table.insert(self._connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			dragTo(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
		end
	end))
	table.insert(self._connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = nil
		end
	end))
	self:_show()
	return self
end

-- The ring, the shade, the slider's ramp and its thumb for the colour held.
function Wheel:_show()
	local angle = self._h * 2 * math.pi
	local reach = self._s * 0.5
	self._ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.cos(angle) * reach, 0.5 + math.sin(angle) * reach)
	local color = Color3.fromHSV(self._h, self._s, self._v)
	self._ring.BackgroundColor3 = color
	self._shade.BackgroundTransparency = self._v
	self._ramp.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(self._h, self._s, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
	self._thumb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1 - self._v, (self._v - 0.5) * THUMB_HEIGHT)
	self._thumb.BackgroundColor3 = color
end

function Wheel:set(h, s, v)
	self._h, self._s, self._v = h, s, v
	self:_show()
end

function Wheel:get()
	return self._h, self._s, self._v
end

function Wheel:destroy()
	for _, connection in ipairs(self._connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._connections = {}
	self.frame:Destroy()
end

return Wheel

--[[
	EmitCode  -  the Emit Code tool: the script lines that emit what is selected, and their Run.
	  EmitCode.expression(instance, kept?) -> text?, shared: a Luau expression that gives `instance`
	    in the place as it stands (nil outside the place); shared lists the steps whose name several
	    siblings carry ({ holder, name, count }); kept keeps the counts between calls
	  EmitCode.outermost(items) -> items       the items no other item of the list holds
	  EmitCode.generate(items) -> text         the whole snippet
	  EmitCode.wire(ctx, UI, Connections, deps)   the panel; deps: Part, Utility, runtime (ModuleScript)
	A step is written by name only when that name gives this very child. A name that is also a member
	of the parent (Size, Name, PrimaryPart) goes through FindFirstChild; a child that is not the first
	of its name is taken by place: GetChildren()[2]. The snippet stays short, with what it emits at
	the top: the panel's box does not scroll.
]]

local EmitCode = {}

local KEYWORDS = {}
for word in string.gmatch("and break do else elseif end false for function if in local nil not or repeat return then true until while", "%a+") do
	KEYWORDS[word] = true
end

local ESCAPES = { ["\\"] = "\\\\", ['"'] = '\\"', ["\n"] = "\\n", ["\r"] = "\\r", ["\t"] = "\\t" }

local HEADER = table.concat({
	'local Part_Icles = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Part_Icles"))',
	"Part_Icles:Activate()",
	"",
}, "\n")

local EMPTY = "-- Select items to generate emit code"
-- A snippet names this many shared names; the rest are summed up in one line.
local MOST_SHARED_LINES = 4

local function isIdentifier(name)
	return string.match(name, "^[%a_][%w_]*$") ~= nil and not KEYWORDS[name]
end

-- A Luau string literal that holds `text` exactly.
local function quoted(text)
	local escaped = string.gsub(text, '[%c"\\]', function(character)
		return ESCAPES[character] or string.format("\\%03d", string.byte(character))
	end)
	return '"' .. escaped .. '"'
end

-- What indexing `parent` with `name` gives in a script: a member first, then a child.
local function indexed(parent, name)
	local found, value = pcall(function()
		return parent[name]
	end)
	if found then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

-- A holder's children: how many carry each name, and each child's place among them all.
local function census(holder, kept)
	local known = kept[holder]
	if known then
		return known
	end
	known = { count = {}, place = {} }
	for index, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
		local name = child.Name
		known.count[name] = (known.count[name] or 0) + 1
		known.place[child] = index
	end
	kept[holder] = known
	return known
end

-- The expression for a service, or nil for a child of the place that is not one. A service
-- keeps the short game.Name while that name gives it; a renamed one is asked for by its class.
local function serviceText(instance)
	if instance == workspace then
		return "workspace"
	end
	local found, service = pcall(game.FindService, game, instance.ClassName)
	if not found or service ~= instance then
		return nil
	end
	local name = instance.Name
	if isIdentifier(name) and indexed(game, name) == instance then
		return "game." .. name
	end
	return "game:GetService(" .. quoted(instance.ClassName) .. ")"
end

-- One step down from `holder` to `child`, the child at `place` among the holder's children.
local function step(holderText, holder, child, place)
	local name = child.Name
	if indexed(holder, name) == child then
		if isIdentifier(name) then
			return holderText .. "." .. name
		end
		return holderText .. "[" .. quoted(name) .. "]"
	end
	if holder:FindFirstChild(name) == child then
		return holderText .. ":FindFirstChild(" .. quoted(name) .. ")"
	end
	return string.format("%s:GetChildren()[%d]", holderText, place)
end

function EmitCode.expression(instance, kept)
	kept = kept or {}
	local chain = {}
	local current = instance
	while current and current ~= game do
		table.insert(chain, 1, current)
		current = current.Parent
	end
	if current ~= game then
		return nil, {}
	end
	local shared = {}
	local text = "game"
	local holder = game
	for index, child in ipairs(chain) do
		local service = index == 1 and serviceText(child) or nil
		if service then
			text = service
		else
			local known = census(holder, kept)
			local count = known.count[child.Name] or 1
			if count > 1 then
				table.insert(shared, { holder = text, name = child.Name, count = count })
			end
			text = step(text, holder, child, known.place[child] or 1)
		end
		holder = child
	end
	return text, shared
end

function EmitCode.outermost(items)
	local listed = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		listed[item] = true
	end
	local outer = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local held = false
		local parent = item.Parent
		while parent and parent ~= game do
			if listed[parent] then
				held = true
				break
			end
			parent = parent.Parent
		end
		if not held then
			table.insert(outer, item)
		end
	end
	return outer
end

local function sharedLines(shared)
	local lines = {}
	local seen = {}
	local left = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(shared) do
		local key = entry.holder .. "\0" .. entry.name
		if not seen[key] then
			seen[key] = true
			if #lines < MOST_SHARED_LINES then
				table.insert(lines, string.format("-- %s has %d children named %s.", entry.holder, entry.count, quoted(entry.name)))
			else
				left += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if #lines == 0 then
		return lines
	end
	if left > 0 then
		table.insert(lines, string.format("-- %d more names are shared in the same way.", left))
	end
	table.insert(lines, "-- Shared names are told apart by order here.")
	table.insert(lines, "-- A running game does not promise that order:")
	table.insert(lines, "-- give each a name of its own.")
	return lines
end

function EmitCode.generate(items)
	local kept = {}
	local expressions = {}
	local shared = {}
	local notes = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local text, itemShared = EmitCode.expression(item, kept)
		if text then
			table.insert(expressions, text)
			table.move(itemShared, 1, #itemShared, #shared + 1, shared)
		else
			table.insert(notes, string.format("-- %s is not in the place.", quoted(item.Name)))
		end
	end
	if #expressions == 0 then
		return EMPTY
	end

	local lines = { HEADER }
	if #expressions == 1 then
		table.insert(lines, "local VFX = " .. expressions[1])
		table.insert(lines, "Part_Icles:AbsoluteEmit(VFX)")
	else
		table.insert(lines, "local VFX = {")
		for _, text in ipairs(expressions) do
			table.insert(lines, "    " .. text .. ",")
		end
		table.insert(lines, "}")
		table.insert(lines, "for _, item in VFX do")
		table.insert(lines, "    Part_Icles:AbsoluteEmit(item)")
		table.insert(lines, "end")
	end
	-- Notes go last: the box shows the top of the snippet.
	for _, line in ipairs(sharedLines(shared)) do
		table.insert(notes, line)
	end
	if #notes > 0 then
		table.insert(lines, "")
		for _, line in ipairs(notes) do
			table.insert(lines, line)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- Mutates: the box's text, and on Run the place (it emits). Refreshed by the selection handler
-- (ctx._refreshEmitCode) and by the panel being shown.
function EmitCode.wire(ctx, UI, Connections, deps)
	local selection = ctx.Selection
	local Part = deps.Part
	-- What the box names now; Run emits exactly these.
	local named = {}

	local function refresh()
		if not UI.EmitCodePanel or not UI.EmitCodePanel.Visible then
			return
		end
		-- A selected RenderTemplate, config or other inner part of a part-icle stands for the part-icle.
		named = EmitCode.outermost(ctx.sel.redirectInternals(selection:Get()))
		UI.EmitCodeBox.Text = EmitCode.generate(named)
	end
	ctx._refreshEmitCode = refresh

	if UI.EmitCodeRun then
		Connections["EmitCodeRun"] = UI.EmitCodeRun.Activated:Connect(function()
			for _, item in ipairs(named) do
				if item:IsDescendantOf(game) then
					Part:AbsoluteEmit(item)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	if UI.EmitCodeCopy then
		Connections["EmitCodeCopy"] = UI.EmitCodeCopy.Activated:Connect(function()
			UI.EmitCodeBox.TextEditable = true
			UI.EmitCodeBox:CaptureFocus()
			UI.EmitCodeBox.SelectionStart = 1
			UI.EmitCodeBox.CursorPosition = #UI.EmitCodeBox.Text + 1
			UI.EmitCodeCopy.Text = "Selected!"
			task.delay(1.5, function()
				if UI.EmitCodeCopy then
					UI.EmitCodeCopy.Text = "Select All"
				end
				if UI.EmitCodeBox then
					UI.EmitCodeBox.TextEditable = false
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	if UI.EmitCodePanel then
		Connections["EmitCodeVis"] = UI.EmitCodePanel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if not UI.EmitCodePanel.Visible then
				return
			end
			-- The snippet runs against this plugin's runtime: the copy in ReplicatedStorage is
			-- replaced when it differs.
			deps.Utility.replaceRuntimeModule(deps.runtime, game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), true)
			refresh()
		end)
	end
end

return EmitCode

--[[
	ForceGizmo  -  draws the shape of every selected Force in the viewport so its reach can be seen:
	a Sphere's rings, a Cone's rim and sides, a Linear's box, a Vortex's cylinder, a hollow shape's
	Inner limit, and a short axis line. A travelling Force also gets its path and its end shape.
	  init(ctx) -> { refresh, cleanup }; cleanup is final, the next setup makes a new gizmo
	Lines are pooled LineHandleAdornments in an unsaved folder under the runtime's host. A lost folder
	is made again at the next refresh; one left behind is removed by Modules/Leftovers (FOLDER_NAME).
	The shape sits where a play starts (after Spawn offsets, on its Link), read as the runtime reads it
	(TypeRegistry, Part/Force/Path.sketch, Fields.orient), so the drawing cannot drift.
	Mutates: its own folder only. Refreshed by a selection change (SelectionHandler), a selected
	Force's attributes, Link or AccelTarget, and the Force, its link or its Attachment's part moving.
	A linked Model or Camera moving does not refresh it.
]]

local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.Part.VisualHost)
local Fields = require(script.Parent.Part.Force.Fields)
local Path = require(script.Parent.Part.Force.Path)

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForceGizmo"
local LINE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70)
local INNER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 70)
local PATH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)
local LINE_THICKNESS = 2
local LINE_TRANSPARENCY = 0.35
local RING_SEGMENTS = 32
local AXIS_LENGTH = 4
-- Frames a travelling Force's path is drawn through, and how far its ends must differ, in
-- studs or in degrees, before it counts as travelling.
local PATH_SAMPLES = 24
local MOVED_STUDS = 0.05
local TURNED_DEGREES = 1
-- The ObjectValues on a Force whose pick changes where it is.
local PICKED_VALUES = { "Link", "AccelTarget" }
-- More selected Forces than this are not drawn: the lines would hide the scene.
local MAX_FORCES = 8

return function(ctx)
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local readProp = ctx.util.readProp
	local Particle = ctx.Part

	local folder = nil
	local pool = {}
	local used = 0
	local connections = {}
	local refreshQueued = false
	-- Set by cleanup: a refresh queued before it (here or by SelectionHandler) draws nothing.
	local closed = false
	local gizmo = {}

	local function ensureFolder()
		if folder then
			return folder
		end
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		folder.Archivable = false
		folder.Parent = VisualHost.root()
		return folder
	end

	local function line(from, to, color)
		local length = (to - from).Magnitude
		if length < 0.001 then
			return
		end
		used += 1
		local adornment = pool[used]
		if not adornment then
			adornment = Instance.new("LineHandleAdornment")
			adornment.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
			adornment.Archivable = false
			adornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
			adornment.Thickness = LINE_THICKNESS
			adornment.Transparency = LINE_TRANSPARENCY
			adornment.Parent = ensureFolder()
			pool[used] = adornment
		end
		adornment.Color3 = color
		adornment.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to)
		adornment.Length = length
		adornment.Visible = true
	end

	-- A circle of `radius` around `centre` in the plane of the unit vectors `first` and `second`.
	local function ring(centre, first, second, radius, color)
		if radius <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local previous = centre + first * radius
		for step = 1, RING_SEGMENTS do
			local angle = step / RING_SEGMENTS * math.pi * 2
			local point = centre + (first * math.cos(angle) + second * math.sin(angle)) * radius
			line(previous, point, color)
			previous = point
		end
	end

	local function drawSphere(frame, range, inner)
		local origin = frame.Position
		ring(origin, frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, range, LINE_COLOR)
		ring(origin, frame.RightVector, frame.LookVector, range, LINE_COLOR)
		ring(origin, frame.UpVector, frame.LookVector, range, LINE_COLOR)
		ring(origin, frame.RightVector, frame.LookVector, inner, INNER_COLOR)
	end

	local function drawCone(frame, range, inner, angle)
		local origin = frame.Position
		local half = math.rad(math.clamp(angle, 0, 360)) / 2
		local rimCentre = origin + frame.LookVector * (range * math.cos(half))
		local rimRadius = range * math.sin(half)
		ring(rimCentre, frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, rimRadius, LINE_COLOR)
		for _, side in ipairs({ frame.RightVector, -frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, -frame.UpVector }) do
			line(origin, rimCentre + side * rimRadius, LINE_COLOR)
		end
		ring(origin + frame.LookVector * (inner * math.cos(half)), frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, inner * math.sin(half), INNER_COLOR)
	end

	local function drawLinear(frame, range, inner, width, height)
		local origin = frame.Position
		local function corner(forward, right, up)
			return origin + frame.LookVector * forward + frame.RightVector * (right * width / 2) + frame.UpVector * (up * height / 2)
		end
		for _, pair in ipairs({ { 1, 1 }, { 1, -1 }, { -1, 1 }, { -1, -1 } }) do
			line(corner(inner, pair[1], pair[2]), corner(range, pair[1], pair[2]), LINE_COLOR)
		end
		for _, forward in ipairs({ inner, range }) do
			line(corner(forward, 1, 1), corner(forward, 1, -1), LINE_COLOR)
			line(corner(forward, 1, -1), corner(forward, -1, -1), LINE_COLOR)
			line(corner(forward, -1, -1), corner(forward, -1, 1), LINE_COLOR)
			line(corner(forward, -1, 1), corner(forward, 1, 1), LINE_COLOR)
		end
	end

	-- The cylinder starts a little behind the Force, as far as it takes hold (Fields.VORTEX_UNDER).
	local function drawVortex(frame, range, inner, height)
		local origin = frame.Position
		local top = origin + frame.LookVector * height
		local base = origin - frame.LookVector * (height * Fields.VORTEX_UNDER)
		ring(origin, frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, range, LINE_COLOR)
		ring(base, frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, range, LINE_COLOR)
		ring(top, frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, range, LINE_COLOR)
		for _, side in ipairs({ frame.RightVector, -frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, -frame.UpVector }) do
			line(base + side * range, top + side * range, LINE_COLOR)
		end
		ring(origin, frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, inner, INNER_COLOR)
	end

	local function hostFrame(item)
		if item:IsA("Attachment") then
			return item.WorldCFrame
		end
		return item.CFrame
	end

	local function number(item, key)
		local value = readProp(TypeRegistry, item, key)
		if type(value) ~= "number" then
			return 0
		end
		return value
	end

	local function drawShape(item, hostCF)
		local face = readProp(TypeRegistry, item, "EmissionDirection")
		local faceName = "Front"
		if typeof(face) == "EnumItem" then
			faceName = face.Name
		end
		local frame = Fields.orient(hostCF, faceName)
		local shape = readProp(TypeRegistry, item, "Shape")
		local range = number(item, "Range")
		local inner = math.min(number(item, "Inner"), range)
		if shape == "Cone" then
			drawCone(frame, range, inner, number(item, "Angle"))
		elseif shape == "Linear" then
			drawLinear(frame, range, inner, number(item, "Width"), number(item, "Height"))
		elseif shape == "Vortex" then
			drawVortex(frame, range, inner, number(item, "Height"))
		else
			drawSphere(frame, range, inner)
		end
		if shape ~= "Sphere" then
			line(frame.Position, frame.Position + frame.LookVector * math.min(AXIS_LENGTH, math.max(range, 0.5)), INNER_COLOR)
		end
	end

	local function drawForce(item)
		local data = Particle:GetData(item)
		if not data then
			drawShape(item, hostFrame(item))
			return
		end
		local frames = Path.sketch(Particle, item, data, PATH_SAMPLES)
		local first = frames[1]
		local last = frames[#frames]
		drawShape(item, first)
		local _, turned = first:ToObjectSpace(last):ToAxisAngle()
		if (last.Position - first.Position).Magnitude < MOVED_STUDS and math.deg(turned) < TURNED_DEGREES then
			return
		end
		for index = 2, #frames do
			line(frames[index - 1].Position, frames[index].Position, PATH_COLOR)
		end
		drawShape(item, last)
	end

	local function disconnectAll()
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(connections)
	end

	local function refreshSoon()
		if refreshQueued then
			return
		end
		refreshQueued = true
		task.defer(function()
			refreshQueued = false
			gizmo.refresh()
		end)
	end

	-- A part, or an Attachment and the part it sits on, moving.
	local function watchMoves(instance)
		if not (instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Attachment")) then
			return
		end
		table.insert(connections, instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(refreshSoon))
		local parent = instance.Parent
		if instance:IsA("Attachment") and parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(connections, parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(refreshSoon))
		end
	end

	local function watch(item)
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if config then
			table.insert(connections, config.AttributeChanged:Connect(refreshSoon))
		end
		-- Link Mode, Link source and Link Axes are attributes of the item itself.
		table.insert(connections, item.AttributeChanged:Connect(refreshSoon))
		watchMoves(item)
		for _, name in ipairs(PICKED_VALUES) do
			local holder = item:FindFirstChild(name)
			if holder and holder:IsA("ObjectValue") then
				table.insert(connections, holder.Changed:Connect(refreshSoon))
				if holder.Value then
					watchMoves(holder.Value)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function gizmo.refresh()
		if closed then
			return
		end
		disconnectAll()
		-- A folder removed from outside took its lines with it: the pool holds dead ones.
		if folder and not folder.Parent then
			folder = nil
			pool = {}
		end
		used = 0
		local drawn = 0
		for _, item in ipairs(ctx.selectedForces or {}) do
			if drawn >= MAX_FORCES then
				break
			end
			if item.Parent then
				drawn += 1
				watch(item)
				drawForce(item)
			end
		end
		for index = used + 1, #pool do
			pool[index].Visible = false
		end
	end

	function gizmo.cleanup()
		closed = true
		disconnectAll()
		if folder then
			folder:Destroy()
			folder = nil
		end
		pool = {}
		used = 0
	end

	return gizmo
end

--[[
	ForgeConverter: converts a Forge VFX bundle (Start / End mesh pairs, Beams, ParticleEmitters,
	Shockwave, BezierParticle and LightningBolt Attachments, sounds, camera shakes ...) into its
	Part-Icles equivalent. The original is untouched: the bundle is cloned next to it as
	`<Name>_PartIcles` and each Forge node in the clone is rewritten in place, deepest first, so nested
	effects convert before their containers. The output carries _convertedByPartIcles
	(RESERVED_ATTRS.md), so it is not converted again.

	EmitOnFinish / EmitOnImpact folders become hidden _OnDeath_EmitTargets / _OnHit_EmitTargets Folders
	on the emitter, wired as EmitTarget on the matching event.

	Known limit: nested emitters inside a spin Model emit from where they stand and do not follow the
	spin; set each one's Link to the spin emitter by hand.

	API: require(script)(ctx) -> { convert = (sourceModel) -> (out or nil, report) }
	  ctx supplies Part and TypeRegistry.
	  report = { successCount, skippedCount, approxCount, warnings = { string },
	             mappedTypes = { [kind] = count, skipped = { [kind] = count } } }

	Sub-modules: Helpers, CurveSampling, EffectConverters, ShockwaveConverter (+ ShockwaveModules),
	BezierConverter, LightningConverter (+ LightningTimeline), MeshAppearance, SoundConverter,
	CameraShakeConverter.
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Helpers)
local EffectConverters = require(script.EffectConverters)
local BezierConverter = require(script.BezierConverter)

local _classify = Helpers.classify

-- Folders of effects fired on the source's death or impact. The main walk skips them; each
-- converter converts its own through fctx.walkForgeSubtree.
local _NESTED_EFFECT_FOLDERS = {
	EmitOnFinish = true,
	EmitOnImpact = true,
	EmitOnHit = true,
}

-- Every Forge node under root, deepest first, so nested effects convert before their containers.
local function _collectForgeNodes(root)
	local entries = {}
	local function _visit(node, depth)
		if _NESTED_EFFECT_FOLDERS[node.Name] and (node:IsA("Folder") or node:IsA("Model")) then
			return
		end
		local kind = _classify(node)
		if kind then
			entries[#entries + 1] = { node = node, kind = kind, depth = depth }
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do _visit(child, depth + 1) end
	end
	_visit(root, 0)
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.depth > b.depth end)
	return entries
end

return function(ctx)
	local converter = {}

	function converter.convert(sourceModel)
		local report = {
			successCount = 0,
			skippedCount = 0,
			approxCount = 0,
			warnings = {},
			mappedTypes = { skipped = {} },
		}

		if not sourceModel then
			report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = "Selection is nil; nothing to convert."
			return nil, report
		end

		-- The source is a previous run's output.
		if sourceModel:GetAttribute("_convertedByPartIcles") then
			report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
				"[warn] '%s' carries _convertedByPartIcles  -  appears to be a previous Convert run's output, not an original Forge bundle. Convert skipped. Remove the attribute manually if intentional.",
				sourceModel:GetFullName())
			return nil, report
		end

		-- `_2`, `_3` ... when the name is taken, so two sources (or a re-convert) never overwrite each other.
		local outName = sourceModel.Name .. "_PartIcles"
		local outParent = sourceModel.Parent or workspace
		if outParent:FindFirstChild(outName) then
			local suffix = 2
			while outParent:FindFirstChild(outName .. "_" .. suffix) do
				suffix = suffix + 1
			end
			outName = outName .. "_" .. suffix
		end

		-- Converters destroy an attachment source (an Attachment cannot host the emitter Part), so it is
		-- wrapped in a Model that survives as the output.
		local sourceKind = _classify(sourceModel)
		local needsWrapper = sourceKind == "bezier" or sourceKind == "shockwave_attachment"
			or sourceKind == "lightning" or sourceKind == "camera_shake"
		local out
		if needsWrapper then
			out = Instance.new("Model")
			out.Name = outName
			out:SetAttribute("_convertedByPartIcles", true)
			out.Parent = outParent
			local inner = sourceModel:Clone()
			-- The wrapped clone's parent is the Model, so the authored parent is kept in _OrigForgeParent for
			-- the shape and radius lookups (Bezier, Lightning and CameraShake converters).
			local origParent = sourceModel.Parent
			if origParent and (origParent:IsA("BasePart") or origParent:IsA("Attachment")) then
				local pv = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				pv.Name = "_OrigForgeParent"
				pv.Value = origParent
				pv.Parent = inner
			end
			inner.Parent = out
		else
			out = sourceModel:Clone()
			out.Name = outName
			out:SetAttribute("_convertedByPartIcles", true)
			out.Parent = outParent
		end

		local fctx = setmetatable({}, { __index = ctx })
		-- What is being converted: a beam's end inside it needs no copy of its part (convertBeam).
		fctx.convertRoot = out

		-- Converts a nested-effect folder into outFolder the same way: clone, then rewrite deepest first.
		-- Helpers.wireEmitTarget calls it.
		fctx.walkForgeSubtree = function(forgeFolder, outFolder)
			for _, child in ipairs(forgeFolder:GetChildren()) do
				local childClone = child:Clone()
				childClone.Parent = outFolder
			end
			for _, entry in ipairs(_collectForgeNodes(outFolder)) do
				if entry.node.Parent then
					EffectConverters.rewriteInPlace(fctx, entry.node, entry.kind, report)
				end
			end
		end

		for _, entry in ipairs(_collectForgeNodes(out)) do
			if entry.node.Parent then
				EffectConverters.rewriteInPlace(fctx, entry.node, entry.kind, report)
			end
		end

		-- No final stripAllForge: particle and trail leaves carry emit attributes without Transformed,
		-- which a sweep would remove. Decorations may keep inert Forge attributes.

		if report.successCount == 0 and report.approxCount == 0 and #out:GetChildren() == 0 then
			out:Destroy()
			return nil, report
		end

		return out, report
	end

	return converter
end

--[[
	BezierConverter: turns a Forge BezierParticle Attachment into a Part-Icles Part emitter.

	Source layout:
	  Attachment  BezierParticle tag; Duration, Speed_*, Easing_Curve, ShapeFace, MinInitRot, RotSpeed_*, EmitCount ...
	    Part      the visual (refObj)
	    Points    numbered anchor Attachments with optional T0 / T1 handles
	    End       optional Attachment that replaces the last anchor

	The Part is cloned at the attachment's WorldCFrame and transformed as a Part. The path is baked
	into PosOffsetX/Y/Z graphs in attachment-local space with Speed 0; FacePath adds RotSpeed graphs
	that turn the particle along the tangent. ShapeFace Inward and InAndOut become InvertMotion.
	EmitOnFinish / EmitOnImpact folders become emit targets on OnDeath / OnHit.

	API:
	  convert(ctx, sourceAttachment, report)   replaces the attachment with the emitter
	  buildPointsLocal(attachment, ignoreEnd)  control points in the attachment's local space, or nil
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Parent.Helpers)
local CurveSampling = require(script.Parent.CurveSampling)

local BezierConverter = {}

local SAMPLES = 16

-- Control points for CurveSampling.evalBezier3D, per segment {anchor, T0, next T1, next anchor},
-- in the attachment's local space so the curve moves with the output. An `End` child replaces the
-- last anchor (End/T1 its handle); `ignoreEnd` skips that (LightningConverter places End in world space).
local function _buildBezierPointsLocal(refAttachment, ignoreEnd)
	local root = refAttachment:FindFirstChild("Points")
	if not root or not root:IsA("Attachment") then return nil end
	local children = root:GetChildren()
	table.sort(children, function(a, b)
		local an, bn = tonumber(a.Name), tonumber(b.Name)
		if an and bn then return an < bn end
		return tostring(a.Name) < tostring(b.Name)
	end)
	local anchors = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(children) do
		if ch:IsA("Attachment") then anchors[#anchors + 1] = ch end
	end
	if #anchors < 2 then return nil end

	-- Handles add through their anchor's CFrame. WorldCFrame is not used: it folds in the parent
	-- part's rotation and distorts the stored graph values. Assumes Points.CFrame is identity.
	local function _toLocal(att)
		if att.Parent == root then
			return att.CFrame.Position
		end
		local anchor = att.Parent
		return anchor.CFrame * att.CFrame.Position
	end

	local endAtt = (not ignoreEnd) and refAttachment:FindFirstChild("End") or nil
	if endAtt and not endAtt:IsA("Attachment") then endAtt = nil end
	local endT1 = endAtt and endAtt:FindFirstChild("T1")
	if endT1 and not endT1:IsA("Attachment") then endT1 = nil end

	local pts = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(anchors) do
		local t0 = p:FindFirstChild("T0")
		local t1 = p:FindFirstChild("T1")
		if i == 1 then pts[#pts + 1] = _toLocal(p) end
		if i ~= 1 then
			pts[#pts + 1] = (t1 and t1:IsA("Attachment")) and _toLocal(t1) or _toLocal(p)
		end
		if i ~= 1 and i ~= #anchors then pts[#pts + 1] = _toLocal(p) end
		if i ~= #anchors then
			pts[#pts + 1] = (t0 and t0:IsA("Attachment")) and _toLocal(t0) or _toLocal(p)
		end
		if i == #anchors then pts[#pts + 1] = _toLocal(p) end
	end

	if endAtt and #pts >= 4 then
		pts[#pts] = _toLocal(endAtt)
		pts[#pts - 1] = (endT1 and _toLocal(endT1)) or _toLocal(endAtt)
	end
	return pts
end
BezierConverter.buildPointsLocal = _buildBezierPointsLocal

local _SHAPE_MAP = {
	Box = "Box",
	Cylinder = "Cylinder",
	Sphere = "Sphere",
	Disc = "Disc",
}

-- Writes the spawn shape, SpreadAngle and EmissionDirection. Forge spreads spawns over a shape only
-- when the attachment's parent is a BasePart; defaults match Forge's (Box, Volume, partial 1, Top).
local function _applyShape(TR, clone, sourceAttachment)
	-- init.luau wraps a directly selected attachment in a Model; _OrigForgeParent keeps the real parent.
	local origParentRef = sourceAttachment:FindFirstChild("_OrigForgeParent")
	local parent
	if origParentRef and origParentRef:IsA("ObjectValue") and origParentRef.Value then
		parent = origParentRef.Value
	else
		parent = sourceAttachment.Parent
	end
	-- Any BasePart parent, however small: a tiny sphere still gives each particle its own direction.
	local hasMeaningfulSize = parent and parent:IsA("BasePart")
	if hasMeaningfulSize then
		local shapeName = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Shape", "Box")
		local mapped = _SHAPE_MAP[shapeName] or "Box"
		local partial = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "ShapePartial", 1)
		if typeof(partial) ~= "number" then partial = 1 end
		partial = math.clamp(partial, 0, 1)
		local style = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "ShapeStyle", "Volume")
		-- ShapeInOut flips the spawn direction, which LookAtInitially folds into the spawn rotation.
		local face = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "ShapeFace", "Outward")
		local mappedFace = "Outward"
		if face == "Inward" then mappedFace = "Inward"
		elseif face == "InAndOut" then mappedFace = "InAndOut"
		end
		TR.write(clone, "UseShape", true)
		TR.write(clone, "Shape", mapped)
		TR.write(clone, "ShapePartial", partial)
		TR.write(clone, "ShapeInOut", mappedFace)
		-- Each particle takes its shape direction as spawn rotation, so DisplacementMode Local turns the
		-- baked path per particle; without it every particle traces the same path.
		TR.write(clone, "LookAtInitially", true)

		-- Hidden proxy of the parent: Forge spawns over the parent's Size, not the small visual.
		local proxy = Instance.new("Part")
		proxy.Name = "_ShapeExtents"
		proxy.Anchored = true
		proxy.CanCollide = false
		proxy.CanQuery = false
		proxy.CanTouch = false
		proxy.Transparency = 1
		proxy.Size = parent.Size
		proxy.CFrame = parent.CFrame
		proxy.Parent = clone
		local link = clone:FindFirstChild("ShapePart")
		if not link then
			link = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			link.Name = "ShapePart"
			link.Parent = clone
		end
		link.Value = proxy

		-- Forge's partial 1 is the full surface or full volume by style; Roblox's ShapePartial 1 is the
		-- surface only and 0 the full volume.
		if style == "Volume" then
			TR.write(clone, "ShapePartial", 0)
		else
			TR.write(clone, "ShapePartial", partial)
		end
	end
	local spread = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "SpreadAngle", Vector3.zero)
	if typeof(spread) == "Vector3" then
		TR.write(clone, "SpreadAngle", Vector2.new(spread.X, spread.Y))
	end
	local emDir = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "EmissionDirection", "Top")
	if typeof(emDir) == "string" then
		local ok, normalId = pcall(function() return Enum.NormalId[emDir] end)
		if ok and normalId then TR.write(clone, "EmissionDirection", normalId.Name) end
	end
end

-- FacePath: the path is baked into PosOffset graphs (20 samples, linear between them) and RotSpeed
-- graphs (OverLife) turn the LookVector along the tangent so trails follow it. Integrating Speed
-- along an Euler-interpolated direction drifts 20-30% off sharp curves; the chords stay within 10%.
local function _writeFacePathVelocityVectored(TR, clone, points, easingCurve, warpFn, teff, sourceAttachment)
	local SAMPLES = 20
	local positions, tangents = CurveSampling.sample3DBezier(points, SAMPLES, easingCurve, warpFn, false)
	local n = SAMPLES

	-- Deltas in attachment-local space; DisplacementMode Local turns them by the spawn rotation.
	local origin = positions[1]
	local posXKp = table.create(n)
	local posYKp = table.create(n)
	local posZKp = table.create(n)
	for i = 1, n do
		local t = (i - 1) / (n - 1)
		local delta = positions[i] - origin
		posXKp[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, delta.X)
		posYKp[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, delta.Y)
		posZKp[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, delta.Z)
	end
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetX", NumberSequence.new(posXKp))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetY", NumberSequence.new(posYKp))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetZ", NumberSequence.new(posZKp))

	-- Position comes from the PosOffset graphs alone.
	TR.write(clone, "Speed", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "VelocityVectored", false)
	TR.write(clone, "DirMode", "Local")
	TR.write(clone, "DisplacementMode", "Local")

	-- Tangent orientation per keypoint as YXZ Eulers; RotOrder Global composes ry * rx * rz back into it.
	local rxArr = table.create(n)
	local ryArr = table.create(n)
	local rzArr = table.create(n)
	for i = 1, n do
		local orient = CurveSampling.orientFromTangent_LookAt(tangents[i])
		local rx, ry, rz = orient:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		rxArr[i], ryArr[i], rzArr[i] = rx, ry, rz
	end
	CurveSampling.unwrapAngles(rxArr)
	CurveSampling.unwrapAngles(ryArr)
	CurveSampling.unwrapAngles(rzArr)

	-- Forge's tumble, rs*t + (re-rs)*t^2/2 scaled by teff, is added to the tangent angles.
	local minRot = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("MinInitRot") or Vector3.zero
	local maxRot = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("MaxInitRot") or Vector3.zero
	if typeof(minRot) ~= "Vector3" then minRot = Vector3.zero end
	if typeof(maxRot) ~= "Vector3" then maxRot = Vector3.zero end
	local function _sign(a, b)
		local m = (a + b) * 0.5
		return m > 0 and 1 or (m < 0 and -1 or 0)
	end
	local signX = _sign(minRot.X, maxRot.X)
	local signY = _sign(minRot.Y, maxRot.Y)
	local signZ = _sign(minRot.Z, maxRot.Z)
	local rsRange = Helpers.range(sourceAttachment, "RotSpeed_Start", 0, 0)
	local reRange = Helpers.range(sourceAttachment, "RotSpeed_End", 0, 0)
	local rsMid = (rsRange.Min + rsRange.Max) * 0.5
	local rsEnv = (rsRange.Max - rsRange.Min) * 0.5
	local reMid = (reRange.Min + reRange.Max) * 0.5
	local reEnv = (reRange.Max - reRange.Min) * 0.5
	local function _tumbleDeg(t, rs, re)
		return teff * (rs * t + (re - rs) * t * t / 2)
	end

	local rotXKp = table.create(n)
	local rotYKp = table.create(n)
	local rotZKp = table.create(n)
	for i = 1, n do
		local t = (i - 1) / (n - 1)
		local tumbleMid = _tumbleDeg(t, rsMid, reMid)
		local tumbleEnv = math.abs(_tumbleDeg(t, rsEnv, reEnv))
		local function _kp(tangentDeg, sign)
			return NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t,
				tangentDeg + sign * tumbleMid,
				sign ~= 0 and tumbleEnv or 0)
		end
		rotXKp[i] = _kp(math.deg(rxArr[i]), signX)
		rotYKp[i] = _kp(math.deg(ryArr[i]), signY)
		rotZKp[i] = _kp(math.deg(rzArr[i]), signZ)
	end
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedX", NumberSequence.new(rotXKp))
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedY", NumberSequence.new(rotYKp))
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedZ", NumberSequence.new(rotZKp))
	TR.write(clone, "RotMode", "OverLife")
	TR.write(clone, "RotOrder", "Global")

	-- MinInitRot / MaxInitRot become per-emit rotation ranges; SpreadAngle stays the native attribute.
	local function _writeRotAxis(axis, axisMin, axisMax)
		if axisMin ~= 0 or axisMax ~= 0 then
			TR.write(clone, "Rot" .. axis, NumberRange.new(axisMin, axisMax))
		end
	end
	_writeRotAxis("X", minRot.X, maxRot.X)
	_writeRotAxis("Y", minRot.Y, maxRot.Y)
	_writeRotAxis("Z", minRot.Z, maxRot.Z)
end

-- End override: Forge ends every path at End. One shared graph cannot converge per particle, so the
-- path is baked as (sample - start) + surfaceOffset * (1 - t) with random RotX/Y/Z: particles start
-- on a sphere of radius |surfaceOffset| and follow the bezier's shape inward.
local _EMISSION_AXIS = {
	Top = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Bottom = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
	Front = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), Back = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	Left = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Right = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
}
local function _writeConvergePath(TR, clone, sourceAttachment, points, easingCurve, warpFn, arcSpace, parent)
	-- Radius is half the parent's Size magnitude: one scalar, as one graph cannot follow Forge's
	-- per-axis ellipsoid.
	local hasBasePartParent = parent and parent:IsA("BasePart")
	local emDir = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "EmissionDirection", "Top")
	local surfaceDir = _EMISSION_AXIS[emDir] or _EMISSION_AXIS.Top
	local radius = 0
	if hasBasePartParent then
		radius = math.max(parent.Size.Magnitude * 0.5, 1)
	end
	local surfaceOffset = surfaceDir * radius

	local positions = CurveSampling.sample3DBezier(points, 16, easingCurve, warpFn, false)
	local n = #positions
	local startPos = positions[1]

	local posX = table.create(n)
	local posY = table.create(n)
	local posZ = table.create(n)
	for i = 1, n do
		local t = (i - 1) / (n - 1)
		local bezierDelta = positions[i] - startPos
		local surfaceComponent = surfaceOffset * (1 - t)
		local total = bezierDelta + surfaceComponent
		posX[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, total.X)
		posY[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, total.Y)
		posZ[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, total.Z)
	end
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetX", NumberSequence.new(posX))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetY", NumberSequence.new(posY))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetZ", NumberSequence.new(posZ))

	-- Without a BasePart parent Forge spawns at a point, so every particle traces the same path.
	if hasBasePartParent then
		TR.write(clone, "RotX", NumberRange.new(-180, 180))
		TR.write(clone, "RotY", NumberRange.new(-180, 180))
		TR.write(clone, "RotZ", NumberRange.new(-180, 180))
	end

	TR.write(clone, "DirMode", "Local")
	TR.write(clone, "DisplacementMode", "Local")
	TR.write(clone, "Speed", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "VelocityVectored", false)
end

-- FacePath off, no End: PosOffset graphs, initial rotation and optional tumble.
local function _writeNonFacePathPosOffset(TR, clone, points, easingCurve, warpFn, arcSpace, sourceAttachment)
	local SAMPLES = 16
	-- Parametric t, as Forge's runtime samples it.
	local positions = CurveSampling.sample3DBezier(points, SAMPLES, easingCurve, warpFn, false)
	local origin = positions[1]
	-- Attachment-local deltas with DisplacementMode Local, so the path turns with the emitter. World
	-- deltas would shrink the graph values and stay fixed when the output is rotated.
	local posXKp = table.create(SAMPLES)
	local posYKp = table.create(SAMPLES)
	local posZKp = table.create(SAMPLES)
	for i = 1, SAMPLES do
		local t = (i - 1) / (SAMPLES - 1)
		local delta = positions[i] - origin
		posXKp[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, delta.X)
		posYKp[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, delta.Y)
		posZKp[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, delta.Z)
	end
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetX", NumberSequence.new(posXKp))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetY", NumberSequence.new(posYKp))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetZ", NumberSequence.new(posZKp))
	TR.write(clone, "DirMode", "Local")
	TR.write(clone, "DisplacementMode", "Local")
	TR.write(clone, "Speed", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "VelocityVectored", false)

	-- Initial rotation only: Speed is 0, so SpreadAngle does not move the particle.
	local minRot = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("MinInitRot") or Vector3.zero
	local maxRot = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("MaxInitRot") or Vector3.zero
	if typeof(minRot) ~= "Vector3" then minRot = Vector3.zero end
	if typeof(maxRot) ~= "Vector3" then maxRot = Vector3.zero end
	if minRot.X ~= 0 or maxRot.X ~= 0 then TR.write(clone, "RotX", NumberRange.new(minRot.X, maxRot.X)) end
	if minRot.Y ~= 0 or maxRot.Y ~= 0 then TR.write(clone, "RotY", NumberRange.new(minRot.Y, maxRot.Y)) end
	if minRot.Z ~= 0 or maxRot.Z ~= 0 then TR.write(clone, "RotZ", NumberRange.new(minRot.Z, maxRot.Z)) end

	local rsRange = Helpers.range(sourceAttachment, "RotSpeed_Start", 0, 0)
	local reRange = Helpers.range(sourceAttachment, "RotSpeed_End", 0, 0)
	if rsRange.Max ~= 0 or reRange.Max ~= 0 then
		TR.write(clone, "RotMode", "Speed")
		local rsMid, rsEnv = (rsRange.Min + rsRange.Max) * 0.5, (rsRange.Max - rsRange.Min) * 0.5
		local reMid, reEnv = (reRange.Min + reRange.Max) * 0.5, (reRange.Max - reRange.Min) * 0.5
		local seq = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, rsMid, rsEnv),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, reMid, reEnv),
		})
		TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedX", seq)
		TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedY", seq)
		TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedZ", seq)
	end
end

-- Replaces the Attachment, which cannot host an emitter Part, with a transformed clone of its Part.
function BezierConverter.convert(ctx, sourceAttachment, report)
	if not sourceAttachment:IsA("Attachment") then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = "Bezier source '" .. sourceAttachment:GetFullName() .. "' is not an Attachment; skipped."
		report.skippedCount += 1
		return
	end

	local refPart = sourceAttachment:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
	if not refPart then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = "Bezier '" .. sourceAttachment.Name .. "' has no Part child (refObj); skipped."
		report.skippedCount += 1
		return
	end

	local container = sourceAttachment.Parent or workspace

	local points = _buildBezierPointsLocal(sourceAttachment)
	if not points or #points < 4 then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = "Bezier '" .. sourceAttachment.Name .. "' has insufficient Points (need >= 2 anchors); skipped."
		report.skippedCount += 1
		return
	end

	-- Effect children are detached before Transform (its RenderTemplate strip would destroy them) and
	-- put back inside the RenderTemplate after.
	local clone = refPart:Clone()
	clone.Name = sourceAttachment.Name
	clone.Anchored = true
	clone.CanCollide = false
	clone.CanQuery = false
	clone.CanTouch = false
	-- Bezier-local points then map directly to spawn-local PosOffset values.
	clone.CFrame = sourceAttachment.WorldCFrame

	local survivors = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Trail")
			or child:IsA("Sound") or child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model")
			or child:IsA("Light") or child:IsA("Highlight")
			or child:IsA("Attachment") or child:IsA("Beam") then
			survivors[#survivors + 1] = child
			child.Parent = nil
		end
	end

	-- Stale Part-Icles markers would make Transform skip the clone.
	Helpers.clearPartIclesMarkers(clone)
	-- The maths reads the untouched source, so the clone drops every Forge attribute and tag.
	Helpers.stripAllForge(clone)
	clone.Parent = container

	local ok, err = pcall(function() ctx.Part:Transform(clone) end)
	if not ok then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format("Transform errored on bezier '%s': %s", sourceAttachment.Name, tostring(err))
		report.skippedCount += 1
		clone:Destroy()
		return
	end
	local rt = clone:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if rt then
		for _, p in ipairs(survivors) do
			-- Keeps the nested-emit attributes, as EffectConverters.convertMesh does.
			Helpers.stripPreservingNestedEmit(p)
			p.Parent = rt
		end
	end

	-- Drop children a Part-Icles Part does not use (same list as convertMesh). EmitOnFinish /
	-- EmitOnImpact live on the source attachment and are converted below.
	local _KEEP = {
		PartIcleProperties = true, RenderTemplate = true,
		EmitParent = true, Link = true, AccelTarget = true, Dir = true, ShapePart = true,
		MeshFlipbooks = true, MeshFrames = true, BeamFlipbooks = true, ImageFlipbooks = true, GraphBlender = true,
	}
	for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
		if not _KEEP[child.Name] then child:Destroy() end
	end

	-- Speed_Curve warps the sampling and sets the effective lifetime.
	local duration = Helpers.range(sourceAttachment, "Duration", 1, 1)
	local meanDuration = (duration.Min + duration.Max) * 0.5
	if meanDuration <= 0 then meanDuration = 1 end
	local speedStart = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Speed_Start", 1)
	local speedEnd = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Speed_End", 1)
	local speedCurve = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("Speed_Curve")
	local speedDuration = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Speed_Duration", 0.1)
	local warpFn, teff = CurveSampling.buildSpeedWarp(speedStart, speedEnd, speedCurve, speedDuration, meanDuration)

	local easingCurve = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("Easing_Curve")
	local arcSpace = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "ArcSpace", false)

	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	TR.write(clone, "Lifetime", NumberRange.new(teff, teff))

	local endAtt = sourceAttachment:FindFirstChild("End")
	if endAtt and not endAtt:IsA("Attachment") then endAtt = nil end
	local hasEndOverride = endAtt ~= nil

	-- FacePath: baked path plus tangent rotation. Otherwise the converge path when End exists, else the baked path.
	local facePath = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "FacePath", false)
	if facePath then
		_writeFacePathVelocityVectored(TR, clone, points, easingCurve, warpFn, teff, sourceAttachment)
		if hasEndOverride then
			report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
				"Bezier '%s'  -  FacePath=true with End override: per-particle convergence not reproducible via shared baseDir graph; particles follow shared path, not End-pinned trajectories.",
				sourceAttachment.Name)
		end
	elseif hasEndOverride then
		-- The real parent, as in _applyShape.
		local origParentRef = sourceAttachment:FindFirstChild("_OrigForgeParent")
		local resolvedParent = sourceAttachment.Parent
		if origParentRef and origParentRef:IsA("ObjectValue") and origParentRef.Value then
			resolvedParent = origParentRef.Value
		end
		_writeConvergePath(TR, clone, sourceAttachment, points, easingCurve, warpFn, arcSpace, resolvedParent)
	else
		_writeNonFacePathPosOffset(TR, clone, points, easingCurve, warpFn, arcSpace, sourceAttachment)
	end

	-- The converge path spreads its own spawns, so it skips the shape.
	if not hasEndOverride then
		_applyShape(TR, clone, sourceAttachment)
	end
	if facePath then
		TR.write(clone, "EmissionDirection", "Front")
	end

	-- Inward plays the path backward; InAndOut keeps only the inward half.
	local face = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "ShapeFace", "Outward")
	local mirrorPaths = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "MirrorPaths", true) == true
	if face == "Inward" or face == "InAndOut" then
		TR.write(clone, "InvertMotion", true)
		if face == "InAndOut" then
			report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
				"Bezier '%s'  -  ShapeFace=InAndOut collapsed to Inward only (single-emitter limit).",
				sourceAttachment.Name)
		end
	end

	local rate = sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("Rate")
	if typeof(rate) == "number" and rate > 0 then
		TR.write(clone, "Rate", rate)
	end

	-- Forge's duration mode emits by rate only, so EmitDuration > 0 drops the EmitCount burst.
	local emitCount = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "EmitCount", 1)
	local emitDuration = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "EmitDuration", 0)
	if emitDuration > 0 then emitCount = 0 end
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitCount", emitCount)
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "EmitDelay", 0))
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", emitDuration)

	-- Forge DestroyDelay (linger after the last particle) maps to PartLife.
	local destroyDelay = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "DestroyDelay", 0)
	if typeof(destroyDelay) == "number" and destroyDelay > 0 then
		TR.write(clone, "PartLife", destroyDelay)
	end

	-- EmitOnFinish fires at the path's end (OnDeath), EmitOnImpact on collision (OnHit).
	local bezierLabel = "Bezier '" .. sourceAttachment.Name .. "'"
	Helpers.wireEmitTarget(ctx, clone, sourceAttachment, report, "EmitOnFinish", "OnDeath", "_OnDeath_EmitTargets", bezierLabel)
	Helpers.wireEmitTarget(ctx, clone, sourceAttachment, report, "EmitOnImpact", "OnHit", "_OnHit_EmitTargets", bezierLabel)

	-- Forge mirrors only with an End, for about half the particles; RotZ from 0 to the mirror angle
	-- spreads between the two.
	if mirrorPaths and hasEndOverride then
		local mirrorRot = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "MirrorRotation", Vector3.new(0, 0, 180))
		if typeof(mirrorRot) ~= "Vector3" then mirrorRot = Vector3.new(0, 0, 180) end
		if math.abs(mirrorRot.Z) > 1e-3 then TR.write(clone, "RotZ", NumberRange.new(0, mirrorRot.Z)) end
	end

	report.successCount += 1
	report.mappedTypes.bezier = (report.mappedTypes.bezier or 0) + 1

	if sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("ProjectileEnabled") then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Bezier '%s'  -  ProjectileEnabled (post-path straight-line continuation) not converted; particle stops at path end.",
			sourceAttachment.Name)
	end
	if sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("HitboxEnabled") then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Bezier '%s'  -  HitboxEnabled (shapecast collision) not converted.",
			sourceAttachment.Name)
	end
	if sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("SyncPosition") == true then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Bezier '%s'  -  SyncPosition (per-frame caster-follow) not auto-Linked; set Link manually if caster needs to drag the path.",
			sourceAttachment.Name)
	end

	sourceAttachment:Destroy()
end

return BezierConverter

--[[
	CameraShakeConverter: replaces a Forge camera shake (a RayValue tagged "CameraShake") with a
	Part-Icles CameraShake emitter, an invisible Part at the shake's origin.

	Forge's shake:
	  offset   = noise / 2 x Amplitude x envelope, noise advancing at 1 / Frequency per second
	  position = PositionInfluence x offset (studs), rotation = RotationInfluence x offset (radians)
	  envelope = linear fade in, hold (SustainTime, or EmitDuration when set), linear fade out
	  falloff  = 1 - distance / Falloff from the nearest Attachment / BasePart ancestor
	Part-Icles multiplies its noise by the amplitude graph directly, so amplitudes are halved; it has
	one amplitude for all axes, so an uneven influence vector uses its largest component.

	API: convert(ctx, shake, report)
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Parent.Helpers)

local CameraShakeConverter = {}

local function addWarning(report, shake, message)
	report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format("Camera shake '%s': %s", shake.Name, message)
end

local function largestComponent(value, fallback)
	if typeof(value) ~= "Vector3" then return fallback end
	return math.max(math.abs(value.X), math.abs(value.Y), math.abs(value.Z))
end

local function isUneven(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
	return math.abs(value.X - value.Y) > 1e-3 or math.abs(value.Y - value.Z) > 1e-3
end

-- World position Forge measures the falloff from, or nil for a shake with no positioned ancestor.
local function originOf(shake)
	local anchor = shake:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Attachment") or shake:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
	local sidecar = shake:FindFirstChild("_OrigForgeParent")
	if sidecar and sidecar:IsA("ObjectValue") and sidecar.Value then anchor = sidecar.Value end
	if not anchor then return nil end
	if anchor:IsA("Attachment") then return anchor.WorldPosition end
	if anchor:IsA("BasePart") then return anchor.Position end
	return nil
end

-- 0 -> peak over the fade in, held, then back to 0 over the fade out.
local function envelope(peak, fadeIn, fadeOut, total)
	local keypoints = { NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, fadeIn > 0 and 0 or peak) }
	local riseEnd = fadeIn / total
	local fallStart = 1 - fadeOut / total
	if riseEnd > 0 and riseEnd < 1 then
		table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(riseEnd, peak))
	end
	if fallStart > riseEnd and fallStart < 1 then
		table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(fallStart, peak))
	end
	table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, fadeOut > 0 and 0 or peak))
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

function CameraShakeConverter.convert(ctx, shake, report)
	local amplitude = Helpers.attr(shake, "Amplitude", 2.5)
	local frequency = Helpers.attr(shake, "Frequency", 0.2)
	local fadeIn = math.max(Helpers.attr(shake, "FadeInTime", 0.3), 0)
	local fadeOut = math.max(Helpers.attr(shake, "FadeOutTime", 2), 0)
	local emitDuration = Helpers.attr(shake, "EmitDuration", 0)
	-- A sustained shake holds until EmitDuration ends, then fades out.
	local hold = emitDuration > 0 and math.max(emitDuration - fadeIn, 0) or math.max(Helpers.attr(shake, "SustainTime", 1), 0)
	local total = math.max(fadeIn + hold + fadeOut, 0.001)
	local positionInfluence = shake:GetAttribute("PositionInfluence")
	local rotationInfluence = shake:GetAttribute("RotationInfluence")
	local falloff = Helpers.attr(shake, "Falloff", 30)
	local emitDelay = Helpers.attr(shake, "EmitDelay", 0)
	local speedStart = Helpers.attr(shake, "Speed_Start", 1)
	local speedEnd = Helpers.attr(shake, "Speed_End", 1)
	local origin = originOf(shake)

	local emitter = Instance.new("Part")
	emitter.Name = shake.Name
	emitter.Size = Vector3.one
	emitter.Anchored = true
	emitter.CanCollide = false
	emitter.CanQuery = false
	emitter.CanTouch = false
	emitter.Transparency = 1
	emitter.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin or Vector3.zero)
	emitter:SetAttribute("IsCameraShake", true)
	emitter.Parent = shake.Parent or workspace

	local ok, err = pcall(function() ctx.Part:Transform(emitter) end)
	if not ok or not emitter:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		emitter:Destroy()
		addWarning(report, shake, "Transform failed (" .. tostring(err) .. "); skipped.")
		report.skippedCount += 1
		shake:Destroy()
		return
	end

	local positionPeak = amplitude * largestComponent(positionInfluence, 1) / 2
	local rotationPeak = math.deg(amplitude * largestComponent(rotationInfluence, 0.2) / 2)
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	TR.write(emitter, "Lifetime", NumberRange.new(total))
	TR.write(emitter, "ShakeAmplitude", envelope(positionPeak, fadeIn, fadeOut, total))
	TR.write(emitter, "ShakeRotAmplitude", envelope(rotationPeak, fadeIn, fadeOut, total))
	TR.write(emitter, "ShakeFrequency", NumberSequence.new(frequency > 0 and 1 / frequency or 0))
	-- No positioned ancestor means Forge applies no falloff: 0 is "global" here.
	TR.write(emitter, "ShakeFalloff", origin and math.max(falloff, 0) or 0)
	emitter:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1)
	emitter:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", emitDelay)
	emitter:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)

	if isUneven(positionInfluence) or isUneven(rotationInfluence) then
		addWarning(report, shake, "per-axis PositionInfluence / RotationInfluence converted to one strength for all axes (the largest).")
	end
	if speedStart ~= 1 or speedEnd ~= 1 then
		addWarning(report, shake, "Speed_Start / Speed_End time scaling is not converted.")
	end

	shake:Destroy()
	report.successCount += 1
	report.mappedTypes.camera_shake = (report.mappedTypes.camera_shake or 0) + 1
end

return CameraShakeConverter
