--[[
	LightningTimeline: bakes the life of one Forge lightning bolt into Part-Icles graphs. Forge runs
	three phases:
	  travel       Duration seconds: the head sweeps the path, Width and Transparency tween,
	               the fade-in plays.
	  hold         DestroyDelay seconds at full length (none in projectile mode).
	  dissipation  Dissipate_Duration seconds (Retract / Scale), or Fade_Out_Duration when the
	               mode is None and a fade-out is set.
	A Part-Icles graph spans the whole life, so its time axis is seconds / total.

	API: read(sourceAttachment) -> phase lengths; thickness(t), transparency(t), color(t, fallback) -> graphs
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Parent.Helpers)
local CurveSampling = require(script.Parent.CurveSampling)

local Timeline = {}

-- NumberSequence allows 20 keypoints: the phase samples plus the closing keypoint.
local MAX_PHASE_SAMPLES = 19
local COLOR_SAMPLES = 12

local function lerp(from, to, alpha)
	return from + (to - from) * alpha
end

function Timeline.read(sourceAttachment)
	local durationRange = Helpers.range(sourceAttachment, "Duration", 1, 1)
	local duration = math.max((durationRange.Min + durationRange.Max) / 2, 0.001)
	local hold = 0
	if sourceAttachment:GetAttribute("ProjectileEnabled") ~= true then
		hold = math.max(Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "DestroyDelay", 0), 0)
	end

	local mode = Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Dissipate_Mode", "None")
	local fadeOutDuration = math.max(Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Fade_Out_Duration", 0), 0)
	local dissipate = 0
	if mode ~= "None" then
		dissipate = math.max(Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Dissipate_Duration", 0.5), 0)
	elseif fadeOutDuration > 0 then
		dissipate = fadeOutDuration
	end

	local extra = hold + dissipate
	return {
		source = sourceAttachment,
		duration = duration,
		dissipate = dissipate,
		dissipateStart = duration + hold,
		total = duration + extra,
		lifetime = NumberRange.new(math.max(durationRange.Min + extra, 0.001), math.max(durationRange.Max + extra, 0.001)),
		mode = mode,
		fadeInDuration = math.max(Helpers.attr(sourceAttachment, "Fade_In_Duration", 0), 0),
		fadeOutDuration = fadeOutDuration,
		-- Part-Icles bolts have no moving tail, so a Retract with no fade-out fades instead.
		retractAsFade = mode == "Retract" and fadeOutDuration <= 0 and dissipate > 0,
	}
end

-- Phase boundaries in seconds, ascending, ending at the total life.
local function phaseEnds(timeline)
	local ends = {}
	if timeline.fadeInDuration > 0 and timeline.fadeInDuration < timeline.duration then
		table.insert(ends, timeline.fadeInDuration)
	end
	table.insert(ends, timeline.duration)
	if timeline.dissipateStart > timeline.duration then
		table.insert(ends, timeline.dissipateStart)
	end
	if timeline.total > timeline.dissipateStart then
		table.insert(ends, timeline.total)
	end
	return ends
end

-- Samples valueAt(seconds) across every phase so each keeps its own curve shape.
local function sampleLife(timeline, valueAt)
	local ends = phaseEnds(timeline)
	local perPhase = math.max(2, math.floor(MAX_PHASE_SAMPLES / #ends))
	local keypoints = {}
	local phaseStart = 0
	for _, phaseEnd in ipairs(ends) do
		for step = 0, perPhase - 1 do
			local seconds = phaseStart + (phaseEnd - phaseStart) * step / perPhase
			table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(seconds / timeline.total, valueAt(seconds)))
		end
		phaseStart = phaseEnd
	end
	table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, valueAt(timeline.total)))
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

-- Width_Start -> Width_End over the travel phase; the Scale dissipation shrinks it to zero.
function Timeline.thickness(timeline)
	local source = timeline.source
	local widthStart = Helpers.attr(source, "Width_Start", 2)
	local widthEnd = Helpers.attr(source, "Width_End", 0.2)
	local widthCurve = source:GetAttribute("Width_Curve")
	local dissipateCurve = source:GetAttribute("Dissipate_Curve")

	return sampleLife(timeline, function(seconds)
		local travel = math.min(seconds / timeline.duration, 1)
		local width = lerp(widthStart, widthEnd, CurveSampling.alphaAt(widthCurve, travel))
		if timeline.mode == "Scale" and timeline.dissipate > 0 and seconds > timeline.dissipateStart then
			local progress = (seconds - timeline.dissipateStart) / timeline.dissipate
			width *= 1 - math.clamp(CurveSampling.alphaAt(dissipateCurve, progress), 0, 1)
		end
		return math.max(width, 0)
	end)
end

-- Transparency_Start -> End over the travel phase, the fade-in at the start, and the fade-out
-- (or a Retract standing in as a fade) during dissipation.
function Timeline.transparency(timeline)
	local source = timeline.source
	local transparencyStart = Helpers.attr(source, "Transparency_Start", 0)
	local transparencyEnd = Helpers.attr(source, "Transparency_End", 0)
	local transparencyCurve = source:GetAttribute("Transparency_Curve")
	local fadeInStart = Helpers.attr(source, "Fade_In_Start", 1)
	local fadeInCurve = source:GetAttribute("Fade_In_Curve")
	local fadeOutEnd = Helpers.attr(source, "Fade_Out_End", 1)
	local fadeOutCurve = source:GetAttribute("Fade_Out_Curve")
	local dissipateCurve = source:GetAttribute("Dissipate_Curve")

	return sampleLife(timeline, function(seconds)
		local travel = math.min(seconds / timeline.duration, 1)
		local base = lerp(transparencyStart, transparencyEnd, CurveSampling.alphaAt(transparencyCurve, travel))
		local value = base
		if timeline.fadeInDuration > 0 and seconds < timeline.fadeInDuration then
			value = lerp(fadeInStart, base, CurveSampling.alphaAt(fadeInCurve, seconds / timeline.fadeInDuration))
		elseif timeline.dissipate > 0 and seconds > timeline.dissipateStart then
			local elapsed = seconds - timeline.dissipateStart
			if timeline.fadeOutDuration > 0 then
				local progress = math.min(elapsed / timeline.fadeOutDuration, 1)
				value = lerp(base, fadeOutEnd, CurveSampling.alphaAt(fadeOutCurve, progress))
			elseif timeline.retractAsFade then
				value = lerp(base, 1, CurveSampling.alphaAt(dissipateCurve, elapsed / timeline.dissipate))
			end
		end
		return math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	end)
end

local function colorAt(keypoints, t)
	for index = 2, #keypoints do
		local previous = keypoints[index - 1]
		local current = keypoints[index]
		if t <= current.Time then
			local span = current.Time - previous.Time
			local alpha = span > 0 and (t - previous.Time) / span or 0
			return previous.Value:Lerp(current.Value, alpha)
		end
	end
	return keypoints[#keypoints].Value
end

-- Forge loops the Color sequence every Color_Duration seconds; the loop is unrolled over the life.
function Timeline.color(timeline, fallbackColor)
	local source = timeline.source
	local sequence = source:GetAttribute("Color")
	if typeof(sequence) ~= "ColorSequence" then
		return ColorSequence.new(Helpers.clampColor(fallbackColor))
	end

	local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
	local isConstant = true
	for index = 2, #keypoints do
		if keypoints[index].Value ~= keypoints[1].Value then
			isConstant = false
			break
		end
	end
	if isConstant then return ColorSequence.new(keypoints[1].Value) end

	local period = Helpers.attr(source, "Color_Duration", 1)
	local curve = source:GetAttribute("Color_Curve")
	local sampled = table.create(COLOR_SAMPLES)
	for index = 1, COLOR_SAMPLES do
		local lifeFraction = (index - 1) / (COLOR_SAMPLES - 1)
		local seconds = lifeFraction * timeline.total
		local cycle = 0
		if period > 0 then
			cycle = (seconds / period) % 1
			-- The end of a full loop is the sequence's last colour, not a wrap to its first.
			if cycle == 0 and seconds > 0 then cycle = 1 end
		end
		local t = math.clamp(CurveSampling.alphaAt(curve, cycle, true), 0, 1)
		sampled[index] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(lifeFraction, colorAt(keypoints, t))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(sampled)
end

return Timeline

--[[
	MeshAppearance: maps the look of a Forge mesh bundle onto a converted Part emitter.
	  mesh    Transparency from Part_Transparency_Start / End (+ curve); a Start carrying a Decal
	          hides the mesh by default. Color stays Start.Color (Forge never tweens it).
	  decals  A Start decal with a same-named End decal fades Transparency and tweens Color3 from
	          Start to End; one without a partner keeps its authored look.

	Decal values land as LayerTransparency / LayerColor / LayerBrightness on the RenderTemplate decal.
	Cross-file: Modules/Part/DecalLayers reads those names, and Transform stamps DecalLayers = true so
	the mesh graphs and the layer graphs stay separate.

	API (the Forge originals are only read):
	  apply(ctx, sourceModel, startPart, endPart, emitter, warpFn)  writes the emitter clone and its RenderTemplate
	  applyFlipbooks(startPart, emitter)  -> total frames, longest unsynced pass in seconds
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Parent.Helpers)
local CurveSampling = require(script.Parent.CurveSampling)

local MeshAppearance = {}

-- Splits an HDR Color3 (a component above 1) into a displayable colour and a brightness factor.
local function splitHDR(color)
	local peak = math.max(color.R, color.G, color.B)
	if peak > 1 then
		return Color3.new(color.R / peak, color.G / peak, color.B / peak), peak
	end
	return color, 1
end

-- Decal / Texture children in child order (Texture inherits Decal).
local function decalsOf(part)
	local decals = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") then
			table.insert(decals, child)
		end
	end
	return decals
end

local function writeMesh(ctx, sourceModel, startPart, emitter, warpFn)
	local partDefault = startPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal") and 1 or 0
	local legacyStart = Helpers.attr(sourceModel, "Mesh_StartTransparency", partDefault)
	local legacyEnd = Helpers.attr(sourceModel, "Mesh_EndTransparency", partDefault)
	local transparencyStart = Helpers.attr(sourceModel, "Part_Transparency_Start", legacyStart)
	local transparencyEnd = Helpers.attr(sourceModel, "Part_Transparency_End", legacyEnd)
	local curve = sourceModel:GetAttribute("Part_Transparency_Curve")

	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	TR.write(emitter, "Transparency", CurveSampling.seqLerpCurved(transparencyStart, transparencyEnd, curve, nil, warpFn))
	TR.write(emitter, "Color", ColorSequence.new(Helpers.clampColor(startPart.Color)))
end

local function writeLayer(layer, fromDecal, endPart, legacyStart, legacyEnd, warpFn)
	local toDecal = endPart:FindFirstChild(fromDecal.Name)
	if not (toDecal and toDecal:IsA("Decal")) then
		layer:SetAttribute("LayerTransparency", NumberSequence.new(fromDecal.Transparency))
		return
	end

	local transparencyStart = Helpers.attr(fromDecal, "Transparency_Start", legacyStart)
	local transparencyEnd = Helpers.attr(fromDecal, "Transparency_End", legacyEnd)
	local curve = fromDecal:GetAttribute("Transparency_Curve")
	layer:SetAttribute("LayerTransparency", CurveSampling.seqLerpCurved(transparencyStart, transparencyEnd, curve, nil, warpFn))

	local startColor, startBrightness = splitHDR(fromDecal.Color3)
	local endColor, endBrightness = splitHDR(toDecal.Color3)
	layer:SetAttribute("LayerColor", Helpers.colorSeq2(startColor, endColor))
	if startBrightness ~= 1 or endBrightness ~= 1 then
		layer:SetAttribute("LayerBrightness", Helpers.seq2(startBrightness, endBrightness))
	end
end

function MeshAppearance.apply(ctx, sourceModel, startPart, endPart, emitter, warpFn)
	writeMesh(ctx, sourceModel, startPart, emitter, warpFn)

	local renderTemplate = emitter:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not renderTemplate then return end

	local legacyStart = Helpers.attr(sourceModel, "Decal_StartTransparency", 0)
	local legacyEnd = Helpers.attr(sourceModel, "Decal_EndTransparency", 1)
	-- The RenderTemplate is a clone of Start, so its decals pair with Start's by child order.
	local sourceDecals = decalsOf(startPart)
	for index, layer in ipairs(decalsOf(renderTemplate)) do
		local fromDecal = sourceDecals[index]
		if fromDecal then
			writeLayer(layer, fromDecal, endPart, legacyStart, legacyEnd, warpFn)
		end
	end
end

-- Each Forge decal flipbook becomes a MeshFlipbooks sub-folder bound to its RenderTemplate decal by
-- LayerFlipbook: OneShot over the life with SyncDuration (or no Flipbook_Change_Duration), else a
-- Loop with one pass per Flipbook_Change_Duration seconds.
function MeshAppearance.applyFlipbooks(startPart, emitter)
	local folder = emitter:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
	local renderTemplate = emitter:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not (folder and renderTemplate) then return 0, 0 end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		child:Destroy()
	end

	local layers = decalsOf(renderTemplate)
	local totalFrames = 0
	local longestPass = 0
	for index, fromDecal in ipairs(decalsOf(startPart)) do
		local layer = layers[index]
		local frames = fromDecal:GetAttribute("FlipbookEnabled") and Helpers.deserializeFlipbook(fromDecal:GetAttribute("FlipbookTextures"))
		if layer and frames and #frames > 0 then
			-- "None" and "" are reserved LayerFlipbook values (no flipbook / the flat frame set).
			local baseName = fromDecal.Name
			if baseName == "" or baseName == "None" then baseName = "Flipbook" end
			local set = Instance.new("Folder")
			set.Name = Helpers.uniqueChildName(folder, baseName)
			for frameIndex, assetId in ipairs(frames) do
				local frame = Instance.new("Decal")
				frame.Name = tostring(frameIndex)
				frame.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(math.floor(assetId))
				frame.Parent = set
			end
			set.Parent = folder
			layer:SetAttribute("LayerFlipbook", set.Name)

			local passSeconds = fromDecal:GetAttribute("Flipbook_Change_Duration")
			local hasOwnPace = typeof(passSeconds) == "number" and passSeconds > 0 and fromDecal:GetAttribute("SyncDuration") ~= true
			if hasOwnPace then
				layer:SetAttribute("LayerFlipbookMode", "Loop")
				layer:SetAttribute("LayerFlipbookFramerate", NumberRange.new(math.max(1, #frames / passSeconds)))
				longestPass = math.max(longestPass, passSeconds)
			else
				layer:SetAttribute("LayerFlipbookMode", "OneShot")
			end
			totalFrames += #frames
		end
	end
	return totalFrames, longestPass
end

return MeshAppearance

--[[
	ShockwaveConverter: turns a Forge Shockwave Attachment (Ring, Line or Debris) into a Part-Icles Part
	emitter. The visual Part is cloned, stripped and transformed, keeping its Material and Reflectance;
	the Forge attributes become graphs, and an OnEmit Module (ShockwaveModules) does the per-spawn work.
	Size and transparency hold, then ramp over the last *_Duration of the life, as Forge's delayed
	tweens do. Forge's ground raycast (Ring, Line) and physics step (Debris) are approximated, so every
	shockwave counts in approxCount.

	API:
	  rewriteShockwave(ctx, sourceAtt, kind, report)  replaces the attachment with the emitter
	  convertShockwavePart(ctx, sourcePart, container, report, kind, sourceAtt)
	  convertShockwaveContainer(ctx, sourceModel, container, report, kind, sourceAtt)  first Part only
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Parent.Helpers)
local ShockwaveModules = require(script.Parent.ShockwaveModules)
local CurveSampling = require(script.Parent.CurveSampling)
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.EventsSchema)

local ShockwaveConverter = {}

-- Forge's defaults.
local DEFAULT_MIN_SIZE = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2)
local DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE = Vector3.new(3, 2, 3)
local DEFAULT_OFFSET = Vector3.zero
local DEFAULT_DIR_LINE = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
local DEFAULT_MIN_DIR = -Vector3.one
local DEFAULT_MAX_DIR = Vector3.one

local function _vec3Attr(inst, name, default)
	local v = inst:GetAttribute(name)
	if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then return v end
	return default
end

local function _sizePair(sourcePart)
	return _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "MinSize", DEFAULT_MIN_SIZE),
		_vec3Attr(sourcePart, "MaxSize", DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE)
end


-- Clones the source Part into container, strips and transforms it, and puts the source's Material
-- and Reflectance back on the RenderTemplate.
local function _cloneAndTransform(ctx, sourcePart, container)
	local srcMaterial = sourcePart:IsA("BasePart") and sourcePart.Material or nil
	local srcReflectance = sourcePart:IsA("BasePart") and sourcePart.Reflectance or nil

	local clone = sourcePart:Clone()
	clone.Anchored = true
	clone.CanCollide = false
	clone.CanQuery = false
	clone.CanTouch = false
	Helpers.clearPartIclesMarkers(clone)
	Helpers.stripAllForge(clone)
	clone.Parent = container
	ctx.Part:Transform(clone)
	local rt = clone:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and srcMaterial then
		rt.Material = srcMaterial
		rt.Reflectance = srcReflectance
	end
	return clone
end

-- Spawn x startScale, held at full, then x endScale, with the MinSize..MaxSize random as the
-- keypoint envelope. Forge tweens in over Size_Start_Duration and out over Size_End_Duration.
local function _writeSizeGraphs(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean,
		startScale, endScale, sizeStartDur, sizeEndDur, scaleStart, scaleEnd)
	local minSize, maxSize = _sizePair(sourcePart)
	-- Line's Scale_Start / Scale_End; 1 for Ring and Debris.
	scaleStart = scaleStart or 1
	scaleEnd = scaleEnd or scaleStart
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local axes = { X = "SizeX", Y = "SizeY", Z = "SizeZ" }
	local t1 = math.clamp(sizeStartDur / lifetimeMean, 0, 1)
	local t2 = math.clamp(1 - sizeEndDur / lifetimeMean, t1, 1)
	for component, prop in pairs(axes) do
		local mid = (minSize[component] + maxSize[component]) * 0.5
		local env = (maxSize[component] - minSize[component]) * 0.5
		-- The held value is one number, so the scale ramp is averaged.
		local body = mid * ((scaleStart + scaleEnd) * 0.5)
		local bodyEnv = env * ((scaleStart + scaleEnd) * 0.5)
		local startVal = body * startScale
		local endVal = body * endScale
		local startEnv = bodyEnv * startScale
		local endEnv = bodyEnv * endScale
		local kps = {
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, math.max(0, startVal), math.abs(startEnv)),
		}
		if t1 > 0 and t1 < 1 then kps[#kps + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t1, body, math.abs(bodyEnv)) end
		if t2 < 1 and t2 > t1 then kps[#kps + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t2, body, math.abs(bodyEnv)) end
		kps[#kps + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, math.max(0, endVal), math.abs(endEnv))
		TR.write(clone, prop, NumberSequence.new(kps))
	end
end

-- tStart held until the last Transparency_Duration, then ramped to tEnd. Equal values skip the
-- fade: the shrink hides the particle.
local function _writeTransparency(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean, defaultEnd)
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local tStart = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Transparency_Start", 0)
	local tEnd = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Transparency_End", defaultEnd)
	if tStart == tEnd then
		TR.write(clone, "Transparency", Helpers.seq2(tStart, tStart))
		return
	end
	local tpDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Transparency_Duration", 0.5)
	local holdEnd = math.clamp(1 - tpDur / lifetimeMean, 0, 1)
	TR.write(clone, "Transparency", Helpers.lateRampSeq(tStart, tEnd, holdEnd))
end

-- offsetStart -> BaseOffset -> offsetEnd over the start and end durations; nothing when all are zero.
local function _writeOffsetGraphs(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean)
	local baseOffset = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "BaseOffset", DEFAULT_OFFSET)
	local offsetStart = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "Offset_Start", baseOffset)
	local offsetEnd = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "Offset_End", baseOffset)
	if offsetStart == DEFAULT_OFFSET and baseOffset == DEFAULT_OFFSET and offsetEnd == DEFAULT_OFFSET then
		return
	end
	local startDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Offset_Start_Duration", 0.5)
	local endDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Offset_End_Duration", 0.5)
	local tMid = math.clamp(startDur / lifetimeMean, 0, 1)
	local tEndStart = math.clamp(1 - endDur / lifetimeMean, tMid, 1)
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetX", Helpers.threeStageSeq(offsetStart.X, baseOffset.X, offsetEnd.X, tMid, tEndStart))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetY", Helpers.threeStageSeq(offsetStart.Y, baseOffset.Y, offsetEnd.Y, tMid, tEndStart))
	TR.write(clone, "PosOffsetZ", Helpers.threeStageSeq(offsetStart.Z, baseOffset.Z, offsetEnd.Z, tMid, tEndStart))
	-- Forge authors offsets in the spawn frame.
	TR.write(clone, "DisplacementMode", "Local")
end

-- Forge tilts each piece inward by atan(height / length) about its tangent, which is the spawn-local
-- Z after RotYEven: RotZ = +atan(meanH / meanL).
local function _writeInwardTilt(ctx, clone, sourcePart)
	local minSize, maxSize = _sizePair(sourcePart)
	local meanH = (minSize.Y + maxSize.Y) * 0.5
	local meanL = (minSize.Z + maxSize.Z) * 0.5
	if meanL <= 0 then return end
	local tiltDeg = math.deg(math.atan(meanH / meanL))
	if math.abs(tiltDeg) < 0.5 then return end
	ctx.TypeRegistry.write(clone, "RotZ", NumberRange.new(tiltDeg))
end


-- Ring: Segments pieces in a circle, each placed by the OnEmit raycast.
local function _convertRing(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, lifetime, lifetimeMean, sourceAtt)
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local radius = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Radius", 5)
	local segments = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Segments", 7)
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitCount", segments)
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "EmitDelay", 0))
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "EmitDuration", 0))

	-- The OnEmit Module places and turns each piece; zero Speed and RotSpeed keep the engine from
	-- moving it after.
	TR.write(clone, "Speed", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "RotMode", "Speed")
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedX", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedY", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedZ", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))

	local scaleStartV = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "SizeScaleStart", Vector3.zero)
	local scaleEndV = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "SizeScaleEnd", Vector3.zero)
	local sizeStartDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Size_Start_Duration", 0.5)
	local sizeEndDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Size_End_Duration", 0.5)
	_writeSizeGraphs(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean,
		scaleStartV.X, scaleEndV.X, sizeStartDur, sizeEndDur, 1, 1)

	-- OnEmit may override a piece's Transparency with the surface it hits.
	_writeTransparency(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean, 0)

	local minSize, maxSize = _sizePair(sourcePart)
	local meanH = (minSize.Y + maxSize.Y) * 0.5
	local meanL = math.max((minSize.Z + maxSize.Z) * 0.5, 0.001)

	-- Ray settings live on the Shockwave Attachment.
	local rayDir = Vector3.new(0, -50, 0)
	local rayColGroup, filterTag, filterType = "Default", "", "Exclude"
	local ignoreWater, ignoreCanCollide = true, false
	if sourceAtt then
		rayDir = _vec3Attr(sourceAtt, "RayDirection", rayDir)
		rayColGroup = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "RayCollisionGroup", rayColGroup)
		filterTag = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "FilterTag", filterTag)
		filterType = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "FilterType", filterType)
		local iw = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "IgnoreWater", true)
		ignoreWater = iw == nil and true or iw
		ignoreCanCollide = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "IgnoreCanCollide", false) == true
	end

	-- OnEmit: per-slot raycast down, surface-aligned Teleport, inward tilt, and the hit surface's
	-- colour, material and transparency.
	local emitCfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(clone, "OnEmit")
	if emitCfg then
		emitCfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", true)
		emitCfg:SetAttribute("ScriptEnabled", true)
		emitCfg:SetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit", 4)
		local existing = emitCfg:FindFirstChild("Module")
		if existing then existing:Destroy() end
		local module = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
		module.Name = "Module"
		module.Source = ShockwaveModules.buildRingOnEmit({
			radius = radius,
			segments = segments,
			rayDir = rayDir,
			rayColGroup = rayColGroup,
			filterTag = filterTag,
			filterType = filterType,
			ignoreWater = ignoreWater,
			ignoreCanCollide = ignoreCanCollide,
			meanHeight = meanH,
			meanLength = meanL,
		})
		module.Parent = emitCfg
	end

	Helpers.wireEmitTarget(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, "EmitOnFinish", "OnDeath",
		"_OnDeath_EmitTargets", "Ring '" .. sourcePart.Name .. "'")
end


-- Line: pieces spread along Direction over Duration, each placed by the OnEmit raycast.
local function _convertLine(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, lifetime, lifetimeMean, sourceAtt)
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local fixedAmount = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "FixedAmount", 0)
	local duration = math.max(Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Duration", 1), 0.001)
	local rateStart = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Rate_Start", 30)
	local rateEnd = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Rate_End", rateStart)
	local rate
	if fixedAmount > 0 then
		rate = fixedAmount / duration
	else
		rate = (rateStart + rateEnd) * 0.5 -- averaged; warned below
	end

	-- Rate only, over Duration: EmitCount 0 drops the burst Part-Icles fires before the rate loop.
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 0)
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "EmitDelay", 0))
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", duration)
	TR.write(clone, "Rate", rate)

	-- As in Ring, OnEmit places each piece.
	TR.write(clone, "Speed", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "RotMode", "Speed")
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedX", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedY", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))
	TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedZ", Helpers.seq2(0, 0))

	-- A Scale_Start / End ramp makes OnEmit set each piece's size, which overrides this envelope.
	local scaleStartV = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "SizeScaleStart", Vector3.zero)
	local scaleEndV = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "SizeScaleEnd", Vector3.zero)
	local sizeStartDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Size_Start_Duration", 0.5)
	local sizeEndDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Size_End_Duration", 0.5)
	_writeSizeGraphs(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean,
		scaleStartV.X, scaleEndV.X, sizeStartDur, sizeEndDur, 1, 1)

	_writeTransparency(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean, 0)

	local minSize, maxSize = _sizePair(sourcePart)
	local meanH = (minSize.Y + maxSize.Y) * 0.5
	local meanL = math.max((minSize.Z + maxSize.Z) * 0.5, 0.001)

	local lineDir = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "Direction", DEFAULT_DIR_LINE)
	if lineDir.Magnitude < 0.001 then lineDir = DEFAULT_DIR_LINE end
	lineDir = lineDir.Unit
	local length = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Length", 50)

	-- Per-piece Z rotation, in the surface frame.
	local rotRange = Helpers.range(sourcePart, "Rotation", -180, 180)

	-- Path_Curve baked into a 64-sample table for the Module; linear without one.
	local pathCurveBuf = sourcePart:GetAttribute("Path_Curve")
	local curvePoints = pathCurveBuf and CurveSampling.deserializeForgeCurve(pathCurveBuf)
	local pathLookup = table.create(64)
	for i = 1, 64 do
		local t = (i - 1) / 63
		if curvePoints and #curvePoints >= 4 then
			pathLookup[i] = math.clamp(CurveSampling.evalForgeAlpha(curvePoints, t), 0, 1)
		else
			pathLookup[i] = t
		end
	end

	local scaleStart = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Scale_Start", 1)
	local scaleEnd = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Scale_End", scaleStart)
	local scaleRamps = scaleStart ~= scaleEnd

	local rayDir = Vector3.new(0, -50, 0)
	local rayColGroup, filterTag, filterType = "Default", "", "Exclude"
	local ignoreWater, ignoreCanCollide = true, false
	if sourceAtt then
		rayDir = _vec3Attr(sourceAtt, "RayDirection", rayDir)
		rayColGroup = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "RayCollisionGroup", rayColGroup)
		filterTag = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "FilterTag", filterTag)
		filterType = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "FilterType", filterType)
		local iw = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "IgnoreWater", true)
		ignoreWater = iw == nil and true or iw
		ignoreCanCollide = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "IgnoreCanCollide", false) == true
	end

	-- OnEmit: emission time from _lineEmissionStart, per-spawn raycast, surface-aligned Teleport with
	-- Z rotation, the hit surface's look, optional scale ramp.
	local emitCfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(clone, "OnEmit")
	if emitCfg then
		emitCfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", true)
		emitCfg:SetAttribute("ScriptEnabled", true)
		emitCfg:SetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit", 4)
		local existing = emitCfg:FindFirstChild("Module")
		if existing then existing:Destroy() end
		local module = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
		module.Name = "Module"
		module.Source = ShockwaveModules.buildLineOnEmit({
			lineDir = lineDir,
			lineLength = length,
			duration = duration,
			rotationMin = rotRange.Min,
			rotationMax = rotRange.Max,
			scaleStart = scaleStart,
			scaleEnd = scaleEnd,
			scaleRamps = scaleRamps,
			rayDir = rayDir,
			rayColGroup = rayColGroup,
			filterTag = filterTag,
			filterType = filterType,
			ignoreWater = ignoreWater,
			ignoreCanCollide = ignoreCanCollide,
			meanHeight = meanH,
			meanLength = meanL,
			pathLookup = pathLookup,
		})
		module.Parent = emitCfg
	end

	if rateStart ~= rateEnd then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Line '%s'  -  Rate_Start/End ramping collapsed to average %g/s; per-frame Rate not supported in Part-Icles scalar Rate.",
			sourcePart.Name, rate)
	end
	if sourcePart:GetAttribute("SyncPosition") == true then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Line '%s'  -  SyncPosition (caster-follow per-spawn) not auto-wired. Set Link manually if caster needs to drag the line.",
			sourcePart.Name)
	end

	Helpers.wireEmitTarget(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, "EmitOnFinish", "OnDeath",
		"_OnDeath_EmitTargets", "Line '" .. sourcePart.Name .. "'")
end


-- Debris: a ballistic launch under gravity, with OnHit bounce and tumble.
local function _convertDebris(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, lifetime, lifetimeMean, sourceAtt)
	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local amount = Helpers.range(sourcePart, "Amount", 5, 10)
	local emitCount = math.max(1, math.floor((amount.Min + amount.Max) * 0.5))
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitCount", emitCount)
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "EmitDelay", 0))
	clone:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "EmitDuration", 0))

	-- Forge launches at LinearMagnitude / Airtime plus an upward kick of g x Airtime / 2, so a piece
	-- lands at origin + dir x LinearMagnitude; the kick folds into the speed, sqrt(launch^2 + kick^2).
	local linmag = Helpers.range(sourcePart, "LinearMagnitude", 15, 25)
	local airtime = Helpers.range(sourcePart, "Airtime", 0.5, 0.5)
	local airMean = math.max((airtime.Min + airtime.Max) * 0.5, 0.05)
	local launchMin = linmag.Min / airMean
	local launchMax = linmag.Max / airMean
	local boostY = workspace.Gravity * airMean * 0.5
	local speedMin = math.sqrt(launchMin * launchMin + boostY * boostY)
	local speedMax = math.sqrt(launchMax * launchMax + boostY * boostY)
	TR.write(clone, "Speed", Helpers.seq2(speedMin, speedMax))

	-- Forge picks the direction inside the MinDirection..MaxDirection box; the cone's half-angle is the
	-- box's largest sideways extent against its vertical one.
	local minDir = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "MinDirection", DEFAULT_MIN_DIR)
	local maxDir = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "MaxDirection", DEFAULT_MAX_DIR)
	local horiz = math.max(math.abs(minDir.X), math.abs(maxDir.X), math.abs(minDir.Z), math.abs(maxDir.Z))
	local vert = math.max(math.abs(minDir.Y), math.abs(maxDir.Y), 1e-3)
	local baseSpread = math.deg(math.atan2(horiz, vert))
	-- The kick tilts launches upward; widening the cone by that tilt keeps the ground reach.
	local boostTilt = math.deg(math.atan2(boostY, math.max(launchMax, 0.01)))
	local spread = math.clamp(baseSpread + boostTilt, 0, 180)
	TR.write(clone, "SpreadAngle", Vector2.new(spread, spread))

	TR.write(clone, "Acceleration", Vector3.new(0, -workspace.Gravity, 0))

	-- Bounce takes Elasticity and Friction from CustomPhysicalProperties when authored, as Forge's
	-- physics step would.
	local hitCfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(clone, "OnHit")
	if hitCfg then
		local cpp = sourcePart.CustomPhysicalProperties
		local bounciness, friction = 0.3, 0.6
		if cpp then
			bounciness = math.clamp(cpp.Elasticity, 0, 1)
			friction = math.clamp(cpp.Friction, 0, 1)
		end
		hitCfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", true)
		hitCfg:SetAttribute("Collision", "Bounce")
		hitCfg:SetAttribute("Bounciness", bounciness)
		hitCfg:SetAttribute("Friction", friction)
		hitCfg:SetAttribute("Spin", 0.5)
	end

	-- EmitOnFinish fires on death, EmitOnImpact on a bounce hit.
	local debrisLabel = "Debris '" .. sourcePart.Name .. "'"
	Helpers.wireEmitTarget(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, "EmitOnFinish", "OnDeath",
		"_OnDeath_EmitTargets", debrisLabel)
	Helpers.wireEmitTarget(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, "EmitOnImpact", "OnHit",
		"_OnHit_EmitTargets", debrisLabel)

	-- Forge spins each piece by a random unit vector x AngularMagnitude. Three independent axes sum to
	-- about sqrt(3) times one, so each axis is scaled by 1/sqrt(3) (0.577); x60 is a hand-tuned rate
	-- for pieces about a stud across.
	local angmag = Helpers.range(sourcePart, "AngularMagnitude", 5, 15)
	if angmag.Max > 0 then
		local rateDeg = math.abs(angmag.Max) * 60 * 0.577
		TR.write(clone, "RotMode", "Speed")
		local rotSpeedSeq = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0, rateDeg),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0, rateDeg),
		})
		TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedX", rotSpeedSeq)
		TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedY", rotSpeedSeq)
		TR.write(clone, "RotSpeedZ", rotSpeedSeq)
		TR.write(clone, "RotX", NumberRange.new(0, 360))
		TR.write(clone, "RotY", NumberRange.new(0, 360))
		TR.write(clone, "RotZ", NumberRange.new(0, 360))
	end

	-- Debris has one Size_Duration and Transparency_Duration: the end ramp only, full size at spawn.
	local sizeDur = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "Size_Duration", 0.5)
	local scaleEndV = _vec3Attr(sourcePart, "SizeScaleEnd", Vector3.zero)
	_writeSizeGraphs(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean,
		1, scaleEndV.X, 0, sizeDur, 1, 1)
	_writeTransparency(ctx, clone, sourcePart, lifetimeMean, 1)

	-- InheritanceEnabled (default true): OnEmit gives each piece the colour, material and transparency
	-- of a random part nearby.
	local inheritEnabled = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "InheritanceEnabled", true) == true
	if inheritEnabled then
		local inheritRadius = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "InheritanceRadius", 5)
		local inheritMaxResults = Helpers.attr(sourcePart, "InheritanceMaxResults", 5)
		local rayColGroup, filterTag, filterType = "Default", "", "Exclude"
		local ignoreCanCollide = false
		if sourceAtt then
			rayColGroup = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "RayCollisionGroup", rayColGroup)
			filterTag = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "FilterTag", filterTag)
			filterType = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "FilterType", filterType)
			ignoreCanCollide = Helpers.attr(sourceAtt, "IgnoreCanCollide", false) == true
		end
		local emitCfg = EventsSchema.ensureEvent(clone, "OnEmit")
		if emitCfg then
			emitCfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", true)
			emitCfg:SetAttribute("ScriptEnabled", true)
			emitCfg:SetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit", 4)
			local existing = emitCfg:FindFirstChild("Module")
			if existing then existing:Destroy() end
			local module = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
			module.Name = "Module"
			module.Source = ShockwaveModules.buildDebrisInheritanceOnEmit({
				inheritanceRadius = inheritRadius,
				inheritanceMaxResults = inheritMaxResults,
				rayColGroup = rayColGroup,
				filterTag = filterTag,
				filterType = filterType,
				ignoreCanCollide = ignoreCanCollide,
			})
			module.Parent = emitCfg
		end
	end

	if typeof(sourcePart:GetAttribute("Amount")) == "NumberRange" then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Debris '%s'  -  Amount range collapsed to %d (Part-Icles EmitCount is scalar).",
			sourcePart.Name, emitCount)
	end
end


-- The nearest Attachment ancestor, which holds the ray settings, when the caller passes none.
local function _findShockwaveAttachment(part)
	local p = part and part.Parent
	while p do
		if p:IsA("Attachment") then return p end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

-- Forge layout: Attachment[Shockwave] > Folder/Model[Ring(s) | Line(s) | Debris] > Part, or the Part
-- directly under the attachment. Returns the Part and its *_container kind.
local _SHOCKWAVE_TYPE_LOCAL = {
	Ring = "shockwave_ring_container",
	Rings = "shockwave_ring_container",
	Line = "shockwave_line_container",
	Lines = "shockwave_line_container",
	Debris = "shockwave_debris_container",
}
local function _findShockwavePartInAttachmentLocal(att)
	local kindFromAtt = _SHOCKWAVE_TYPE_LOCAL[att.Name]
	for _, child in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
			local kindFromFolder = _SHOCKWAVE_TYPE_LOCAL[child.Name]
			for _, grandchild in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
				if grandchild:IsA("BasePart") then
					return grandchild, kindFromFolder or kindFromAtt
				end
			end
		end
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			return child, kindFromAtt
		end
	end
	return nil, kindFromAtt
end

-- Replaces a cloned Shockwave Attachment (and its Forge folder) with the emitter, under the
-- attachment's parent.
function ShockwaveConverter.rewriteShockwave(ctx, sourceAtt, kind, report)
	local container = sourceAtt.Parent or workspace
	local sourcePart, containerKind = _findShockwavePartInAttachmentLocal(sourceAtt)
	if not sourcePart or not containerKind then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format(
			"Shockwave attachment '%s'  -  no visual Part found inside; skipped.",
			sourceAtt:GetFullName())
		report.skippedCount += 1
		sourceAtt:Destroy()
		return
	end
	kind = kind or containerKind
	ShockwaveConverter.convertShockwavePart(ctx, sourcePart, container, report, kind, sourceAtt)
	sourceAtt:Destroy()
end

function ShockwaveConverter.convertShockwavePart(ctx, sourcePart, container, report, kind, sourceAtt)
	if not sourcePart or not sourcePart:IsA("BasePart") then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = "Shockwave source is not a BasePart; skipped."
		report.skippedCount += 1
		return
	end

	sourceAtt = sourceAtt or _findShockwaveAttachment(sourcePart)

	local clone = _cloneAndTransform(ctx, sourcePart, container)

	-- Forge's default lifetime is 2 to 3 for all three.
	local lifetime = Helpers.range(sourcePart, "Lifetime", 2, 3)
	ctx.TypeRegistry.write(clone, "Lifetime", lifetime)
	local lifetimeMean = math.max((lifetime.Min + lifetime.Max) * 0.5, 1e-3)

	if kind == "shockwave_ring_container" then
		_convertRing(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, lifetime, lifetimeMean, sourceAtt)
	elseif kind == "shockwave_line_container" then
		_convertLine(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, lifetime, lifetimeMean, sourceAtt)
	else
		_convertDebris(ctx, clone, sourcePart, report, lifetime, lifetimeMean, sourceAtt)
	end

	local baseKind = kind:gsub("_container$", "")
	report.approxCount += 1
	report.mappedTypes[baseKind] = (report.mappedTypes[baseKind] or 0) + 1
end

-- A selected Rings / Lines / Debris container converts its first Part only.
function ShockwaveConverter.convertShockwaveContainer(ctx, sourceModel, container, report, kind, sourceAtt)
	local first
	for _, c in ipairs(sourceModel:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("BasePart") then first = c; break end
	end
	if not first then
		report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = "Shockwave container '" .. sourceModel:GetFullName() .. "' has no Part children; skipped."
		report.skippedCount += 1
		return
	end
	ShockwaveConverter.convertShockwavePart(ctx, first, container, report, kind, sourceAtt)
end

return ShockwaveConverter

--[[
	ShockwaveModules: builds the OnEmit / OnHit ModuleScript sources that converted ring, line and
	debris emitters carry. Each builder takes a `constants` table of values baked from the Forge
	attributes and fills the template's `{{NAME}}` tokens with them as Luau literals.

	API (each returns a source string):
	  buildRingOnEmit(c), buildLineOnEmit(c), buildDebrisInheritanceOnEmit(c), buildDebrisImpactOnHit()
]]

local ShockwaveModules = {}

local function _luaBool(v) return v and "true" or "false" end
local function _luaStr(v) return string.format("%q", tostring(v or "")) end
local function _luaVec3(v)
	if typeof(v) ~= "Vector3" then v = Vector3.zero end
	return string.format("Vector3.new(%g, %g, %g)", v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
end

-- Replaces `{{NAME}}` tokens with vars[NAME], already formatted as Luau.
local function _substitute(template, vars)
	return (template:gsub("%{%{([%w_]+)%}%}", function(name)
		local v = vars[name]
		if v == nil then return "nil" end
		return tostring(v)
	end))
end


-- Ring OnEmit: per-segment raycast down, surface alignment, the hit's colour and material.
local RING_TEMPLATE = [==[
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local RADIUS = {{RADIUS}}
local SEGMENTS = {{SEGMENTS}}
local RAY_DIR = {{RAY_DIR}}
local RAY_COL_GROUP = {{RAY_COL_GROUP}}
local FILTER_TAG = {{FILTER_TAG}}
local FILTER_TYPE = {{FILTER_TYPE}}
local IGNORE_WATER = {{IGNORE_WATER}}
local IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE = {{IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE}}
local MEAN_HEIGHT = {{MEAN_HEIGHT}}
local MEAN_LENGTH = {{MEAN_LENGTH}}
local INWARD_TILT_RAD = -math.atan(MEAN_HEIGHT / math.max(MEAN_LENGTH, 0.001))

return function(payload)
	local slot = (payload.EmitIndex or 1) - 1
	local emitCount = payload.EmitCount or SEGMENTS
	local angle = (slot / emitCount) * math.pi * 2

	local originCF = payload.WorldCFrame
	if not originCF then payload.Kill() return end

	-- Radial ray-origin point in attachment-local XZ plane.
	local radialPos = originCF * CFrame.new(RADIUS * math.cos(angle), 0, RADIUS * math.sin(angle))

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.CollisionGroup = RAY_COL_GROUP
	params.IgnoreWater = IGNORE_WATER
	params.RespectCanCollide = not IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType[FILTER_TYPE]
	if FILTER_TAG ~= "" then
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = CollectionService:GetTagged(FILTER_TAG)
	end
	if FILTER_TYPE == "Exclude" then
		params:AddToFilter({ workspace.Terrain, payload.Source })
	end

	local worldRayDir = originCF:VectorToWorldSpace(RAY_DIR)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(radialPos.Position, worldRayDir, params)
	if not result then payload.Kill() return end

	-- Surface basis: right=tangent (perpendicular to radial+normal), up=hit normal.
	local rx = -math.cos(angle)
	local rz = -math.sin(angle)
	local dir = originCF:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(rx, 0, rz))
	local tangent = dir:Cross(result.Normal)
	if tangent.Magnitude < 0.001 then tangent = originCF.RightVector end
	tangent = tangent.Unit

	local surfaceCF = CFrame.fromMatrix(result.Position, tangent, result.Normal)
		* CFrame.fromOrientation(INWARD_TILT_RAD, 0, 0)
	payload.Teleport(surfaceCF)

	if result.Instance and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		payload.SetColor(result.Instance.Color)
		payload.Particle.Material = result.Material
		local hitTp = result.Instance.Transparency
		if hitTp ~= 0 then payload.SetTransparency(hitTp) end
	end
end
]==]

function ShockwaveModules.buildRingOnEmit(c)
	return _substitute(RING_TEMPLATE, {
		RADIUS = c.radius,
		SEGMENTS = c.segments,
		RAY_DIR = _luaVec3(c.rayDir),
		RAY_COL_GROUP = _luaStr(c.rayColGroup),
		FILTER_TAG = _luaStr(c.filterTag),
		FILTER_TYPE = _luaStr(c.filterType),
		IGNORE_WATER = _luaBool(c.ignoreWater),
		IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE = _luaBool(c.ignoreCanCollide),
		MEAN_HEIGHT = c.meanHeight,
		MEAN_LENGTH = c.meanLength,
	})
end


-- Line OnEmit: emission clock, per-spawn raycast, per-particle Z rotation.
local LINE_TEMPLATE = [==[
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local LINE_DIR = {{LINE_DIR}}
local LINE_LENGTH = {{LINE_LENGTH}}
local DURATION = {{DURATION}}
local ROTATION_MIN = {{ROTATION_MIN}}
local ROTATION_MAX = {{ROTATION_MAX}}
local SCALE_START = {{SCALE_START}}
local SCALE_END = {{SCALE_END}}
local SCALE_RAMPS = {{SCALE_RAMPS}}
local RAY_DIR = {{RAY_DIR}}
local RAY_COL_GROUP = {{RAY_COL_GROUP}}
local FILTER_TAG = {{FILTER_TAG}}
local FILTER_TYPE = {{FILTER_TYPE}}
local IGNORE_WATER = {{IGNORE_WATER}}
local IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE = {{IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE}}
local MEAN_HEIGHT = {{MEAN_HEIGHT}}
local MEAN_LENGTH = {{MEAN_LENGTH}}
local INWARD_TILT_RAD = -math.atan(MEAN_HEIGHT / math.max(MEAN_LENGTH, 0.001))

local PATH_LOOKUP = {{PATH_LOOKUP}}

local rng = Random.new()

return function(payload)
	local now = os.clock()
	local emissionStart = payload.Source:GetAttribute("_lineEmissionStart")
	if not emissionStart or (now - emissionStart) > (DURATION + 0.5) then
		payload.Source:SetAttribute("_lineEmissionStart", now)
		emissionStart = now
	end

	local elapsed = now - emissionStart
	local rawFrac = math.clamp(elapsed / DURATION, 0, 1)
	-- Path_Curve easing lookup
	local lookupIdx = math.clamp(math.floor(rawFrac * (#PATH_LOOKUP - 1)) + 1, 1, #PATH_LOOKUP)
	local alpha = math.clamp(PATH_LOOKUP[lookupIdx] or rawFrac, 0, 1)

	local originCF = payload.WorldCFrame
	if not originCF then payload.Kill() return end

	local worldLineDir = originCF:VectorToWorldSpace(LINE_DIR)
	local linePos = originCF.Position + worldLineDir * LINE_LENGTH * alpha

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.CollisionGroup = RAY_COL_GROUP
	params.IgnoreWater = IGNORE_WATER
	params.RespectCanCollide = not IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType[FILTER_TYPE]
	if FILTER_TAG ~= "" then
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = CollectionService:GetTagged(FILTER_TAG)
	end
	if FILTER_TYPE == "Exclude" then
		params:AddToFilter({ workspace.Terrain, payload.Source })
	end

	local worldRayDir = originCF:VectorToWorldSpace(RAY_DIR)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(linePos, worldRayDir, params)
	if not result then payload.Kill() return end

	local tangent = worldLineDir:Cross(result.Normal)
	if tangent.Magnitude < 0.001 then tangent = originCF.RightVector end
	tangent = tangent.Unit

	local rotZ_rad = math.rad(rng:NextNumber(ROTATION_MIN, ROTATION_MAX))
	local surfaceCF = CFrame.fromMatrix(result.Position, tangent, result.Normal)
		* CFrame.fromOrientation(0, rotZ_rad, 0)
		* CFrame.fromOrientation(INWARD_TILT_RAD, 0, 0)
	payload.Teleport(surfaceCF)

	if result.Instance and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		payload.SetColor(result.Instance.Color)
		payload.Particle.Material = result.Material
		local hitTp = result.Instance.Transparency
		if hitTp ~= 0 then payload.SetTransparency(hitTp) end
	end

	-- Optional global scale ramp (Scale_Start..Scale_End across Duration).
	-- Disables per-particle size envelope when active (SetSize auto-skips graph).
	if SCALE_RAMPS then
		local currentScale = SCALE_START + (SCALE_END - SCALE_START) * rawFrac
		payload.SetSize(payload.Particle.Size * currentScale)
	end
end
]==]

local function _luaNumberArray(arr)
	if not arr or #arr == 0 then return "{0, 1}" end
	local parts = table.create(#arr)
	for i, v in ipairs(arr) do parts[i] = string.format("%g", v) end
	return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "}"
end

function ShockwaveModules.buildLineOnEmit(c)
	return _substitute(LINE_TEMPLATE, {
		LINE_DIR = _luaVec3(c.lineDir),
		LINE_LENGTH = c.lineLength,
		DURATION = c.duration,
		ROTATION_MIN = c.rotationMin,
		ROTATION_MAX = c.rotationMax,
		SCALE_START = c.scaleStart,
		SCALE_END = c.scaleEnd,
		SCALE_RAMPS = _luaBool(c.scaleRamps),
		RAY_DIR = _luaVec3(c.rayDir),
		RAY_COL_GROUP = _luaStr(c.rayColGroup),
		FILTER_TAG = _luaStr(c.filterTag),
		FILTER_TYPE = _luaStr(c.filterType),
		IGNORE_WATER = _luaBool(c.ignoreWater),
		IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE = _luaBool(c.ignoreCanCollide),
		MEAN_HEIGHT = c.meanHeight,
		MEAN_LENGTH = c.meanLength,
		PATH_LOOKUP = _luaNumberArray(c.pathLookup),
	})
end


-- Debris OnEmit: a nearby part's colour and material for each particle (InheritanceEnabled).
local DEBRIS_INHERITANCE_TEMPLATE = [==[
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local INHERITANCE_RADIUS = {{INHERITANCE_RADIUS}}
local INHERITANCE_MAX_RESULTS = {{INHERITANCE_MAX_RESULTS}}
local RAY_COL_GROUP = {{RAY_COL_GROUP}}
local FILTER_TAG = {{FILTER_TAG}}
local FILTER_TYPE = {{FILTER_TYPE}}
local IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE = {{IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE}}

local rng = Random.new()

local function _buildParams()
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.MaxParts = INHERITANCE_MAX_RESULTS
	params.CollisionGroup = RAY_COL_GROUP
	params.RespectCanCollide = not IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType[FILTER_TYPE]
	if FILTER_TAG ~= "" then
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = CollectionService:GetTagged(FILTER_TAG)
	end
	if FILTER_TYPE == "Exclude" then
		params:AddToFilter({ workspace.Terrain })
	end
	return params
end

return function(payload)
	-- Reset per-particle impact flag (used by OnHit EmitOnImpact handler).
	payload.Particle:SetAttribute("_impacted", nil)

	local params = _buildParams()
	local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(payload.WorldPosition, INHERITANCE_RADIUS, params)
	local opaque = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if p.Transparency < 1 then opaque[#opaque + 1] = p end
	end
	if #opaque == 0 then return end

	local iref = opaque[rng:NextInteger(1, #opaque)]
	payload.SetColor(iref.Color)
	payload.Particle.Material = iref.Material
	if iref.Transparency > 0 then
		payload.SetTransparency(iref.Transparency)
	end
end
]==]

function ShockwaveModules.buildDebrisInheritanceOnEmit(c)
	return _substitute(DEBRIS_INHERITANCE_TEMPLATE, {
		INHERITANCE_RADIUS = c.inheritanceRadius,
		INHERITANCE_MAX_RESULTS = c.inheritanceMaxResults,
		RAY_COL_GROUP = _luaStr(c.rayColGroup),
		FILTER_TAG = _luaStr(c.filterTag),
		FILTER_TYPE = _luaStr(c.filterType),
		IGNORE_CAN_COLLIDE = _luaBool(c.ignoreCanCollide),
	})
end

local DEBRIS_IMPACT_TEMPLATE = [==[

--[[
	SoundConverter: turns a Forge Sound into a Part-Icles Sound emitter in place (Transform on the Sound).
	  Volume_Start / End (+ Duration, Curve)  -> Volume graph
	  Speed_Start / End  (+ Duration, Curve)  -> PlaybackSpeed graph
	  RollOff_Start                           -> RollOffMin
	  EmitDuration (Forge stops the clip)     -> Lifetime
	  EmitCount / EmitDelay                   -> item attributes
	A tween's duration is in seconds of the clip and the graphs span the emitter's life, so a shorter
	tween becomes an early ramp that then holds; an unloaded clip (TimeLength 0) spreads it over the life.
	Not mapped, each reported: sound pools, EmitInterval, RepeatCount, a RollOff tween.

	API: convert(ctx, sound, report)
]]

local Helpers = require(script.Parent.Helpers)
local CurveSampling = require(script.Parent.CurveSampling)

local SoundConverter = {}

local RAMP_SAMPLES = 8

local function addWarning(report, sound, message)
	report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = string.format("Sound '%s': %s", sound.Name, message)
end

-- startValue -> endValue along a Forge curve over the first `fraction` of life, then held.
local function rampGraph(startValue, endValue, curve, fraction)
	if startValue == endValue then return NumberSequence.new(startValue) end
	fraction = math.clamp(fraction, 0.001, 1)
	local keypoints = {}
	for step = 0, RAMP_SAMPLES do
		local progress = step / RAMP_SAMPLES
		local value = startValue + (endValue - startValue) * CurveSampling.alphaAt(curve, progress)
		table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(progress * fraction, math.max(value, 0)))
	end
	if fraction < 1 then
		table.insert(keypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, math.max(endValue, 0)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

-- Reads every Forge value before the attribute strip.
local function readSource(sound)
	local emitDuration = Helpers.attr(sound, "EmitDuration", 0)
	local life = emitDuration > 0 and emitDuration or sound.TimeLength
	local function fractionOf(durationName)
		local seconds = sound:GetAttribute(durationName)
		if typeof(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds <= 0 or life <= 0 then return 1 end
		return seconds / life
	end
	local repeatInterval = Helpers.range(sound, "RepeatInterval", 0, 0)
	local emitInterval = Helpers.range(sound, "EmitInterval", 0, 0)
	return {
		emitCount = Helpers.attr(sound, "EmitCount", 1),
		emitDelay = Helpers.attr(sound, "EmitDelay", 0),
		emitDuration = emitDuration,
		volumeStart = Helpers.attr(sound, "Volume_Start", sound.Volume),
		volumeEnd = Helpers.attr(sound, "Volume_End", sound.Volume),
		volumeCurve = sound:GetAttribute("Volume_Curve"),
		volumeFraction = fractionOf("Volume_Duration"),
		speedStart = Helpers.attr(sound, "Speed_Start", sound.PlaybackSpeed),
		speedEnd = Helpers.attr(sound, "Speed_End", sound.PlaybackSpeed),
		speedCurve = sound:GetAttribute("Speed_Curve"),
		speedFraction = fractionOf("Speed_Duration"),
		rollOffStart = Helpers.attr(sound, "RollOff_Start", sound.RollOffMinDistance),
		rollOffEnd = Helpers.attr(sound, "RollOff_End", sound.RollOffMinDistance),
		looped = sound.Looped,
		timeLength = sound.TimeLength,
		usesPool = Helpers.attr(sound, "SoundPoolTag", "") ~= "",
		repeats = Helpers.attr(sound, "RepeatCount", 1) > 1 or repeatInterval.Max > 0,
		staggers = emitInterval.Max > 0,
	}
end

function SoundConverter.convert(ctx, sound, report)
	local source = readSource(sound)

	Helpers.clearPartIclesMarkers(sound)
	Helpers.stripAllForge(sound)
	local ok, err = pcall(function() ctx.Part:Transform(sound) end)
	if not ok or not sound:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		addWarning(report, sound, "Transform failed (" .. tostring(err) .. "); left as a plain Sound.")
		report.skippedCount += 1
		return
	end

	local TR = ctx.TypeRegistry
	TR.write(sound, "Volume", rampGraph(source.volumeStart, source.volumeEnd, source.volumeCurve, source.volumeFraction))
	TR.write(sound, "PlaybackSpeed", rampGraph(source.speedStart, source.speedEnd, source.speedCurve, source.speedFraction))
	TR.write(sound, "RollOffMin", source.rollOffStart)
	if source.emitDuration > 0 then
		TR.write(sound, "Lifetime", NumberRange.new(source.emitDuration))
	elseif source.looped and source.timeLength > 0 then
		-- Forge plays a looped clip for one clip length; a Looped emitter needs that as its Lifetime.
		TR.write(sound, "Lifetime", NumberRange.new(source.timeLength))
	elseif source.looped then
		addWarning(report, sound, "looped clip is not loaded, so its length is unknown; set Lifetime by hand.")
	end
	sound:SetAttribute("EmitCount", source.emitCount)
	sound:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", source.emitDelay)

	if source.rollOffStart ~= source.rollOffEnd then
		addWarning(report, sound, "the RollOff tween is not converted; RollOff_Start is used.")
	end
	if source.usesPool then
		addWarning(report, sound, "sound pools (random pick per emit) are not converted; this clip always plays.")
	end
	if source.repeats or source.staggers then
		addWarning(report, sound, "RepeatCount / RepeatInterval / EmitInterval are not converted; the copies play together.")
	end

	report.successCount += 1
	report.mappedTypes.sound = (report.mappedTypes.sound or 0) + 1
end

return SoundConverter

--[[
	FriendlyName  -  safe asset Names for CreateAssetAsync uploads.
	Roblox moderation can ban an upload named like `Spritesheet_8942146902_9` (ids, an underscore
	before digits), so uploads are named one safe noun plus a frame number with no separator.
]]

local FriendlyName = {}

local WORDS = {
	"Petal","Bloom","Sparkle","Glimmer","Wisp","Cloud","Mist","Star",
	"Comet","Aurora","Prism","Crystal","Ember","Flake","Dawn","Dusk",
	"Meadow","Brook","Stream","Pebble","Shell","Coral","Pearl","Opal",
	"Jade","Amber","Topaz","Quartz","Lily","Daisy","Tulip","Iris",
	"Maple","Willow","Cedar","Birch","Fern","Moss","Clover","Ivy",
	"Breeze","Whisper","Echo","Halo","Beam","Glow","Spark","Twinkle",
	"Drift","Ripple","Bubble","Foam","Snowdrop","Dewdrop","Sunbeam","Moonbeam",
	"Starlet","Lantern","Beacon","Candle","Lamplight","Firefly","Lightning","Flicker",
	"Feather","Plume","Quill","Frond","Bough","Bud","Sprig","Seed",
	"Acorn","Berry","Honey","Nectar","Velvet","Silk","Linen","Cotton",
}

-- A random safe word.
function FriendlyName.base()
	return WORDS[math.random(#WORDS)]
end

-- "Petal" + 3 -> "Petal3"; no underscore, which moderation flags.
function FriendlyName.frame(base, idx)
	return base .. tostring(idx)
end

return FriendlyName

	self._setSimpDragging = refs.setSimpDragging

	self:_layoutStatusBar()
	self:_wire()
	return self
end


function GraphEditor:_rawClose()
	self._panel.Visible = false
	self._interactionState = "idle"
	self._state.onApply = nil
	self._state.onPreview = nil
	self._previewPending = false
	self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_hideHelp()
	self:_hidePopups()
	self._ghostDot.Visible = false
	self._ghostLineL.Visible = false
	self._ghostLineR.Visible = false
	self._closing = false
end

-- Popovers that must not be showing the next time the editor opens. Cancel and Apply both end here.
function GraphEditor:_hidePopups()
	if self._simpPanel then self._simpPanel.Visible = false end
	self._simpOrigKps = nil
	self._simpOrigSamples = nil
	if self._codePopup then self._codePopup.Visible = false end
	self:_closeTransient()
end

function GraphEditor:_apply()
	if self._state.onApply then
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Graph Edit")
		self._state.onApply(self:_toSeq(), self:_getBezierData())
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Graph Edit")
	end
	self._applyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 130)
	task.delay(0.3, function()
		if self._applyBtn then self._applyBtn.TextColor3 = self._T.Green end
	end)
	self._originalSequence = nil
	self:_rawClose()
end

function GraphEditor:_reload()
	if not self._originalSequence then return end
	local onApply, onPreview = self._state.onApply, self._state.onPreview
	self:_load(self._originalSequence, self._originalBezierJSON)
	self._state.onApply = onApply; self._state.onPreview = onPreview
	self._panel.Visible = true
	task.defer(function() self:_redraw() end)
	if self._state.onPreview then self._state.onPreview(self._originalSequence) end
end

function GraphEditor:Open(sequence, propertyName, onApply, onPreview, bezierJSON)
	-- Re-opening while editing cancels the previous session first, or its unapplied live preview
	-- stays on the item with no revert and no undo waypoint.
	if self:IsOpen() then self:Close() end
	self._state.propName = propertyName or ""
	self._state.onApply = onApply
	self._state.onPreview = onPreview or nil
	self._originalSequence = sequence
	self._originalBezierJSON = bezierJSON
	self._lastPreviewTime = 0
	self._previewPending = false
	self._closing = false
	self._interactionState = "idle"
	self:_onOpened()
	self:_load(sequence, bezierJSON)
	self:_updatePasteBtn()

	self._panel.Visible = true
	task.defer(function() self:_redraw() end)
end

function GraphEditor:Close()
	if self._closing then return end
	self._closing = true
	-- Kept locally: the cleanup below clears them, and onPreview(origSeq) at the end reverts the live
	-- emitter. Consumers (Connectors.cGraphDots, PropertyInputs/AxisGraphPreview) recognise the
	-- revert by getting back the very sequence passed to Open.
	local onPrev = self._state.onPreview
	local origSeq = self._originalSequence
	self._originalSequence = nil
	self._state.onApply = nil; self._state.onPreview = nil
	self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_hideHelp()
	self:_hidePopups()
	self._panel.Visible = false
	self._ghostDot.Visible = false; self._ghostLineL.Visible = false; self._ghostLineR.Visible = false
	self._interactionState = "idle"; self._previewPending = false
	self._closing = false
	-- After _closing is false again, so a callback that calls Open() at once re-enters cleanly.
	if onPrev and origSeq then onPrev(origSeq) end
end

function GraphEditor:IsOpen() return self._panel.Visible and not self._closing end
function GraphEditor:GetPanel() return self._panel end

function GraphEditor:Destroy()
	for _, c in ipairs(self._conns) do c:Disconnect() end
	self._conns = {}
	local function destroyPool(pool)
		for _, inst in ipairs(pool.inUse) do inst:Destroy() end
		for _, inst in ipairs(pool.available) do inst:Destroy() end
	end
	destroyPool(self._linePool)
	destroyPool(self._dotPool)
	destroyPool(self._stripPool)
	destroyPool(self._labelPool)
	destroyPool(self._ghostLinePool)
	if self._panel then self._panel:Destroy() end
end

-- Mixins only add methods, so their order is free; all must load before `return GraphEditor`.
require(script.Interaction)(GraphEditor); task.wait()
require(script.EditMode)(GraphEditor); task.wait()
require(script.InputWiring)(GraphEditor); task.wait()
require(script.Rendering)(GraphEditor); task.wait()
require(script.RenderDraw)(GraphEditor); task.wait()
require(script.RenderSimplify)(GraphEditor); task.wait()
require(script.CodeIO)(GraphEditor); task.wait()

return GraphEditor

--[[
	BuildPlot: the graph editor's plot: its frame, axis, line, keypoint and ghost layers, the hover
	tooltip, the box-select rectangle and the action toast. Both views build their plot here.
	  buildPlot(panel, T, track, place) -> refs
	    track: { blob, stroke, color }  theme-ref registration functions of the view
	    place: { position, size, sunken, bleed, header, rightPad }
	      sunken    an opaque plot in the theme's Sunken colour
	      bleed     how far outside their rectangle the curve and keypoint layers clip, so points
	                on the edge of the range draw whole
	      header    height of a band along the top for the view to fill (refs.plotHeader)
	      rightPad  room right of the curve in place of Constants.DRAW_PAD.right
	refs.plotSurface carries the background and outline: the plot, or the frame around band and plot.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

local DRAW_PAD = C.DRAW_PAD

local function buildPlot(panel, T, track, place)
	local trackBlob, trackStroke, trackColor = track.blob, track.stroke, track.color

	local gf = Instance.new("Frame"); gf.Name = "GF"
	gf.BorderSizePixel = 0; gf.ClipsDescendants = true; gf.Active = true
	gf.ZIndex = 2

	local surface = gf
	local header = nil
	if place.header then
		surface = Instance.new("Frame")
		surface.Name = "Plot"
		surface.BorderSizePixel = 0
		surface.ZIndex = 2

		header = Instance.new("Frame")
		header.Name = "Header"
		header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, place.header)
		header.ZIndex = 3
		header.Parent = surface

		gf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		gf.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, place.header)
		gf.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -place.header)
		gf.Parent = surface
	end

	surface.BackgroundColor3 = T.GraphBg or Color3.fromRGB(16, 10, 5)
	trackColor(surface, "BackgroundColor3", "GraphBg")
	surface.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	if place.sunken then
		-- The plot is the one sunken surface of the panel.
		surface.BackgroundColor3 = T.GraphBg or T.Sunken or surface.BackgroundColor3
		surface.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	end
	surface.Size = place.size
	surface.Position = place.position
	surface.Parent = panel
	U.ac(surface, UDim.new(0, 4))
	trackStroke(U.addStroke(surface, T))

	local axisLayer = Instance.new("Frame"); axisLayer.Name = "Axis"
	axisLayer.BackgroundTransparency = 1; axisLayer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	axisLayer.ZIndex = 2; axisLayer.ClipsDescendants = true
	axisLayer.Parent = gf

	local layerPos = UDim2.new(0, DRAW_PAD.left, 0, DRAW_PAD.top)
	local padRight = place.rightPad or DRAW_PAD.right
	local layerSz = UDim2.new(1, -(DRAW_PAD.left + padRight), 1, -(DRAW_PAD.top + DRAW_PAD.bottom))

	local lineLayer = Instance.new("Frame"); lineLayer.Name = "Lines"
	lineLayer.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lineLayer.ClipsDescendants = true
	lineLayer.Position = layerPos; lineLayer.Size = layerSz
	lineLayer.ZIndex = 3; lineLayer.Parent = gf

	-- `da` holds dots, handles and envelope stems, clipped to the drawing area so dragged ones stop at
	-- the edge; ghost stays unclipped for the tooltip.
	local da = Instance.new("Frame"); da.Name = "DA"
	da.BackgroundTransparency = 1; da.ClipsDescendants = true
	da.Position = layerPos; da.Size = layerSz
	da.ZIndex = 4; da.Parent = gf

	-- The layers keep their exact rectangle (the mixins measure the plot from it); only the
	-- clipping moves outward, to a parent of each.
	local function clipWithBleed(layer, bleed)
		local clip = Instance.new("Frame")
		clip.Name = layer.Name .. "Clip"
		clip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		clip.ClipsDescendants = true
		clip.Position = layerPos - UDim2.fromOffset(bleed, bleed)
		clip.Size = layerSz + UDim2.fromOffset(bleed * 2, bleed * 2)
		clip.ZIndex = layer.ZIndex
		clip.Parent = gf
		layer.ClipsDescendants = false
		layer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bleed, bleed)
		layer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -bleed * 2, 1, -bleed * 2)
		layer.Parent = clip
	end
	if place.bleed then
		clipWithBleed(lineLayer, place.bleed)
		clipWithBleed(da, place.bleed)
	end

	local ghost = Instance.new("Frame"); ghost.Name = "Ghost"
	ghost.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ghost.ClipsDescendants = false
	ghost.Position = layerPos; ghost.Size = layerSz
	ghost.ZIndex = 5; ghost.Parent = gf

	local boxRect = Instance.new("Frame"); boxRect.Name = "BoxSel"
	boxRect.BackgroundColor3 = T.Gold; boxRect.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
	boxRect.BorderSizePixel = 0; boxRect.Visible = false
	boxRect.ZIndex = 6; boxRect.Parent = ghost
	trackColor(boxRect, "BackgroundColor3", "Gold")
	local boxStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", boxRect)
	boxStroke.Color = T.Gold; boxStroke.Transparency = 0.5; boxStroke.Thickness = 1
	trackColor(boxStroke, "Color", "Gold")

	-- On the unclipped ghost layer, so the readout above a top keypoint is not cut off.
	local tooltip = Instance.new("Frame"); tooltip.Name = "Tooltip"
	tooltip.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; tooltip.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	trackBlob(tooltip)
	tooltip.BorderSizePixel = 0; tooltip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 16)
	tooltip.Visible = false; tooltip.ZIndex = 10; tooltip.Active = false
	tooltip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	tooltip.Parent = ghost
	U.ac(tooltip, UDim.new(0, 3))
	trackBlob(tooltip)
	local tipLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel"); tipLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tipLabel.Text = ""; tipLabel.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tipLabel.Font = T.Font
	tipLabel.TextSize = 8; tipLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, 0)
	tipLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
	tipLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; tipLabel.ZIndex = 11
	tipLabel.Parent = tooltip
	trackColor(tipLabel, "TextColor3", "BrightGold")

	-- Ghost instances, built once.
	local ghostDot = Instance.new("Frame"); ghostDot.Name = "GDot"
	ghostDot.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ghostDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	ghostDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, C.GHOST_DOT_PX, 0, C.GHOST_DOT_PX)
	ghostDot.Visible = false; ghostDot.ZIndex = 6; ghostDot.Parent = ghost
	Instance.new("UICorner", ghostDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.ceil(C.GHOST_DOT_PX / 2))
	local gs = Instance.new("UIStroke", ghostDot)
	gs.Color = T.Gold; gs.Transparency = C.GHOST_ALPHA; gs.Thickness = 1.5
	gs.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	trackColor(gs, "Color", "Gold")

	local ghostLineL = Instance.new("Frame"); ghostLineL.Name = "GL"
	ghostLineL.BackgroundColor3 = T.MutedGold; ghostLineL.BackgroundTransparency = C.GHOST_LINE_ALPHA
	ghostLineL.BorderSizePixel = 0; ghostLineL.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	ghostLineL.Visible = false; ghostLineL.ZIndex = 2; ghostLineL.Parent = ghost
	trackColor(ghostLineL, "BackgroundColor3", "MutedGold")

	local ghostLineR = Instance.new("Frame"); ghostLineR.Name = "GR"
	ghostLineR.BackgroundColor3 = T.MutedGold; ghostLineR.BackgroundTransparency = C.GHOST_LINE_ALPHA
	ghostLineR.BorderSizePixel = 0; ghostLineR.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	ghostLineR.Visible = false; ghostLineR.ZIndex = 2; ghostLineR.Parent = ghost
	trackColor(ghostLineR, "BackgroundColor3", "MutedGold")

	local actionLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel"); actionLabel.Name = "ActionPopup"
	actionLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; actionLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	actionLabel.Text = ""; actionLabel.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	trackColor(actionLabel, "TextColor3", "BrightGold")
	actionLabel.Font = T.Font; actionLabel.TextSize = 9
	actionLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 14)
	actionLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	actionLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 4)
	actionLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	actionLabel.ZIndex = 10; actionLabel.Visible = false
	actionLabel.Parent = da

	return {
		graphFrame = gf,
		plotSurface = surface,
		plotHeader = header,
		axisLayer = axisLayer,
		lineLayer = lineLayer,
		drawArea = da,
		ghostFrame = ghost,
		ghostDot = ghostDot,
		ghostLineL = ghostLineL,
		ghostLineR = ghostLineR,
		actionLabel = actionLabel,
		boxRect = boxRect,
		tooltip = tooltip,
		tipLabel = tipLabel,
	}
end

return buildPlot

--[[
	BuildPopups: the graph editor's popovers, children of its panel: the keypoint edit panel
	(double-click), the shortcuts overlay and the Simplify popover. Both views build them here.
	  buildPopups(panel, T, editor, track, place) -> refs
	    track: { blob, stroke, color, scrollbar }  theme-ref registration functions of the view
	    place: { helpPosition, helpSize, simplifyPosition }
	refs: the names the mixins use (editPanel, tIn, helpOverlay, simpPanel ...), helpCard, and
	simplifySize (SIMPLIFY_W, SIMPLIFY_H) for the view placing the popover.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)

local EDITPANEL_W = C.EDITPANEL_W
local EDITPANEL_ROW_H = C.EDITPANEL_ROW_H
local EDITPANEL_GAP = C.EDITPANEL_GAP
local EDITPANEL_PAD = C.EDITPANEL_PAD

local function buildPopups(panel, T, self, track, place)
	local trackBlob, trackStroke, trackColor, trackScrollbar = track.blob, track.stroke, track.color, track.scrollbar

	-- Edit popover.
	local ep = Instance.new("Frame"); ep.Name = "EditPanel"
	ep.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; ep.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	ep.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ep.Size = UDim2.new(0, EDITPANEL_W, 0, 10)
	ep.Visible = false; ep.ZIndex = 10; ep.Active = true
	ep.Parent = panel
	U.ac(ep, UDim.new(0, 6))
	local epStroke = U.addStroke(ep, T)
	trackStroke(epStroke)
	local caret = Instance.new("Frame"); caret.Name = "Caret"
	caret.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; caret.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	caret.BorderSizePixel = 0
	caret.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
	caret.Rotation = 45
	caret.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	caret.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
	caret.ZIndex = 10; caret.Parent = ep
	local editCloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); editCloseBtn.Name = "EditClose"
	editCloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	editCloseBtn.Text = "\xC3\x97" -- multiplication sign
	editCloseBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; editCloseBtn.Font = T.Font; editCloseBtn.TextSize = 12
	editCloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
	editCloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, -2)
	editCloseBtn.ZIndex = 12; editCloseBtn.Parent = ep
	trackColor(editCloseBtn, "TextColor3", "MutedGold")
	editCloseBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_hideEditPanel() end)
	local CARET_H = 8
	local rowY = CARET_H
	local rowW = EDITPANEL_W - EDITPANEL_PAD * 2
	local tRow = Instance.new("Frame"); tRow.Name = "TR"; tRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tRow.Size = UDim2.new(0, rowW, 0, EDITPANEL_ROW_H); tRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, EDITPANEL_PAD, 0, rowY)
	tRow.ZIndex = 11; tRow.Parent = ep
	U.lbl(tRow, "Time", T, 34).Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	local tIn, tW, tS = U.inp(tRow, "-", T, rowW - 36)
	tW.Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 1); tW.Size = UDim2.new(0, rowW - 36, 1, -2)
	tW.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	trackBlob(tW); trackStroke(tS)
	tIn.TextSize = 10
	tIn.FocusLost:Connect(function() self:_onTimeIn() end)
	rowY = rowY + EDITPANEL_ROW_H + EDITPANEL_GAP
	local vRow = Instance.new("Frame"); vRow.Name = "VR"; vRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	vRow.Size = UDim2.new(0, rowW, 0, EDITPANEL_ROW_H); vRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, EDITPANEL_PAD, 0, rowY)
	vRow.ZIndex = 11; vRow.Parent = ep
	U.lbl(vRow, "Value", T, 34).Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	local vIn, vW, vS = U.inp(vRow, "-", T, rowW - 36)
	vW.Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 1); vW.Size = UDim2.new(0, rowW - 36, 1, -2)
	vW.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	trackBlob(vW); trackStroke(vS)
	vIn.TextSize = 10
	vIn.FocusLost:Connect(function() self:_onValIn() end)
	rowY = rowY + EDITPANEL_ROW_H + EDITPANEL_GAP
	local eRow = Instance.new("Frame"); eRow.Name = "ER"; eRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	eRow.Size = UDim2.new(0, rowW, 0, EDITPANEL_ROW_H); eRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, EDITPANEL_PAD, 0, rowY)
	eRow.ZIndex = 11; eRow.Parent = ep
	local eLbl = U.lbl(eRow, "Env", T, 34)
	eLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	local eIn, eW, eS = U.inp(eRow, "-", T, rowW - 36)
	eW.Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 1); eW.Size = UDim2.new(0, rowW - 36, 1, -2)
	eW.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	trackBlob(eW); trackStroke(eS)
	eIn.TextSize = 10
	eIn.FocusLost:Connect(function() self:_onEnvIn() end)
	rowY = rowY + EDITPANEL_ROW_H + EDITPANEL_GAP
	local delBtn, delS = U.btn("Del", ep, "Delete", UDim2.new(0, rowW, 0, EDITPANEL_ROW_H), T, T.MutedGold)
	delBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, EDITPANEL_PAD, 0, rowY)
	delBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	delBtn.TextSize = 9; delBtn.ZIndex = 11
	trackBlob(delBtn); trackStroke(delS)
	delBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if self:_selectedCount() > 0 then
			self:_delSelected()
			self:_hideEditPanel()
		end
	end)
	rowY = rowY + EDITPANEL_ROW_H + EDITPANEL_PAD
	-- Shortcuts overlay.
	local helpOverlay = Instance.new("Frame"); helpOverlay.Name = "HelpOverlay"
	helpOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0); helpOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	helpOverlay.BorderSizePixel = 0; helpOverlay.Visible = false
	helpOverlay.Size = place.helpSize
	helpOverlay.Position = place.helpPosition
	helpOverlay.ZIndex = 20; helpOverlay.Active = true; helpOverlay.Parent = panel
	U.ac(helpOverlay, UDim.new(0, 4))
	local helpCard = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); helpCard.Name = "HelpCard"
	helpCard.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; helpCard.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	helpCard.BorderSizePixel = 0
	helpCard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 230)
	helpCard.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

	local helpTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel"); helpTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	helpTitle.Text = "Keyboard Shortcuts"; helpTitle.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	helpTitle.Font = T.Font; helpTitle.TextSize = 11
	helpTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	helpTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	helpTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6)
	helpTitle.ZIndex = 22; helpTitle.Parent = helpCard
	trackColor(helpTitle, "TextColor3", "BrightGold")
	local helpSections = {
		{ header = "Mouse", items = {
			{ "Click empty", "Add keypoint" },
			{ "Click keypoint", "Select" },
			{ "Shift+click", "Multi-select" },
			{ "Double-click", "Edit values" },
			{ "Drag keypoint", "Move (Shift = axis lock)" },
			{ "Drag empty", "Box select" },
		}},
		{ header = "Keys", items = {
			{ "Arrow keys", "Nudge (Shift = bigger)" },
			{ "Del / Backspace", "Delete selected" },
			{ "C / V", "Copy / Paste curve" },
			{ "Esc", "Close editor" },
		}},
		-- Navigation is on Y only (time is fixed to 0..1); InputWiring wires the zoom and pan.
		{ header = "Navigation", items = {
			{ "Scroll", "Zoom" },
			{ "Alt+drag / Mid-drag", "Pan viewport" },
		}},
	}
	local helpY = 26
	for _, section in ipairs(helpSections) do
		local secHdr = Instance.new("TextLabel"); secHdr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		secHdr.Text = section.header; secHdr.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		secHdr.Font = T.Font; secHdr.TextSize = 9
		secHdr.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		secHdr.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14)
		secHdr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, helpY)
		secHdr.ZIndex = 22; secHdr.Parent = helpCard
		trackColor(secHdr, "TextColor3", "MutedGold")
		helpY = helpY + 14
		for _, item in ipairs(section.items) do
			local keyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); keyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			keyLbl.Text = item[1]; keyLbl.TextColor3 = T.Gold
			keyLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Code; keyLbl.TextSize = 9
			keyLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			keyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 13)
			keyLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, helpY)
			keyLbl.ZIndex = 22; keyLbl.Parent = helpCard
			trackColor(keyLbl, "TextColor3", "Gold")
			local descLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); descLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			descLbl.Text = item[2]; descLbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			descLbl.Font = T.Font; descLbl.TextSize = 9
			descLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			descLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 13)
			descLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 152, 0, helpY)
			descLbl.ZIndex = 22; descLbl.Parent = helpCard
			trackColor(descLbl, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
			helpY = helpY + 13
		end
		helpY = helpY + 4
	end
	local dismissHint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); dismissHint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dismissHint.Text = "Click anywhere to dismiss"; dismissHint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	dismissHint.Font = T.Font; dismissHint.TextSize = 8
	dismissHint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	dismissHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
	dismissHint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, helpY + 4)
	dismissHint.ZIndex = 22; dismissHint.Parent = helpCard
	trackColor(dismissHint, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
	helpCard.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, helpY + 20)
	local helpDismiss = Instance.new("TextButton"); helpDismiss.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	helpDismiss.Text = ""; helpDismiss.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); helpDismiss.ZIndex = 23
	helpDismiss.Parent = helpOverlay
	helpDismiss.Activated:Connect(function() self:_hideHelp() end)
	-- Simplify popover.
	local SIMPLIFY_W = 160
	local SIMPLIFY_H = 76
	local simpPanel, simpPanelS = U.blob("SimplifyPanel", panel, UDim2.new(0, SIMPLIFY_W, 0, SIMPLIFY_H), T)
	simpPanel.Visible = false; simpPanel.ZIndex = 15; simpPanel.Active = true
	simpPanel.Position = place.simplifyPosition
	trackBlob(simpPanel); trackStroke(simpPanelS)
	local minBtn, minS = U.btn("Min", simpPanel, "Minimize", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 20), T, T.Gold)
	minBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4); minBtn.TextSize = 9; minBtn.ZIndex = 16
	trackBlob(minBtn); trackStroke(minS)
	minBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_minimize() end)
	local redLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); redLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	redLbl.Text = "Reduce"; redLbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; redLbl.Font = T.Font; redLbl.TextSize = 8
	redLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	redLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 14); redLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 28)
	redLbl.ZIndex = 16; redLbl.Parent = simpPanel
	trackColor(redLbl, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
	local sliderTrack = Instance.new("Frame"); sliderTrack.Name = "SliderTrack"
	sliderTrack.BackgroundColor3 = T.DarkGold; sliderTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	sliderTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
	sliderTrack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 8)

	devLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12); devLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 56)

	return {
