--[[
	BuildUI: builds the graph editor's Classic view (panel, header, preset strip, plot) and the lower
	controls through BuildUIControls.
	  buildUI(screenGui, T, editor) -> refs, including themeRefs for RefreshTheme
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)
-- Each task.wait lets a frame pass between the heavier requires.
local buildControls = require(script.Parent.BuildUIControls); task.wait()
local buildPlot = require(script.Parent.BuildPlot); task.wait()
local PresetThumb = require(script.Parent.PresetThumb)
local MiniSlider = require(script.Parent.Parent.UIBuilder.MiniSlider)
local Layout = require(script.Parent.Layout)

local PRESET_THUMB_W = C.PRESET_THUMB_W
local PRESET_THUMB_H = C.PRESET_THUMB_H
local PRESET_GAP = C.PRESET_GAP
local PRESETS = C.PRESETS

local function buildUI(screenGui, T, self)
	-- themeRefs.colored holds {instance, property, themeColorKey} for controls the single-colour
	-- categories cannot hold; RefreshTheme reapplies T[colorKey] to each (trackColor adds one).
	local themeRefs = { panels = {}, blobs = {}, strokes = {}, scrollbars = {}, colored = {} }
	local function trackPanel(f) table.insert(themeRefs.panels, f) end
	local function trackBlob(f) table.insert(themeRefs.blobs, f) end
	local function trackStroke(s) table.insert(themeRefs.strokes, s) end
	local function trackColor(inst, prop, colorKey) table.insert(themeRefs.colored, { inst, prop, colorKey }) end

	local L = self._layout
	local buttonY = L.buttonY
	local buttonH = L.buttonH

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = "GraphEditor"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -L.panelW/2, 0.5, -L.panelH/2)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, L.panelW, 0, L.panelH)
	panel.Visible = false; panel.ZIndex = 6; panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true
	panel.Parent = screenGui
	U.ac(panel, UDim.new(0, 8))
	trackStroke(U.addStroke(panel, T))
	trackPanel(panel)

	local hdr = U.region(L, "Hdr", panel, L.headerH, T, trackBlob, trackStroke)
	hdr.Position = UDim2.new(0, L.side, 0, L.top)

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "Graph Editor"; title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
	title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 11
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	-- The header's tools sit together at its right end; the title takes what is left.
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(378 + 6), 1, 0); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0)
	title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	title.ZIndex = 8; title.Parent = hdr
	trackColor(title, "TextColor3", "Gold")

	local undoBtn, undoS = U.btn("Undo", hdr, "<", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, buttonH), T, T.DarkGold)
	undoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -368, 0, buttonY); undoBtn.TextSize = 10; undoBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(undoBtn); trackStroke(undoS)
	undoBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_undo() end)

	local redoBtn, redoS = U.btn("Redo", hdr, ">", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, buttonH), T, T.DarkGold)
	redoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -344, 0, buttonY); redoBtn.TextSize = 10; redoBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(redoBtn); trackStroke(redoS)
	redoBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_redo() end)

	local invertBtn, invertS = U.btn("Inv", hdr, "Invert", UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, buttonH), T, T.Gold)
	invertBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -320, 0, buttonY); invertBtn.TextSize = 9; invertBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(invertBtn); trackStroke(invertS)
	invertBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_invertGraph() end)

	-- Bare text, so not U.btn; its colour is tracked so theme switches re-tint it.
	local xBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); xBtn.Name = "X"; xBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	xBtn.Text = "X"; xBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; xBtn.Font = T.Font; xBtn.TextSize = 10
	xBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0); xBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0)
	xBtn.ZIndex = 9; xBtn.Parent = hdr
	trackColor(xBtn, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
	xBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:Close() end)

	local helpBtn, helpS = U.btn("Help", hdr, "?", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, buttonH), T, T.DarkGold)
	helpBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0, buttonY); helpBtn.TextSize = 10; helpBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(helpBtn); trackStroke(helpS)
	helpBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_toggleHelp() end)

	-- Dragging the scale slider previews the size as an outline; the UIScale applies on release.
	local SCALE_SLIDER_W = 96
	local scaleSlider = MiniSlider.new(hdr, T, {
		name = "Scale", min = C.PANEL_SCALE_MIN, max = C.PANEL_SCALE_MAX, default = self:_savedPanelScale(),
		width = SCALE_SLIDER_W, height = buttonH, zIndex = 9,
	})
	MiniSlider.bindPanelScale(scaleSlider, panel, T, function(value) self:_setPanelScale(value) end, C.PANEL_BASE_SCALE)
	scaleSlider.frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(46 + SCALE_SLIDER_W), 0, buttonY)
	trackBlob(scaleSlider.track)
	trackColor(scaleSlider.fill, "BackgroundColor3", "SliderFill")
	trackColor(scaleSlider.handle, "BackgroundColor3", "BrightGold")
	trackColor(scaleSlider.label, "TextColor3", "MutedGold")
	for _, conn in ipairs(scaleSlider.conns) do table.insert(self._conns, conn) end

	local pasteBtn, pasteS = U.btn("Ps", hdr, "Paste", UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, buttonH), T, T.MutedGold)
	pasteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -184, 0, buttonY); pasteBtn.TextSize = 9; pasteBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(pasteBtn); trackStroke(pasteS)
	pasteBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_pasteFromClipboard() end)

	local copyBtn, copyS = U.btn("Cp", hdr, "Copy", UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, buttonH), T, T.Gold)
	copyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -226, 0, buttonY); copyBtn.TextSize = 9; copyBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(copyBtn); trackStroke(copyS)
	copyBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_copyToClipboard() end)

	local codeBtn, codeS = U.btn("Code", hdr, "Code", UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, buttonH), T, T.MutedGold)
	codeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -268, 0, buttonY); codeBtn.TextSize = 9; codeBtn.ZIndex = 9
	trackBlob(codeBtn); trackStroke(codeS)
	codeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_openCodePopup() end)

	local dH = Instance.new("TextButton"); dH.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dH.Text = ""
	dH.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); dH.ZIndex = 7; dH.Parent = hdr
	self:_makeDrag(panel, dH)

	-- Preset strip: its title row is as tall as the folded bar; the thumbnails sit under it.
	local presetsOpen = self._presetStripExpanded
	local presetHeadH = L.presetCollapsedH

	local presetBar = U.region(L, "PresetBar", panel, presetsOpen and L.presetH or presetHeadH, T, trackBlob, trackStroke)
	presetBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, L.side, 0, Layout.stripY(L))
	presetBar.ClipsDescendants = true

	local collapseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); collapseBtn.Name = "CollapsePresets"
	collapseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; collapseBtn.Text = presetsOpen and "\xE2\x96\xBC" or "\xE2\x96\xB6"
	collapseBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; collapseBtn.Font = T.Font; collapseBtn.TextSize = 8
	collapseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, presetHeadH)
	collapseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	collapseBtn.ZIndex = 8; collapseBtn.Parent = presetBar
	trackColor(collapseBtn, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
	collapseBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_togglePresetStrip() end)

	local presetsLabel = Instance.new("TextButton"); presetsLabel.Name = "PresetsLabel"
	presetsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1; presetsLabel.Text = "Presets"
	presetsLabel.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; presetsLabel.Font = T.Font; presetsLabel.TextSize = 8
	presetsLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	presetsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, presetHeadH)
	presetsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
	presetsLabel.ZIndex = 8; presetsLabel.Parent = presetBar
	trackColor(presetsLabel, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
	presetsLabel.Activated:Connect(function() self:_togglePresetStrip() end)

	local stripFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); stripFrame.Name = "PresetStrip"
	stripFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; stripFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	stripFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
	stripFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6; stripFrame.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X; stripFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	stripFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, L.presetH - presetHeadH)
	stripFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, presetHeadH)
	stripFrame.Visible = presetsOpen
	stripFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, (#PRESETS * (PRESET_THUMB_W + PRESET_GAP)) + PRESET_GAP, 0, 0)
	stripFrame.ZIndex = 7; stripFrame.Active = true
	stripFrame.Parent = presetBar; table.insert(themeRefs.scrollbars, stripFrame)

	local presetThumbs = {}
	for i, preset in ipairs(PRESETS) do
		local x = PRESET_GAP + (i - 1) * (PRESET_THUMB_W + PRESET_GAP)
		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame"); wrapper.Name = preset.name .. "W"
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1; wrapper.BorderSizePixel = 0
		wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(0, PRESET_THUMB_W, 0, PRESET_THUMB_H - 2)
		wrapper.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 1)
		wrapper.ZIndex = 8; wrapper.ClipsDescendants = true; wrapper.Parent = stripFrame
		local thumb = Instance.new("TextButton"); thumb.Name = preset.name
		thumb.BackgroundColor3 = T.GraphBg or Color3.fromRGB(20, 12, 6)
		trackColor(thumb, "BackgroundColor3", "GraphBg")
		thumb.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3; thumb.BorderSizePixel = 0
		thumb.Text = ""; thumb.AutoButtonColor = true
		thumb.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		thumb.ZIndex = 8; thumb.Parent = wrapper
		U.ac(thumb, UDim.new(0, 3))

		PresetThumb.draw(wrapper, preset, PRESET_THUMB_W, PRESET_THUMB_H - 2, T, trackColor, 9)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Text = preset.name; lbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		trackColor(lbl, "TextColor3", "DarkGold")
		lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 7; lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
		lbl.ZIndex = 9; lbl.Parent = thumb

		thumb.Activated:Connect(function() self:_applyPreset(i) end)
		presetThumbs[i] = thumb
	end

	-- Layout owns the plot's gY / gH; ViewClassic._calcGraphRegion uses the same calls when the
	-- preset strip folds or opens.
	local gY = Layout.graphY(L, presetsOpen)
	local gH = Layout.graphH(L, presetsOpen)

	local plot = buildPlot(panel, T, { blob = trackBlob, stroke = trackStroke, color = trackColor }, {
		position = UDim2.new(0, L.side, 0, gY),
		size = UDim2.new(1, -L.side * 2, 0, gH),
		sunken = false,
	})
	local gf, da, ghost = plot.graphFrame, plot.drawArea, plot.ghostFrame

	local function trackScrollbar(f) table.insert(themeRefs.scrollbars, f) end
	local ctrlRefs = buildControls(panel, gf, da, ghost, T, self, gY, gH, trackPanel, trackBlob, trackStroke, trackScrollbar, trackColor)

	local refs = {
		themeRefs = themeRefs,
		panel = panel,
		title = title,
		redoBtn = redoBtn,
		undoBtn = undoBtn,
		helpBtn = helpBtn,
		pasteBtn = pasteBtn,
		copyBtn = copyBtn,
		scaleSlider = scaleSlider,
		collapseBtn = collapseBtn,
		presetsLabel = presetsLabel,
		presetBar = presetBar,
		presetStrip = stripFrame,
		presetThumbs = presetThumbs,
		gY = gY,
		gH = gH,
	}

	for k, v in pairs(plot) do refs[k] = v end
	for k, v in pairs(ctrlRefs) do refs[k] = v end

	return refs
end

return buildUI

--[[
	BuildUIControls: the lower part of the graph editor's UI (status bar, Show popup, footer) and the
	popovers through BuildPopups. Called from BuildUI.
	  buildControls(panel, gf, da, ghost, T, self, gY, gH, trackPanel, trackBlob, ...) -> refs
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local U = require(script.Parent.Util)
local Layout = require(script.Parent.Layout)
local buildPopups = require(script.Parent.BuildPopups)

-- Width of Reload / Cancel / Apply at the footer's right end.
local FOOTER_BUTTON = 84
local function buildControls(panel, gf, da, ghost, T, self, gY, gH, trackPanel, trackBlob, trackStroke, trackScrollbar, trackColor)
	local L = self._layout
	local sbY = Layout.statusY(L)
	-- Edit panel, shortcuts overlay and Simplify popover. 160 x 76 is the Simplify popover's size.
	local popups = buildPopups(panel, T, self, { blob = trackBlob, stroke = trackStroke, color = trackColor, scrollbar = trackScrollbar }, {
		helpPosition = UDim2.new(0, L.side, 0, gY),
		helpSize = UDim2.new(1, -L.side * 2, 0, gH),
		simplifyPosition = UDim2.new(1, -160 - 8, 0, sbY - 76 - 4),
	})
	local sb = U.region(L, "StatusBar", panel, L.statusH, T, trackBlob, trackStroke)
	sb.Position = UDim2.new(0, L.side, 0, sbY)
	local showBtn, showS = U.btn("Show", sb, "Show \xe2\x96\xbe", UDim2.new(0, 48, 1, -4), T, T.DarkGold)
	showBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 2); showBtn.TextSize = 9; showBtn.ZIndex = 8
	trackBlob(showBtn); trackStroke(showS)
	-- Opaque (alpha 0) so its rows stay readable over the graph; Rendering.RefreshTheme keeps an
	-- _opaqueBlob frame opaque.

--[[
	CodeIO mixin: the curve as Luau code. _openCodePopup shows the curve as a
	`NumberSequence.new({...})` constructor, focused and selected for Ctrl+C, with an Import button
	that parses the same form back into keypoints.
]]

local U = require(script.Parent.Util)
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)

return function(GraphEditor)

-- Serializes what Apply would write, so the exported code matches the applied curve.
function GraphEditor:_seqToCodeString()
	local seq = self:_toSeq()
	local lines = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
		if kp.Envelope > 0 then
			table.insert(lines, string.format("\tNumberSequenceKeypoint.new(%.4g, %.4g, %.4g),", kp.Time, kp.Value, kp.Envelope))
		else
			table.insert(lines, string.format("\tNumberSequenceKeypoint.new(%.4g, %.4g),", kp.Time, kp.Value))
		end
	end
	return "NumberSequence.new({\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n})"
end

-- `NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, v[, e])` entries from pasted code: a sorted keypoint array, or nil
-- and a reason.
function GraphEditor:_parseCodeString(text)
	local parsed = {}
	for args in text:gmatch("NumberSequenceKeypoint%.new%s*%(([^%)]+)%)") do
		local nums = {}
		for token in args:gmatch("[^,]+") do
			table.insert(nums, tonumber((token:gsub("%s", ""))))
		end
		if not nums[1] or not nums[2] then return nil, "Unreadable keypoint" end
		table.insert(parsed, {
			time = math.clamp(nums[1], 0, 1),
			value = nums[2],
			envelope = math.max(0, nums[3] or 0),
		})
	end
	if #parsed < 2 then return nil, "Need at least 2 keypoints" end
	if #parsed > C.MAX_KEYPOINTS then return nil, "Roblox limit: " .. C.MAX_KEYPOINTS .. " keypoints" end
	table.sort(parsed, function(a, b) return a.time < b.time end)
	parsed[1].time = 0
	parsed[#parsed].time = 1
	return parsed
end

function GraphEditor:_importCodeString(text)
	local parsed, why = self:_parseCodeString(text)
	if not parsed then
		self:_showActionPopup(why or "Couldn't parse code")
		return
	end
	self:_pushUndo()
	local s = self._state
	s.keypoints = parsed
	s.handlesEnabled = false
	self._handlesEverEnabled = false
	self:_initLinearHandles()
	local hasEnv = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(parsed) do
		if kp.envelope > 0 then hasEnv = true; break end
	end
	if hasEnv then s.envelopeEnabled = true end
	self:_clearSelection(); self:_hideEditPanel()
	self:_syncUIToState(); self:_adaptRange(false)
	self:_redraw(); self:_tryPreview()
	self._codePopup.Visible = false
	self:_showActionPopup("Imported " .. #parsed .. " keypoints")
end

function GraphEditor:_buildCodePopup()
	local T = self._T
	local popup, popupS = U.blob("CodePopup", self._panel, UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 156), T)
	popup.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -78)
	popup.ZIndex = 18
	popup.Visible = false
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.blobs, popup)
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.strokes, popupS)

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1; title.Text = "Sequence as code"
	title.TextColor3 = T.Gold; title.Font = T.Font; title.TextSize = 10
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 2)
	title.ZIndex = 19; title.Parent = popup
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.colored, { title, "TextColor3", "Gold" })

	local box = Instance.new("TextBox"); box.Name = "CodeBox"
	box.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; box.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	box.Font = Enum.Font.Code; box.TextSize = 9
	box.MultiLine = true; box.TextWrapped = true; box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; box.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -46); box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 20)
	box.Text = ""; box.ZIndex = 19; box.Parent = popup
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.panels, box)
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.colored, { box, "TextColor3", "MutedGold" })

	local importBtn, importS = U.btn("Import", popup, "Import", UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 18), T, T.Green)
	importBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 1, -22); importBtn.TextSize = 9; importBtn.ZIndex = 19
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.blobs, importBtn)
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.strokes, importS)
	importBtn.Activated:Connect(function() self:_importCodeString(box.Text) end)

	local closeBtn, closeS = U.btn("CloseCode", popup, "Close", UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18), T, T.DarkGold)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -122, 1, -22); closeBtn.TextSize = 9; closeBtn.ZIndex = 19
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.blobs, closeBtn)
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.strokes, closeS)
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() popup.Visible = false end)

	local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel"); hint.Name = "Hint"
	hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1; hint.Text = "Ctrl+C to copy  -  paste code here, then Import"
	hint.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; hint.Font = T.Font; hint.TextSize = 8
	hint.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -134, 0, 18); hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -22)
	hint.ZIndex = 19; hint.Parent = popup
	table.insert(self._themeRefs.colored, { hint, "TextColor3", "DarkGold" })

	self._codePopup = popup
	self._codeBox = box
end

function GraphEditor:_openCodePopup()
	if not self._codePopup then self:_buildCodePopup() end
	if self._codePopup.Visible then
		self._codePopup.Visible = false
		return
	end
	self._codeBox.Text = self:_seqToCodeString()
	self._codePopup.Visible = true
	-- Focused with everything selected, so Ctrl+C copies at once.
	self._codeBox:CaptureFocus()
	self._codeBox.SelectionStart = 1
	self._codeBox.CursorPosition = #self._codeBox.Text + 1
end

end
